1.1.1.s: brahma saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | kṣatraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | iṣaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | ūrjaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | rayiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | puṣṭiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | prajāṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | paśūnthsaṃdhattaṃ tānme jinvatam | stutosi janadhāḥ | devāstvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu
1.1.1.d: ब्रह्म संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । क्षत्रं संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । इषं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । ऊर्जं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । रयिं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । पुष्टिं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । प्रजां संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । पशून्थ्संधत्तं तान्मे जिन्वतम् । स्तुतोसि जनधाः । देवास्त्वा शुक्रपाः प्रणयन्तु
1.1.1.m: Unite brahman, invigorate that for me! / Unite regal power, invigorate that for me! / Unite refreshment, invigorate that for me! / Unite vigor, invigorate that for me! / Unite wealth, invigorate that for me! / Unite nourishment, invigorate that for me! / Unite offspring, invigorate that for me! / Unite domestic animals, invigorate them for me! / You are praised, supporter of people; / let the gods who drink the clear soma cup lead you forth!

1.1.1.s: suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayanparīhi | śukraḥ śukraśociṣā | stutosi janadhāḥ | devāstvā manthipāḥ praṇayantu | suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayanparīhi | manthī manthiśociṣā | saṃjagmānau diva ā pṛthivyā''yuḥ | saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | prāṇaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam | apānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam
1.1.1.d: सुवीराः प्रजाः प्रजनयन्परीहि । शुक्रः शुक्रशोचिषा । स्तुतोसि जनधाः । देवास्त्वा मन्थिपाः प्रणयन्तु । सुप्रजाः प्रजाः प्रजनयन्परीहि । मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषा । संजग्मानौ दिव आ पृथिव्या'ऽयुः । संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । प्राणं संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् । अपानं संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम्
1.1.1.m:
Go around, begetting offspring with good heroes, / clear with clear brilliance! / You are praised, supporter of people; / let the gods who drink the stirred soma cup lead you forth! / Go around, begetting good offspring, / stirred with stirred brilliance! / Having met from heaven and earth, unite lifespan; / invigorate that for me! / Unite exhalation, invigorate that for me! / Unite inhalation, invigorate that for me!

Unite diffused breath, invigorate that for me! / Unite sight, invigorate that for me! / Unite hearing, invigorate that for me! / Unite mind, invigorate that for me! / Unite speech, invigorate that for me! / You two are lifespan: grant me lifespan! / Grant lifespan to the sacrifice! / Grant lifespan to the lord of the sacrifice! / You two are exhalation: grant me exhalation! / Grant exhalation to the sacrifice!

1.1.1.s: vyānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam | cakṣuḥ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | śrotraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | manaḥ saṃdhattaṃ tanme jinvatam | vācaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | āyuḥ stha āyurme dhattam | āyuryajñāya dhattam | āyuryajñapataye dhattam | prāṇaḥ sthaḥ prāṇaṃ me dhattam | prāṇaṃ yajñāya dhattam
1.1.1.d: व्यानं संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् । चक्षुः संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । श्रोत्रं संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । मनः संधत्तं तन्मे जिन्वतम् । वाचं संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् । आयुः स्थ आयुर्मे धत्तम् । आयुर्यज्ञाय धत्तम् । आयुर्यज्ञपतये धत्तम् । प्राणः स्थः प्राणं मे धत्तम् । प्राणं यज्ञाय धत्तम्

1.1.1.s: prāṇaṃ yajñapataye dhattam | cakṣuḥ sthaścakṣurme dhattam | cakṣuryajñāya dhattam | cakṣuryajñapataye dhattam | śrotraṃ sthaḥ śrotraṃ me dhattam | śrotraṃ yajñāya dhattam | śrotraṃ yajñapataye dhattam | tau devau śukrāmanthinau | kalpayataṃ daivīrviśaḥ | kalpayataṃ mānuṣīḥ
1.1.1.d: प्राणं यज्ञपतये धत्तम् । चक्षुः स्थश्चक्षुर्मे धत्तम् । चक्षुर्यज्ञाय धत्तम् । चक्षुर्यज्ञपतये धत्तम् । श्रोत्रं स्थः श्रोत्रं मे धत्तम् । श्रोत्रं यज्ञाय धत्तम् । श्रोत्रं यज्ञपतये धत्तम् । तौ देवौ शुक्रामन्थिनौ । कल्पयतं दैवीर्विशः । कल्पयतं मानुषीः
1.1.1.m: Grant exhalation to the lord of the sacrifice! / You two are sight: grant me sight! / Grant sight to the sacrifice! / Grant sight to the lord of the sacrifice! / You two are hearing: grant me hearing! / Grant hearing to the sacrifice! / Grant hearing to the lord of the sacrifice! / You two gods, clear and stirred soma cups, / arrange the divine clans, / arrange the human [clans]!

1.1.1.s: iṣamūrjamasmāsu dhattam | prāṇānpaśuṣu | prajāṃ mayi ca yajamāne ca | nirastaḥ śaṇḍaḥ | nirasto markaḥ | apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau sahāmunā | śukrasya samidasi | manthinaḥ samidasi | sa prathamaḥ saṃkṛtirviśvakarmā | sa prathamo mitro varuṇo agniḥ | sa prathamo bṛhaspatiścikitvān | tasmā indrāya sutamājuhomi
1.1.1.d: इषमूर्जमस्मासु धत्तम् । प्राणान्पशुषु । प्रजां मयि च यजमाने च । निरस्तः शण्डः । निरस्तो मर्कः । अपनुत्तौ शण्डामर्कौ सहामुना । शुक्रस्य समिदसि । मन्थिनः समिदसि । स प्रथमः संकृतिर्विश्वकर्मा । स प्रथमो मित्रो वरुणो अग्निः । स प्रथमो बृहस्पतिश्चिकित्वान् । तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतमाजुहोमि
1.1.1.m: Place refreshment and vigor in us, / exhalations in the domestic animals, / offspring in me and in the sacrificer! / Śaṇḍa is cast out! / Marka is cast out! / Śaṇḍa and Marka are driven away along with that [foe]! / You are the kindling stick of the clear soma cup; / you are the kindling stick of the stirred soma cup. / He is the first, the arranger, Viśvakarman; / he is the first, Mitra, Varuṇa, Agni; / he is the first, wise Bṛhaspati; / to that Indra I offer the pressed [soma]!

1.1.2.s: kṛttikāsvagnimādadhīta | etadvā agnernakṣatram | yatkṛttikāḥ | svāyāmevainaṃ devatāyāmādhāya | brahmavarcasī bhavati | mukhaṃ vā etannakṣatrāṇām | yatkṛttikāḥ | yaḥ kṛttikāsvagnimādhatte | mukhya eva bhavati | atho khalu
1.1.2.d: कृत्तिकास्वग्निमादधीत । एतद्वा अग्नेर्नक्षत्रम् । यत्कृत्तिकाः । स्वायामेवैनं देवतायामाधाय । ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति । मुखं वा एतन्नक्षत्राणाम् । यत्कृत्तिकाः । यः कृत्तिकास्वग्निमाधत्ते । मुख्य एव भवति । अथो खलु
1.1.2.m: One should establish the fire under the Kṛttikās. / For this is Agni's lunar mansion, / namely the Kṛttikās. / Having established him in his own deity, / one becomes endowed with spiritual preeminence. / For this is the face of the lunar mansions, / namely the Kṛttikās. / Whoever establishes the fire under the Kṛttikās / becomes foremost indeed. / Now however:

1.1.2.s: agninakṣatramityapacāyanti | gṛhān ha dāhuko bhavati | prajāpatī rohiṇyāmagnimasṛjata | taṃ devā rohiṇyāmādadhata | tato vai te sarvānrohānarohan | tadrohiṇyai rohiṇitvam | yo rohiṇyāmagnimādhatte | ṛdhnotyeva | sarvānrohānrohati | devā vai bhadrāḥ santo'gnimādhithsanta
1.1.2.d: अग्निनक्षत्रमित्यपचायन्ति । गृहान् ह दाहुको भवति । प्रजापती रोहिण्यामग्निमसृजत । तं देवा रोहिण्यामादधत । ततो वै ते सर्वान्रोहानरोहन् । तद्रोहिण्यै रोहिणित्वम् । यो रोहिण्यामग्निमाधत्ते । ऋध्नोत्येव । सर्वान्रोहान्रोहति । देवा वै भद्राः सन्तोऽग्निमाधिथ्सन्त
1.1.2.m: They avoid it, saying, 'It is Agni's lunar mansion, / he will likely be a burner of houses.' / Prajāpati created the fire under Rohiṇī. / The gods established it under Rohiṇī. / From that, indeed, they ascended all ascents. / That is the Rohiṇī-nature of Rohiṇī. / Whoever establishes the fire under Rohiṇī / prospers indeed; / he ascends all ascents. / The gods, while being prosperous, wished to establish the fire.

1.1.2.s: teṣāmanāhito'gnirāsīt | athaibhyo vāmaṃ vasvapākrāmat | te punarvasvorādadhata | tato vai tān vāmaṃ vasūpāvartata | yaḥ purā bhadraḥ sanpāpīyānthsyāt | sa punarvasvoragnimādadhīta | punarevainaṃ vāmaṃ vasūpāvartate | bhadro bhavati | yaḥ kāmayeta dānakāmā me prajāḥ syuriti | sa pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoragnimādadhīta
1.1.2.d: तेषामनाहितोऽग्निरासीत् । अथैभ्यो वामं वस्वपाक्रामत् । ते पुनर्वस्वोरादधत । ततो वै तान् वामं वसूपावर्तत । यः पुरा भद्रः सन्पापीयान्थ्स्यात् । स पुनर्वस्वोरग्निमादधीत । पुनरेवैनं वामं वसूपावर्तते । भद्रो भवति । यः कामयेत दानकामा मे प्रजाः स्युरिति । स पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योरग्निमादधीत
1.1.2.m: Their fire was unestablished. / Then desirable wealth departed from them. / They established it under the Punarvasus. / From that, indeed, desirable wealth returned to them. / Whoever, having formerly been prosperous, becomes worse off, / should establish the fire under the Punarvasus. / Desirable wealth returns to him again; / he becomes prosperous. / Whoever should desire, 'May my offspring be eager to give,' / should establish the fire under the earlier Phalgunīs.

1.1.2.s: aryamṇo vā etannakṣatram | yatpūrve phalgunī | aryameti tamāhuryo dadāti | dānakāmā asmai prajā bhavanti | yaḥ kāmayeta bhagī syāmiti | sa uttarayoḥ phalgunyoragnimādadhīta | bhagasya vā etannakṣatram | yaduttare phalgunī | bhagyeva bhavati | kālakañjā vai nāmāsurā āsan
1.1.2.d: अर्यम्णो वा एतन्नक्षत्रम् । यत्पूर्वे फल्गुनी । अर्यमेति तमाहुर्यो ददाति । दानकामा अस्मै प्रजा भवन्ति । यः कामयेत भगी स्यामिति । स उत्तरयोः फल्गुन्योरग्निमादधीत । भगस्य वा एतन्नक्षत्रम् । यदुत्तरे फल्गुनी । भग्येव भवति । कालकञ्जा वै नामासुरा आसन्
1.1.2.m: For this is Aryaman's lunar mansion, / namely the earlier Phalgunīs. / They call him Aryaman who gives; / his offspring become eager to give. / Whoever should desire, 'May I be fortunate,' / should establish the fire under the later Phalgunīs. / For this is Bhaga's lunar mansion, / namely the later Phalgunīs. / He becomes fortunate indeed. / There were asuras named Kālakañjas.

1.1.2.s: te suvargāya lokāyāgnimacinvata | puruṣa iṣṭakāmupādadhātpuruṣa iṣṭakām | sa indro brāhmaṇo bruvāṇa iṣṭakāmupādhatta | eṣā me citrā nāmeti | te suvargaṃ lokamāprārohan | sa indra iṣṭakāmāvṛhat | te'vākīryanta | ye'vākīryanta | ta ūrṇāvabhayo'bhavan | dvāvudapatatām
1.1.2.d: ते सुवर्गाय लोकायाग्निमचिन्वत । पुरुष इष्टकामुपादधात्पुरुष इष्टकाम् । स इन्द्रो ब्राह्मणो ब्रुवाण इष्टकामुपाधत्त । एषा मे चित्रा नामेति । ते सुवर्गं लोकमाप्रारोहन् । स इन्द्र इष्टकामावृहत् । तेऽवाकीर्यन्त । येऽवाकीर्यन्त । त ऊर्णावभयोऽभवन् । द्वावुदपतताम्
1.1.2.m: They piled a fire for the heavenly realm. / Man by man, [each] placed a brick; man by man, [each] placed a brick. / That Indra, calling himself a Brahmin, placed a brick: / 'This is mine, named Citrā.' / They climbed up toward the heavenly realm. / That Indra pulled out the brick. / They were scattered down. / Those who were scattered down / became spiders. / Two flew up.

1.1.2.s: tau divyau śvānāvabhavatām | yo bhrātṛvyavānthsyāt | sa citrāyāmagnimādadhīta | avakīryaiva bhrātṛvyān | ojo balamindriyaṃ vīryamātmandhatte | vasantā brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta | vasanto vai brāhmaṇasyartuḥ | sva evainamṛtāvādhāya | brahmavarcasī bhavati | mukhaṃ vā etadṛtūnām
1.1.2.d: तौ दिव्यौ श्वानावभवताम् । यो भ्रातृव्यवान्थ्स्यात् । स चित्रायामग्निमादधीत । अवकीर्यैव भ्रातृव्यान् । ओजो बलमिन्द्रियं वीर्यमात्मन्धत्ते । वसन्ता ब्राह्मणोऽग्निमादधीत । वसन्तो वै ब्राह्मणस्यर्तुः । स्व एवैनमृतावाधाय । ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति । मुखं वा एतदृतूनाम्
1.1.2.m: They became the two heavenly dogs. / Whoever has a rival / should establish the fire under Citrā. / Having scattered his rivals, / he places splendorous might, physical strength, sensory power, and heroic power into himself. / A Brahmin should establish the fire in the spring. / Spring is the Brahmin's season. / Having established him in his own season, / he becomes endowed with spiritual preeminence. / For this is the face of the seasons,

1.1.2.s: yadvasantaḥ | yo vasantā'gnimādhatte | mukhya eva bhavati | atho yonimantamevainaṃ prajātamādhatte | grīṣme rājanya ādadhīta | grīṣmo vai rājanyasyartuḥ | sva evainamṛtāvādhāya | indriyāvī bhavati | śaradi vaiśya ādadhīta | śaradvai vaiśyasyartuḥ
1.1.2.d: यद्वसन्तः । यो वसन्ताऽग्निमाधत्ते । मुख्य एव भवति । अथो योनिमन्तमेवैनं प्रजातमाधत्ते । ग्रीष्मे राजन्य आदधीत । ग्रीष्मो वै राजन्यस्यर्तुः । स्व एवैनमृतावाधाय । इन्द्रियावी भवति । शरदि वैश्य आदधीत । शरद्वै वैश्यस्यर्तुः
1.1.2.m:
namely spring. / Whoever establishes the fire in spring / becomes foremost indeed. / Moreover, he establishes him born from his own womb. / A Rājanya should establish [the fire] in summer. / Summer is the Rājanya's season. / Having established him in his own season, / he becomes endowed with sensory power. / A Vaiśya should establish [the fire] in autumn. / Autumn is the Vaiśya's season.

Having established him in his own season, / he becomes rich in domestic animals. / One should not establish the fire under the earlier Phalgunīs. / For this is the last night of the year, / namely the earlier Phalgunīs. / Having established the fire at the rear of the year, / he becomes worse off. / One should establish it under the later [Phalgunīs]. / For this is the first night of the year, / namely the later Phalgunīs. / Having established the fire at the front of the year, / he becomes better off. / Now however: / whenever sacrifice falls to his lot, / then he should establish it. / That itself is his success.

1.1.2.s: sva evenamṛtāvādhāya | paśumānbhavati | na pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoragnimādadhīta | eṣā vai jaghanyā rātriḥ saṃvathsarasya | yatpūrve phalgunī | pṛṣṭita eva saṃvathsarasyāgnimādhāya | pāpīyānbhavati | uttarayorādadhīta | eṣā vai prathamā rātriḥ saṃvathsarasya | yaduttare phalgunī | mukhata eva saṃvathsarasyāgnimādhāya | vasīyānbhavati | atho khalu | yadaivainaṃ yajña upanamet | athādadhīta | saivāsyarddhiḥ
1.1.2.d: स्व एवेनमृतावाधाय । पशुमान्भवति । न पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योरग्निमादधीत । एषा वै जघन्या रात्रिः संवथ्सरस्य । यत्पूर्वे फल्गुनी । पृष्टित एव संवथ्सरस्याग्निमाधाय । पापीयान्भवति । उत्तरयोरादधीत । एषा वै प्रथमा रात्रिः संवथ्सरस्य । यदुत्तरे फल्गुनी । मुखत एव संवथ्सरस्याग्निमाधाय । वसीयान्भवति । अथो खलु । यदैवैनं यज्ञ उपनमेत् । अथादधीत । सैवास्यर्द्धिः

1.1.3.s: uddhanti | yadevāsyā amedhyam | tadapa hanti | apo'vokṣati śāntyai | sikatā nivapati | etadvā agnervaiśvānarasya rūpam | rūpeṇaiva vaiśvānaramavarundhe | ūṣānnivapati | puṣṭirvā eṣā prajananam | yadūṣāḥ
1.1.3.d: उद्धन्ति । यदेवास्या अमेध्यम् । तदप हन्ति । अपोऽवोक्षति शान्त्यै । सिकता निवपति । एतद्वा अग्नेर्वैश्वानरस्य रूपम् । रूपेणैव वैश्वानरमवरुन्धे । ऊषान्निवपति । पुष्टिर्वा एषा प्रजननम् । यदूषाः
1.1.3.m: He digs up [the ground]. / Whatever is impure in it, / that he strikes away. / He sprinkles water on it for appeasement. / He scatters sand. / For this is the form of Agni Vaiśvānara; / through its form, he secures Vaiśvānara. / He scatters saline earth. / For this is nourishment, procreation, / namely saline earth.

1.1.3.s: puṣṭyāmeva prajanane'gnimādhatte | atho saṃjñāna eva | saṃjñānagg hyetatpaśūnām | yadūṣāḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī sahāstām | te viyatī abrūtām | astveva nau saha yajñiyamiti | yadamuṣyā yajñiyamāsīt | tadasyāmadadhāt | ta ūṣā abhavan
1.1.3.d: पुष्ट्यामेव प्रजननेऽग्निमाधत्ते । अथो संज्ञान एव । संज्ञानग्ग् ह्येतत्पशूनाम् । यदूषाः । द्यावापृथिवी सहास्ताम् । ते वियती अब्रूताम् । अस्त्वेव नौ सह यज्ञियमिति । यदमुष्या यज्ञियमासीत् । तदस्यामदधात् । त ऊषा अभवन्
1.1.3.m: In nourishment indeed, in procreation, he establishes the fire. / And also in recognition indeed; / for this is the recognition of animals, / namely saline soil. / Heaven and earth were together. / As they were separating, they said: / 'Let there indeed be between us what is fit for sacrifice.' / What was fit for sacrifice in that [heaven], / that it deposited in this [earth]. / That became saline soil.

1.1.3.s: yadasyā yajñiyamāsīt | tadamuṣyāmadadhāt | tadadaścandramasi kṛṣṇam | ūṣānnivapannado dhyāyet | dyāvāpṛthivyoreva yajñiye'gnimādhatte | agnirdevebhyo nilāyata | ākhū rūpaṃ kṛtvā | sa pṛthivīṃ prāviśat | sa ūtīḥ kurvāṇaḥ pṛthivīmanu samacarat | tadākhukarīṣamabhavat
1.1.3.d: यदस्या यज्ञियमासीत् । तदमुष्यामदधात् । तददश्चन्द्रमसि कृष्णम् । ऊषान्निवपन्नदो ध्यायेत् । द्यावापृथिव्योरेव यज्ञियेऽग्निमाधत्ते । अग्निर्देवेभ्यो निलायत । आखू रूपं कृत्वा । स पृथिवीं प्राविशत् । स ऊतीः कुर्वाणः पृथिवीमनु समचरत् । तदाखुकरीषमभवत्
1.1.3.m: What was fit for sacrifice in this [earth], / that it deposited in that [heaven]. / That is that black [mark] in the moon. / Pouring down the saline soil, he should meditate on that [mark]. / Indeed in what is fit for sacrifice of heaven and earth he establishes the fire. / Agni hid himself from the gods; / having assumed the form of a rat, / he entered the earth. / Making burrowings, he moved along the earth; / that became rat-earth.

1.1.3.s: yadākhukarīṣaṃ saṃbhāro bhavati | yadevāsya tatra nyaktam | tadevāvarundhe | ūrjaṃ vā etaṃ rasaṃ pṛthivyā upadīkā uddihanti | yadvalmīkam | yadvalmīkavapā saṃbhāro bhavati | ūrjameva rasaṃ pṛthivyā avarundhe | atho śrotrameva | śrotragg hyetatpṛthivyāḥ | yadvalmīkaḥ
1.1.3.d: यदाखुकरीषं संभारो भवति । यदेवास्य तत्र न्यक्तम् । तदेवावरुन्धे । ऊर्जं वा एतं रसं पृथिव्या उपदीका उद्दिहन्ति । यद्वल्मीकम् । यद्वल्मीकवपा संभारो भवति । ऊर्जमेव रसं पृथिव्या अवरुन्धे । अथो श्रोत्रमेव । श्रोत्रग्ग् ह्येतत्पृथिव्याः । यद्वल्मीकः
1.1.3.m: When rat-earth becomes a material [for the altar], / whatever of him was left behind there, / that indeed he obtains. / This vigor, this sap of the earth, the subterranean termites mound up, / which is the anthill. / When the core of an anthill becomes a material, / the vigor indeed, the sap of the earth he obtains. / And also the ear indeed; / for this is the ear of the earth, / namely the anthill.

1.1.3.s: abadhiro bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāsāmannamupākṣīyata | tābhyaḥ sūdamupa prābhinat | tato vai tāsāmannaṃ nākṣīyata | yasya sūdaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | nāsya gṛhe'nnaṃ kṣīyate | āpo vā idamagre salilamāsīt | tena prajāpatiraśrāmyat
1.1.3.d: अबधिरो भवति । य एवं वेद । प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । तासामन्नमुपाक्षीयत । ताभ्यः सूदमुप प्राभिनत् । ततो वै तासामन्नं नाक्षीयत । यस्य सूदः संभारो भवति । नास्य गृहेऽन्नं क्षीयते । आपो वा इदमग्रे सलिलमासीत् । तेन प्रजापतिरश्राम्यत्
1.1.3.m: He does not become deaf / who knows thus. / Prajāpati created creatures; / their food was exhausted. / For them he tapped a water-basin; / thence indeed their food was not exhausted. / He for whom [soil from] a water-basin becomes a material, / food is not exhausted in his house. / Waters, indeed, were this [universe] in the beginning, a flood. / Thereat Prajāpati toiled:

1.1.3.s: kathamidaṃ syāditi | so'paśyatpuṣkaraparṇaṃ tiṣṭhat | so'manyata | asti vai tat | yasminnidamadhitiṣṭhatīti | sa varāho rūpaṃ kṛtvopa nyamajjat | sa pṛthivīmadha ārcchat | tasyā upahatyodamajjat | tatpuṣkaraparṇe'prathayat | yadaprathayat
1.1.3.d: कथमिदं स्यादिति । सोऽपश्यत्पुष्करपर्णं तिष्ठत् । सोऽमन्यत । अस्ति वै तत् । यस्मिन्निदमधितिष्ठतीति । स वराहो रूपं कृत्वोप न्यमज्जत् । स पृथिवीमध आर्च्छत् । तस्या उपहत्योदमज्जत् । तत्पुष्करपर्णेऽप्रथयत् । यदप्रथयत्
1.1.3.m: 'How could this [earth] come to be?' / He saw a lotus leaf standing. / He thought: / 'Surely there is that / upon which this stands.' / Having assumed the form of a boar, he dived down; / he reached the earth below. / Striking off a piece of it, he dived up; / he spread it out on the lotus leaf. / In that he spread it out (aprathayat),

1.1.3.s: tatpṛthivyai pṛthivitvam | abhūdvā idamiti | tadbhūmyai bhūmitvam | tāṃ diśo'nu vātaḥ samavahat | tāṃ śarkarābhiradṛṃhat | śaṃ vai no'bhūditi | taccharkarāṇāṃ śarkaratvam | yadvarāhavihataṃ saṃbhāro bhavati | asyāmevāchambaṭkāramagnimādhatte | śarkarā bhavanti dhṛtyai
1.1.3.d: तत्पृथिव्यै पृथिवित्वम् । अभूद्वा इदमिति । तद्भूम्यै भूमित्वम् । तां दिशोऽनु वातः समवहत् । तां शर्कराभिरदृंहत् । शं वै नोऽभूदिति । तच्छर्कराणां शर्करत्वम् । यद्वराहविहतं संभारो भवति । अस्यामेवाछम्बट्कारमग्निमाधत्ते । शर्करा भवन्ति धृत्यै
1.1.3.m: that is the earth's nature as earth (pṛthivī). / 'This has indeed come into being (abhūt)!' [he thought]; / that is the ground's nature as ground (bhūmi). / Along the directions the wind carried it together; / he made it firm with pebbles. / 'It has indeed become auspicious (śam) for us,' [they said]; / that is the pebbles' nature as pebbles (śarkarā). / When earth dug up by a boar becomes a material, / upon this [earth] indeed, without failure, he establishes the fire. / The pebbles are for firmness,

1.1.3.s: atho śaṃtvāya | saretā agnirādheya ityāhuḥ | āpo varuṇasya patnaya āsan | tā agnirabhyadhyāyat | tāḥ samabhavat | tasya retaḥ parā'patat | taddhiraṇyamabhavat | yaddhiraṇyamupāsyati | saretasamevāgnimādhatte | puruṣa innvai svādretaso bībhathsata ityāhuḥ
1.1.3.d: अथो शंत्वाय । सरेता अग्निराधेय इत्याहुः । आपो वरुणस्य पत्नय आसन् । ता अग्निरभ्यध्यायत् । ताः समभवत् । तस्य रेतः पराऽपतत् । तद्धिरण्यमभवत् । यद्धिरण्यमुपास्यति । सरेतसमेवाग्निमाधत्ते । पुरुष इन्न्वै स्वाद्रेतसो बीभथ्सत इत्याहुः
1.1.3.m: and also for well-being. / 'Agni is to be established with semen,' they say. / The waters were the wives of Varuṇa; / after them Agni lusted; / they united. / His semen fell away; / that became gold. / When he throws down gold, / with semen indeed he establishes Agni. / 'A man surely shrinks from his own semen,' they say;

1.1.3.s: uttarata upāsyatyabībhathsāyai | ati prayacchati | ārtimevātiprayacchati | agnirdevebhyo nilāyata | aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | so'śvatthe saṃvathsaramatiṣṭhat | tadaśvatthasyāśvatthatvam | yadāśvatthaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | yadevāsya tatra nyaktam | tadevāvarundhe
1.1.3.d: उत्तरत उपास्यत्यबीभथ्सायै । अति प्रयच्छति । आर्तिमेवातिप्रयच्छति । अग्निर्देवेभ्यो निलायत । अश्वो रूपं कृत्वा । सोऽश्वत्थे संवथ्सरमतिष्ठत् । तदश्वत्थस्याश्वत्थत्वम् । यदाश्वत्थः संभारो भवति । यदेवास्य तत्र न्यक्तम् । तदेवावरुन्धे
1.1.3.m: he throws it down towards the north to prevent shrinking. / He hands it over; / distress indeed he hands over. / Agni hid himself from the gods; / having assumed the form of a horse, / he stood for a year in an aśvattha tree. / That is the aśvattha tree's nature as an aśvattha. / When [wood] from an aśvattha tree becomes a material, / whatever of him was left behind there, / that indeed he obtains.

1.1.3.s: devā vā ūrjaṃ vyabhajanta | tata udumbara udatiṣṭhat | ūrgvā udumbaraḥ | yadaudumbaraḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | ūrjamevāvarundhe | tṛtīyasyāmito divi soma āsīt | taṃ gāyatryāharat | tasya parṇamacchidyata | tatparṇo'bhavat | tatparṇasya parṇatvam
1.1.3.d: देवा वा ऊर्जं व्यभजन्त । तत उदुम्बर उदतिष्ठत् । ऊर्ग्वा उदुम्बरः । यदौदुम्बरः संभारो भवति । ऊर्जमेवावरुन्धे । तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि सोम आसीत् । तं गायत्र्याहरत् । तस्य पर्णमच्छिद्यत । तत्पर्णोऽभवत् । तत्पर्णस्य पर्णत्वम्
1.1.3.m: The gods divided vigor among themselves; / thence the udumbara tree arose. / The udumbara tree is vigor. / When [wood] from an udumbara tree becomes a material, / vigor indeed he obtains. / In the third heaven from here was Soma; / Gāyatrī brought it down. / A leaf of it was cut off; / that became the parṇa tree. / That is the parṇa tree's nature as parṇa.

1.1.3.s: yasya parṇamayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | somapīthamevāvarundhe | devā vai brahmannavadanta | tatparṇa upāśṛṇot | suśravā vai nāma | yatparṇamayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | prajāpatiragnimasṛjata | so'bibhetpra mā dhakṣyatīti | taṃ śamyā'śamayat
1.1.3.d: यस्य पर्णमयः संभारो भवति । सोमपीथमेवावरुन्धे । देवा वै ब्रह्मन्नवदन्त । तत्पर्ण उपाशृणोत् । सुश्रवा वै नाम । यत्पर्णमयः संभारो भवति । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । प्रजापतिरग्निमसृजत । सोऽबिभेत्प्र मा धक्ष्यतीति । तं शम्याऽशमयत्
1.1.3.m: He for whom [wood] consisting of parṇa becomes a material / obtains the drinking of Soma. / The gods spoke concerning the sacred word; / the parṇa tree listened to that; / Suśravas ('fine hearing') indeed is its name. / When [wood] consisting of parṇa becomes a material, / spiritual preeminence indeed he obtains. / Prajāpati created Agni. / He feared: 'He will burn me up.' / Him he appeased (aśamayat) with the śamī tree.

1.1.3.s: tacchamyai śamitvam | yacchamīmayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | śāntyā apradāhāya | agneḥ sṛṣṭasya yataḥ | vikaṅkataṃ bhā ārcchat | yadvaikaṅkataḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | bhā evāvarundhe | sahṛdayo'gnirādheya ityāhuḥ | maruto'dbhiragnimatamayan | tasya tāntasya hṛdayamācchindan | sā'śanirabhavat | yadaśanihatasya vṛkṣasya saṃbhāro bhavati | sahṛdayamevāgnimādhatte
1.1.3.d: तच्छम्यै शमित्वम् । यच्छमीमयः संभारो भवति । शान्त्या अप्रदाहाय । अग्नेः सृष्टस्य यतः । विकङ्कतं भा आर्च्छत् । यद्वैकङ्कतः संभारो भवति । भा एवावरुन्धे । सहृदयोऽग्निराधेय इत्याहुः । मरुतोऽद्भिरग्निमतमयन् । तस्य तान्तस्य हृदयमाच्छिन्दन् । साऽशनिरभवत् । यदशनिहतस्य वृक्षस्य संभारो भवति । सहृदयमेवाग्निमाधत्ते
1.1.3.m: That is the śamī tree's nature as śamī. / When [wood] consisting of śamī becomes a material, / [it is] for appeasement, for non-burning. / From Agni when created, as he went forth, / radiance reached the vikaṅkata tree. / When [wood] from the vikaṅkata becomes a material, / radiance indeed he obtains. / 'Agni is to be established with a heart,' they say. / The Maruts choked Agni with waters; / they cut out the heart of him when choked. / That became the lightning bolt. / When [wood] of a tree struck by lightning becomes a material, / with a heart indeed he establishes Agni.

1.1.4.s: dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣvagnimādadhīta | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsarādevainamavarudhyādhatte | yaddvādaśasu vikrāmeṣvādadhīta | parimitamavarundhīta | cakṣurnimita ādadhīta | iyaddvādaśavikrāmā iti | parimitaṃ caivāparimitaṃ cāvarundhe | anṛtaṃ vai vācā vadati | anṛtaṃ manasā dhyāyati
1.1.4.d: द्वादशसु विक्रामेष्वग्निमादधीत । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सरादेवैनमवरुध्याधत्ते । यद्द्वादशसु विक्रामेष्वादधीत । परिमितमवरुन्धीत । चक्षुर्निमित आदधीत । इयद्द्वादशविक्रामा इति । परिमितं चैवापरिमितं चावरुन्धे । अनृतं वै वाचा वदति । अनृतं मनसा ध्यायति
1.1.4.m: At twelve paces he should establish the fire; / twelve months are the year. / Obtaining him from the year itself, he establishes [him]. / If he should establish [him] at twelve paces, / he would obtain what is measured. / He should establish [him] within sight: / 'Is this [distance] twelve paces?' / Both the measured and the unmeasured he obtains. / Untruth indeed one speaks with speech; / untruth one contemplates with the mind.

1.1.4.s: cakṣurvai satyam | adrāgityāha | adarśamiti | tathsatyam | yaścakṣurnimite'gnimādhatte | satya evainamādhatte | tasmādāhitāgnirnānṛtaṃ vadet | nāsya brāhmaṇo'nāśvāngṛhe vaset | satye hyasyāgnirāhitaḥ | āgneyī vai rātriḥ
1.1.4.d: चक्षुर्वै सत्यम् । अद्रागित्याह । अदर्शमिति । तथ्सत्यम् । यश्चक्षुर्निमितेऽग्निमाधत्ते । सत्य एवैनमाधत्ते । तस्मादाहिताग्निर्नानृतं वदेत् । नास्य ब्राह्मणोऽनाश्वान्गृहे वसेत् । सत्ये ह्यस्याग्निराहितः । आग्नेयी वै रात्रिः
1.1.4.m: The eye indeed is truth. / 'Did you see?' one asks; / 'I saw,' [one answers]; / that is truth. / He who establishes the fire within sight / establishes it in truth indeed. / Therefore one who has established the fires must not speak untruth; / no Brahmin should stay in his house having not eaten; / for in truth his fire has been established. / Nocturnal indeed is night;

1.1.4.s: āgneyāḥ paśavaḥ | aindramahaḥ | naktaṃ gārhapatyamādadhāti | paśūnevāvarundhe | divā''havanīyam | indriyamevāvarundhe | ardhodite sūrya āhavanīyamādadhāti | etasminvai loke prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | prajā eva tadyajamānaḥ sṛjate | atho bhūtaṃ caiva bhaviṣyaccāvarundhe
1.1.4.d: आग्नेयाः पशवः । ऐन्द्रमहः । नक्तं गार्हपत्यमादधाति । पशूनेवावरुन्धे । दिवा'ऽहवनीयम् । इन्द्रियमेवावरुन्धे । अर्धोदिते सूर्य आहवनीयमादधाति । एतस्मिन्वै लोके प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । प्रजा एव तद्यजमानः सृजते । अथो भूतं चैव भविष्यच्चावरुन्धे
1.1.4.m: connected with Agni are animals; / connected with Indra is the day. / At night he establishes the Gārhapatya fire; / animals indeed he obtains. / By day the Āhavanīya fire; / power of the senses indeed he obtains. / When the sun is half-risen, he establishes the Āhavanīya fire; / in this world indeed Prajāpati created creatures; / creatures indeed the sacrificer then creates; / and also both what has been and what shall be he obtains.

1.1.4.s: iḍā vai mānavī yajñānūkāśinyāsīt | sā'śṛṇot | asurā agnimādadhata iti | tadagacchat | ta āhavanīyamagra ādadhata | atha gārhapatyam | athānvāhāryapacanam | sā'bravīt | pratīcyeṣāg śrīragāt | bhadrā bhūtvā parābhaviṣyantīti
1.1.4.d: इडा वै मानवी यज्ञानूकाशिन्यासीत् । साऽशृणोत् । असुरा अग्निमादधत इति । तदगच्छत् । त आहवनीयमग्र आदधत । अथ गार्हपत्यम् । अथान्वाहार्यपचनम् । साऽब्रवीत् । प्रतीच्येषाग् श्रीरगात् । भद्रा भूत्वा पराभविष्यन्तीति
1.1.4.m: Iḍā, daughter of Manu, was an overseer of the sacrifice. / She heard: / 'The asuras are establishing the fire.' / She went thither. / They established the Āhavanīya first, / then the Gārhapatya, / then the Anvāhāryapacana. / She said: / 'Backward has gone their fortune; / having prospered, they will perish.'

1.1.4.s: yasyaivamagnirādhīyate | pratīcyasya śrīreti | bhadro bhūtvā parābhavati | sā'śṛṇot | devā agnimādadhata iti | tadagacchat | te'nvāhāryapacanamagra ādadhata | atha gārhapatyam | athāhavanīyam | sā'bravīt
1.1.4.d: यस्यैवमग्निराधीयते । प्रतीच्यस्य श्रीरेति । भद्रो भूत्वा पराभवति । साऽशृणोत् । देवा अग्निमादधत इति । तदगच्छत् । तेऽन्वाहार्यपचनमग्र आदधत । अथ गार्हपत्यम् । अथाहवनीयम् । साऽब्रवीत्
1.1.4.m: He whose fire is thus established, / backward goes his fortune; / having prospered, he perishes. / She heard: / 'The gods are establishing the fire.' / She went thither. / They established the Anvāhāryapacana first, / then the Gārhapatya, / then the Āhavanīya. / She said:

1.1.4.s: prācyeṣāg śrīragāt | bhadrā bhūtvā suvargaṃ lokameṣyanti | prajāṃ tu na vethsyanta iti | yasyaivamagnirādhīyate | prācyasya śrīreti | bhadro bhūtvā suvargaṃ lokameti | prajāṃ tu na vindate | sā'bravīdiḍā manum | tathā vā ahaṃ tavāgnimādhāsyāmi | yathā pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjaniṣyase
1.1.4.d: प्राच्येषाग् श्रीरगात् । भद्रा भूत्वा सुवर्गं लोकमेष्यन्ति । प्रजां तु न वेथ्स्यन्त इति । यस्यैवमग्निराधीयते । प्राच्यस्य श्रीरेति । भद्रो भूत्वा सुवर्गं लोकमेति । प्रजां तु न विन्दते । साऽब्रवीदिडा मनुम् । तथा वा अहं तवाग्निमाधास्यामि । यथा प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जनिष्यसे
1.1.4.m: "Their fortune has gone eastward; having become auspicious, they will go to the heavenly realm, but they will not find offspring." For whomever the fire is established in this way, his fortune goes eastward; having become auspicious, he goes to the heavenly realm, but he does not obtain offspring. Iḍā said to Manu: "In such a manner indeed will I establish your fire that you will be born forth with offspring and domestic animals in pairs,

1.1.4.s: pratyasminloke sthāsyasi | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jeṣyasīti | gārhapatyamagra ādadhāt | gārhapatyaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante | gārhapatyenaivāsmai prajāṃ paśūnprājanayat | athānvāhāryapacanam | tiryaṅṅiva vā ayaṃ lokaḥ | asminneva tena loke pratyatiṣṭhat | athāhavanīyam | tenaiva suvargaṃ lokamabhyajayat
1.1.4.d: प्रत्यस्मिन्लोके स्थास्यसि । अभि सुवर्गं लोकं जेष्यसीति । गार्हपत्यमग्र आदधात् । गार्हपत्यं वा अनु प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते । गार्हपत्येनैवास्मै प्रजां पशून्प्राजनयत् । अथान्वाहार्यपचनम् । तिर्यङ्ङिव वा अयं लोकः । अस्मिन्नेव तेन लोके प्रत्यतिष्ठत् । अथाहवनीयम् । तेनैव सुवर्गं लोकमभ्यजयत्
1.1.4.m: you will stand firm in this world, [and] you will conquer the heavenly realm." She established the Gārhapatya first. Following the Gārhapatya, offspring and domestic animals are born; by means of the Gārhapatya she generated offspring and domestic animals for him. Then [she established] the Anvāhāryapacana. Across, as it were, is this world; in this very world he stood firm through that. Then [she established] the Āhavanīya; through that very fire he conquered the heavenly realm.

1.1.4.s: yasyaivamagnirādhīyate | pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjāyate | pratyasminloke tiṣṭhati | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yasya vā ayathādevatamagnirādhīyate | ā devatābhyo vṛścyate | pāpīyānbhavati | yasya yathādevatam | na devatābhya ā vṛścyate | vasīyānbhavati
1.1.4.d: यस्यैवमग्निराधीयते । प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जायते । प्रत्यस्मिन्लोके तिष्ठति । अभि सुवर्गं लोकं जयति । यस्य वा अयथादेवतमग्निराधीयते । आ देवताभ्यो वृश्च्यते । पापीयान्भवति । यस्य यथादेवतम् । न देवताभ्य आ वृश्च्यते । वसीयान्भवति
1.1.4.m: For whomever the fire is established in this way, he is born forth with offspring and domestic animals in pairs, he stands firm in this world, and he conquers the heavenly realm. For whomever the fire is established not according to the deity, he is cut off from the deities [and] becomes worse off. For whomever it is according to the deity, he is not cut off from the deities [and] becomes better off. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the vow of the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases I establish," one should establish [it] for descendants of the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the vow of the Āditya deities I establish," for other Brahmin descendants. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the vow of King Varuṇa I establish," for a king. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the virility of Indra, by his vow, I establish," for a Rājanya. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the vow of Manu, the village headman, I establish," for a Vaiśya. With "Thee, O lord of vows, by the vow of the Ṛbhu deities I establish," for a chariot-maker. The fire is established according to the deity; he is not cut off from the deities [and] becomes better off.

1.1.4.s: bhṛgūṇāṃ tvā'ṃgirasāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmīti bhṛgvaṃgirasāmādadhyāt | ādityānāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmītyanyāsāṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ prajānām | varuṇasya tvā rājño vratapate vratenādadhāmīti rājñaḥ | indrasya tvendriyeṇa vratapate vratenādadhāmīti rājanyasya | manostvā grāmaṇyo vratapate vratenādadhāmīti vaiśyasya | ṛbhūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmīti rathakārasya | yathādevatamagnirādhīyate | na devatābhya ā vṛścyate | vasīyānbhavati
1.1.4.d: भृगूणां त्वाऽंगिरसां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति भृग्वंगिरसामादध्यात् । आदित्यानां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीत्यन्यासां ब्राह्मणीनां प्रजानाम् । वरुणस्य त्वा राज्ञो व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति राज्ञः । इन्द्रस्य त्वेन्द्रियेण व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति राजन्यस्य । मनोस्त्वा ग्रामण्यो व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति वैश्यस्य । ऋभूणां त्वा देवानां व्रतपते व्रतेनादधामीति रथकारस्य । यथादेवतमग्निराधीयते । न देवताभ्य आ वृश्च्यते । वसीयान्भवति

1.1.5.s: prajāpatirvācaḥ satyamapaśyat | tenāgnimādhatta | tena vai sa ārdhnot | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityāha | etadvai vācaḥ satyam | ya etenāgnimādhatte | ṛdhnotyeva | atho satyaprāśūreva bhavati | atho ya evaṃ vidvānabhicarati | stṛṇuta evainam
1.1.5.d: प्रजापतिर्वाचः सत्यमपश्यत् । तेनाग्निमाधत्त । तेन वै स आर्ध्नोत् । भूर्भुवः सुवरित्याह । एतद्वै वाचः सत्यम् । य एतेनाग्निमाधत्ते । ऋध्नोत्येव । अथो सत्यप्राशूरेव भवति । अथो य एवं विद्वानभिचरति । स्तृणुत एवैनम्
1.1.5.m: Prajāpati saw the truth of speech. With it he established the fire; by it he indeed prospered. He says: "Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ." This indeed is the truth of speech. Whoever establishes the fire with this prospers indeed. Moreover, he becomes one whose prayer is true. Moreover, if one who knows thus practices sorcery against [an enemy], he overthrows him indeed.

1.1.5.s: bhūrityāha | prajā eva tadyajamānaḥ sṛjate | bhuva ityāha | asminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | suvarityāha | suvarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | tribhirakṣarairgārhapatyamādadhāti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣvevainaṃ lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | sarvaiḥ pañcabhirāhavanīyam
1.1.5.d: भूरित्याह । प्रजा एव तद्यजमानः सृजते । भुव इत्याह । अस्मिन्नेव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । सुवरित्याह । सुवर्ग एव लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । त्रिभिरक्षरैर्गार्हपत्यमादधाति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एष्वेवैनं लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । सर्वैः पञ्चभिराहवनीयम्
1.1.5.m: He says: "Bhūḥ." Thereby the sacrificer creates offspring. He says: "Bhuvaḥ." In this very world he stands firm. He says: "Suvaḥ." In the heavenly realm he stands firm. With three syllables he establishes the Gārhapatya. Three are these worlds; established in these very worlds he establishes it. With all five [syllables he establishes] the Āhavanīya.

1.1.5.s: suvargāya vā eṣa lokāyādhīyate | yadāhavanīyaḥ | suvarga evāsmai loke vācaḥ satyaṃ sarvamāpnoti | tribhirgārhapatyamādadhāti | pañcabhirāhavanīyam | aṣṭau saṃpadyante | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatro'gniḥ | yāvānevāgniḥ | tamādhatte
1.1.5.d: सुवर्गाय वा एष लोकायाधीयते । यदाहवनीयः । सुवर्ग एवास्मै लोके वाचः सत्यं सर्वमाप्नोति । त्रिभिर्गार्हपत्यमादधाति । पञ्चभिराहवनीयम् । अष्टौ संपद्यन्ते । अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री । गायत्रोऽग्निः । यावानेवाग्निः । तमाधत्ते
1.1.5.m: For the heavenly realm indeed is this established, namely the Āhavanīya. In the heavenly realm he obtains all the truth of speech. With three [syllables] he establishes the Gārhapatya, with five the Āhavanīya; they amount to eight. The Gāyatrī has eight syllables; Agni belongs to the Gāyatrī. As great as Agni is, so great he establishes him.

1.1.5.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā asmāthsṛṣṭāḥ parācīrāyann | tābhyo jyotirudagṛhṇāt | taṃ jyotiḥ paśyantīḥ prajā abhisamāvartanta | uparīvāgnimudgṛhṇīyāduddharann | jyotireva paśyantīḥ prajā yajamānamabhisamāvartante | prajāpaterakṣyaśvayat | tatparā'patat | tadaśvo'bhavat | tadaśvasyāśvatvam
1.1.5.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ता अस्माथ्सृष्टाः पराचीरायन्न् । ताभ्यो ज्योतिरुदगृह्णात् । तं ज्योतिः पश्यन्तीः प्रजा अभिसमावर्तन्त । उपरीवाग्निमुद्गृह्णीयादुद्धरन्न् । ज्योतिरेव पश्यन्तीः प्रजा यजमानमभिसमावर्तन्ते । प्रजापतेरक्ष्यश्वयत् । तत्पराऽपतत् । तदश्वोऽभवत् । तदश्वस्याश्वत्वम्
1.1.5.m: Prajāpati created offspring. Having been created, they went away from him. For them he held up a light. Seeing that light, the offspring turned back toward him. When taking out [the fire], he should hold the fire high up, as it were. Seeing the light, the offspring turn back toward the sacrificer. Prajāpati's eye swelled; it fell away. It became a horse. That is the horsehood of the horse.

1.1.5.s: eṣa vai prajāpatiḥ | yadagniḥ | prājāpatyo'śvaḥ | yadaśvaṃ purastānnayati | svameva cakṣuḥ paśyanprajāpatiranūdeti | vajrī vā eṣaḥ | yadaśvaḥ | yadaśvaṃ purastānnayati | jātāneva bhrātṛvyānpraṇudate | punarāvartayati
1.1.5.d: एष वै प्रजापतिः । यदग्निः । प्राजापत्योऽश्वः । यदश्वं पुरस्तान्नयति । स्वमेव चक्षुः पश्यन्प्रजापतिरनूदेति । वज्री वा एषः । यदश्वः । यदश्वं पुरस्तान्नयति । जातानेव भ्रातृव्यान्प्रणुदते । पुनरावर्तयति
1.1.5.m: This is Prajāpati, namely Agni; the horse belongs to Prajāpati. When he leads the horse in front, Prajāpati rises up behind, beholding his own eye. Possessed of the vajra indeed is this one, namely the horse. When he leads the horse in front, he thrusts away born rivals. He turns [him] back;

1.1.5.s: janiṣyamāṇāneva pratinudate | nyāhavanīyo gārhapatyamakāmayata | ni gārhapatya āhavanīyam | tau vibhājaṃ nāśaknot | so'śvaḥ pūrvavāḍbhūtvā | prāñcaṃ pūrvamudavahat | tatpūrvavāhaḥ pūrvavāṭtvam | yadaśvaṃ purastānnayati | vibhaktirevainayoḥ sā | atho nānāvīryāvevainau kurute
1.1.5.d: जनिष्यमाणानेव प्रतिनुदते । न्याहवनीयो गार्हपत्यमकामयत । नि गार्हपत्य आहवनीयम् । तौ विभाजं नाशक्नोत् । सोऽश्वः पूर्ववाड्भूत्वा । प्राञ्चं पूर्वमुदवहत् । तत्पूर्ववाहः पूर्ववाट्त्वम् । यदश्वं पुरस्तान्नयति । विभक्तिरेवैनयोः सा । अथो नानावीर्यावेवैनौ कुरुते
1.1.5.m: he thrusts back those who are yet to be born. The Āhavanīya desired the Gārhapatya; the Gārhapatya [desired] the Āhavanīya. He was not able to separate them. That horse, having become a leader-horse, carried the ancient [fire] toward the east. That is the nature of a leader-horse as a leader-horse. When he leads the horse in front, that is their separation; moreover, he makes the two of different powers.

1.1.5.s: yaduparyupari śiro haret | prāṇān vicchindyāt | adho'dhaḥ śiro harati | prāṇānāṃ gopīthāya | iyatyagre harati | atheyatyatheyati | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣvevainaṃ lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | prajāpatiragnimasṛjata | so'bibhetpra mā dhakṣyatīti
1.1.5.d: यदुपर्युपरि शिरो हरेत् । प्राणान् विच्छिन्द्यात् । अधोऽधः शिरो हरति । प्राणानां गोपीथाय । इयत्यग्रे हरति । अथेयत्यथेयति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एष्वेवैनं लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । प्रजापतिरग्निमसृजत । सोऽबिभेत्प्र मा धक्ष्यतीति
1.1.5.m: If he were to carry [the fire] above the head, he would cut off the vital breaths. He carries it below the head, for the protection of the vital breaths. At first he carries it this [high], then this [high], then this [high]. Three are these worlds; established in these worlds he establishes it. Prajāpati created Agni. He feared: "He will burn me up."

1.1.5.s: tasya tredhā mahimānaṃ vyauhat | śāntyā apradāhāya | yattredhā'gnirādhīyate | mahimānamevāsya tadvyūhati | śāntyā apradāhāya | punarāvartayati | mahimānamevāsya saṃdadhāti | paśurvā eṣaḥ | yadaśvaḥ | eṣa rudraḥ
1.1.5.d: तस्य त्रेधा महिमानं व्यौहत् । शान्त्या अप्रदाहाय । यत्त्रेधाऽग्निराधीयते । महिमानमेवास्य तद्व्यूहति । शान्त्या अप्रदाहाय । पुनरावर्तयति । महिमानमेवास्य संदधाति । पशुर्वा एषः । यदश्वः । एष रुद्रः
1.1.5.m: He distributed his greatness threefold for appeasement, that he might not burn. When the fire is established threefold, he thereby distributes his greatness for appeasement, that he might not burn. He turns [him] back; he thereby restores his greatness. An animal indeed is this one, namely the horse; Rudra is this one,

1.1.5.s: yadagniḥ | yadaśvasya pade'gnimādadhyāt | rudrāya paśūnapidadhyāt | apaśuryajamānaḥ syāt | yannākramayet | anavaruddhā asya paśavaḥ syuḥ | pārśvata ākramayet | yathā''hitasyāgneraṅgārā abhyavavarterann | avaruddhā asya paśavo bhavanti | na rudrāyāpidadhāti
1.1.5.d: यदग्निः । यदश्वस्य पदेऽग्निमादध्यात् । रुद्राय पशूनपिदध्यात् । अपशुर्यजमानः स्यात् । यन्नाक्रमयेत् । अनवरुद्धा अस्य पशवः स्युः । पार्श्वत आक्रमयेत् । यथा'ऽहितस्याग्नेरङ्गारा अभ्यववर्तेरन्न् । अवरुद्धा अस्य पशवो भवन्ति । न रुद्रायापिदधाति
1.1.5.m: namely Agni. If he were to establish the fire in the footprint of the horse, he would consign the domestic animals to Rudra; the sacrificer would be without domestic animals. If he were not to make [him] step, his domestic animals would not be secured. He should make him step to the side, so that the embers of the established fire may roll down toward it. His domestic animals become secured; he does not consign them to Rudra.

1.1.5.s: trīṇi havīṃṣi nirvapati | virāja eva vikrāntaṃ yajamāno'nu vikramate | agnaye pavamānāya | agnaye pāvakāya | agnaye śucaye | yadagnaye pavamānāya nirvapati | punātyevainam | yadagnaye pāvakāya | pūta evāsminnannādyaṃ dadhāti | yadagnaye śucaye | brahmavarcasamevāsminnupariṣṭāddadhāti
1.1.5.d: त्रीणि हवींषि निर्वपति । विराज एव विक्रान्तं यजमानोऽनु विक्रमते । अग्नये पवमानाय । अग्नये पावकाय । अग्नये शुचये । यदग्नये पवमानाय निर्वपति । पुनात्येवैनम् । यदग्नये पावकाय । पूत एवास्मिन्नन्नाद्यं दधाति । यदग्नये शुचये । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवास्मिन्नुपरिष्टाद्दधाति
1.1.5.m: He pours out three sacrificial offerings. The sacrificer strides out along the striding-out of the Virāj: for Agni Pavamāna, for Agni Pāvaka, for Agni Śuci. When he pours out [an offering] for Agni Pavamāna, he purifies him indeed. When for Agni Pāvaka, he puts food into him once purified. When for Agni Śuci, he puts spiritual preeminence into him from above.

1.1.6.s: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsann | te devā vijayamupayantaḥ | agnau vāmaṃ vasu saṃnyadadhata | idamu no bhaviṣyati | yadi no jeṣyantīti | tadagnirnothsahamaśaknot | tattredhā vinyadadhāt | paśuṣu tṛtīyam | apsu tṛtīyam | āditye tṛtīyam
1.1.6.d: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन्न् । ते देवा विजयमुपयन्तः । अग्नौ वामं वसु संन्यदधत । इदमु नो भविष्यति । यदि नो जेष्यन्तीति । तदग्निर्नोथ्सहमशक्नोत् । तत्त्रेधा विन्यदधात् । पशुषु तृतीयम् । अप्सु तृतीयम् । आदित्ये तृतीयम्
1.1.6.m: The gods and the asuras were in conflict. Those gods, about to achieve victory, deposited their dear treasure in Agni: "This shall be ours if they conquer us." Agni was not able to bear it. He distributed it threefold: a third among domestic animals, a third among the waters, [and] a third in the sun.

1.1.6.s: taddevā vijitya | punaravāruruthsanta | te'gnaye pavamānāya puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ niravapan | paśavo vā agniḥ pavamānaḥ | yadeva paśuṣvāsīt | tattenāvārundhata | te'gnaye pāvakāya | āpo vā agniḥ pāvakaḥ | yadevāpsvāsīt | tattenāvārundhata
1.1.6.d: तद्देवा विजित्य । पुनरवारुरुथ्सन्त । तेऽग्नये पवमानाय पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निरवपन् । पशवो वा अग्निः पवमानः । यदेव पशुष्वासीत् । तत्तेनावारुन्धत । तेऽग्नये पावकाय । आपो वा अग्निः पावकः । यदेवाप्स्वासीत् । तत्तेनावारुन्धत
1.1.6.m:
Having conquered, the gods wished to recover it.
They offered an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni Pavamāna.
Agni Pavamāna is domestic animals.
Whatever was in the domestic animals,
that they recovered through that.
They [offered] to Agni Pāvaka.
Agni Pāvaka is the waters.
Whatever was in the waters,
that they recovered through that.

1.1.6.s: te'gnaye śucaye | asau vā ādityo'gniḥ śuciḥ | yadevāditya āsīt | tattenāvārundhata | brahmavādino vadanti | tanuvo vāvaitā agnyādheyasya | āgneyo vā aṣṭākapālo'gnyādheyamiti | yattaṃ nirvapet | naitāni | yathā''tmā syāt
1.1.6.d: तेऽग्नये शुचये । असौ वा आदित्योऽग्निः शुचिः । यदेवादित्य आसीत् । तत्तेनावारुन्धत । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । तनुवो वावैता अग्न्याधेयस्य । आग्नेयो वा अष्टाकपालोऽग्न्याधेयमिति । यत्तं निर्वपेत् । नैतानि । यथा'ऽत्मा स्यात्
1.1.6.m:
They [offered] to Agni Śuci.
Yonder sun is Agni Śuci.
Whatever was in the sun,
that they recovered through that.
The discussers of sacred lore say:
'These are indeed the bodies of the fire establishment;
the eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni is the fire establishment.'
If he should offer that,
and not these,
just as there would be a trunk,

1.1.6.s: nāṅgāni | tādṛgeva tat | yadetāni nirvapet | na tam | yathā'ṅgāni syuḥ | nātmā | tādṛgeva tat | ubhayāni saha nirupyāṇi | yajñasya sātmatvāya | ubhayaṃ vā etasyendriyaṃ vīryamāpyate
1.1.6.d: नाङ्गानि । तादृगेव तत् । यदेतानि निर्वपेत् । न तम् । यथाऽङ्गानि स्युः । नात्मा । तादृगेव तत् । उभयानि सह निरुप्याणि । यज्ञस्य सात्मत्वाय । उभयं वा एतस्येन्द्रियं वीर्यमाप्यते
1.1.6.m:
and not limbs,
such indeed would that be.
If he should offer these,
and not that,
just as there would be limbs,
and not a trunk,
such indeed would that be.
Both are to be offered together,
for the wholeness of the sacrifice.
Both the sensual power and heroic power of him are obtained.

1.1.6.s: yo'gnimādhatte | aindrāgnamekādaśakapālamanunirvapet | ādityaṃ carum | indrāgnī vai devānāmayātayāmānau | ye eva devate ayātayāmnī | tābhyāmevāsmā indriyaṃ vīryamavarundhe | ādityo bhavati | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | dhenvai vā etadretaḥ
1.1.6.d: योऽग्निमाधत्ते । ऐन्द्राग्नमेकादशकपालमनुनिर्वपेत् । आदित्यं चरुम् । इन्द्राग्नी वै देवानामयातयामानौ । ये एव देवते अयातयाम्नी । ताभ्यामेवास्मा इन्द्रियं वीर्यमवरुन्धे । आदित्यो भवति । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । धेन्वै वा एतद्रेतः

1.1.6.s: yadājyam | anaḍuhastaṇḍulāḥ | mithunamevāvarundhe | ghṛte bhavati | yajñasyālūkṣāntatvāya | catvāra ārṣeyāḥ prāśñanti | diśāmeva jyotiṣi juhoti | paśavo vā etāni havīṃṣi | eṣa rudraḥ | yadagniḥ
1.1.6.d: यदाज्यम् । अनडुहस्तण्डुलाः । मिथुनमेवावरुन्धे । घृते भवति । यज्ञस्यालूक्षान्तत्वाय । चत्वार आर्षेयाः प्राश्ञन्ति । दिशामेव ज्योतिषि जुहोति । पशवो वा एतानि हवींषि । एष रुद्रः । यदग्निः

1.1.6.s: yathsadya etāni havīṃṣi nirvapet | rudrāya paśūnapi dadhyāt | apaśuryajamānaḥ syāt | yannānunirvapet | anavaruddhā asya paśavaḥ syuḥ | dvādaśasu rātrīṣvanu nirvapet | saṃvathsarapratimā vai dvādaśa rātrayaḥ | saṃvathsareṇaivāsmai rudraṃ śamayitvā | paśūnavarundhe | yadekamekametāni havīṃṣi nirvapet
1.1.6.d: यथ्सद्य एतानि हवींषि निर्वपेत् । रुद्राय पशूनपि दध्यात् । अपशुर्यजमानः स्यात् । यन्नानुनिर्वपेत् । अनवरुद्धा अस्य पशवः स्युः । द्वादशसु रात्रीष्वनु निर्वपेत् । संवथ्सरप्रतिमा वै द्वादश रात्रयः । संवथ्सरेणैवास्मै रुद्रं शमयित्वा । पशूनवरुन्धे । यदेकमेकमेतानि हवींषि निर्वपेत्
1.1.6.m:
If he should offer these oblations on the same day,
he would consign the domestic animals to Rudra;
the sacrificer would be without domestic animals.
If he should not offer [them] subsequently,
his domestic animals would remain unobtained.
He should offer [them] subsequently after twelve nights.
The twelve nights are the counter-measure of the year;
having appeased Rudra for him by means of the year,
he secures domestic animals.
If he should offer these oblations one by one,

1.1.6.s: yathā trīṇyāvapanāni pūrayet | tādṛktat | na prajananamucchiṃṣet | ekaṃ nirupya | uttare samasyet | tṛtīyamevāsmai lokamucchiṃṣati prajananāya | taṃ prajayā paśubhiranu prajāyate | atho yajñasyaivaiṣā'bhikrāntiḥ | rathacakraṃ pravartayati | manuṣyarathenaiva devarathaṃ pratyavarohati
1.1.6.d: यथा त्रीण्यावपनानि पूरयेत् । तादृक्तत् । न प्रजननमुच्छिंषेत् । एकं निरुप्य । उत्तरे समस्येत् । तृतीयमेवास्मै लोकमुच्छिंषति प्रजननाय । तं प्रजया पशुभिरनु प्रजायते । अथो यज्ञस्यैवैषाऽभिक्रान्तिः । रथचक्रं प्रवर्तयति । मनुष्यरथेनैव देवरथं प्रत्यवरोहति

1.1.6.s: brahmavādino vadanti | hotavyamagnihotrāṃna hotavyāmiti | yadyajuṣā juhuyāt | ayathāpūrvamāhutī juhuyāt | yanna juhuyāt | agniḥ parābhavet | tūṣṇīmeva hotavyam | yathāpūrvamāhutī juhoti | nāgniḥ parābhavati | agnīdhe dadāti
1.1.6.d: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । होतव्यमग्निहोत्रांन होतव्यामिति । यद्यजुषा जुहुयात् । अयथापूर्वमाहुती जुहुयात् । यन्न जुहुयात् । अग्निः पराभवेत् । तूष्णीमेव होतव्यम् । यथापूर्वमाहुती जुहोति । नाग्निः पराभवति । अग्नीधे ददाति
1.1.6.m:
The discussers of sacred lore say:
'Is the agnihotra to be offered, or is it not to be offered?'
If he should offer with a yajus-formula,
he would offer the two oblations out of proper sequence.
If he should not offer,
Agni would perish.
It is to be offered in silence;
he offers the two oblations in proper sequence;
Agni does not perish.
He gives to the Agnīdh.

1.1.6.s: agnimukhānevartūnprīṇāti | upabarhaṇaṃ dadāti | rūpāṇāmavaruddhyai | aśvaṃ brahmaṇe | indriyamevāvarundhe | dhenuṃ hotre | āśiṣa evāvarundhe | anaḍvāhamadhvaryave | vahnirvā anaḍvān | vahniradhvaryuḥ
1.1.6.d: अग्निमुखानेवर्तून्प्रीणाति । उपबर्हणं ददाति । रूपाणामवरुद्ध्यै । अश्वं ब्रह्मणे । इन्द्रियमेवावरुन्धे । धेनुं होत्रे । आशिष एवावरुन्धे । अनड्वाहमध्वर्यवे । वह्निर्वा अनड्वान् । वह्निरध्वर्युः

1.1.6.s: vahninaiva vahni yajñasyāvarundhe | mithunau gāvau dadāti | mithunasyāvaruddhyai | vāso dadāti | sarva devatyaṃ vai vāsaḥ | sarvā eva devatāḥ prīṇāti | ā dvādaśabhyo dadāti | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsara eva pratitiṣṭhati | kāmamūrdhvaṃ deyam | aparimitasyāvaruddhyai
1.1.6.d: वह्निनैव वह्नि यज्ञस्यावरुन्धे । मिथुनौ गावौ ददाति । मिथुनस्यावरुद्ध्यै । वासो ददाति । सर्व देवत्यं वै वासः । सर्वा एव देवताः प्रीणाति । आ द्वादशभ्यो ददाति । द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सर एव प्रतितिष्ठति । काममूर्ध्वं देयम् । अपरिमितस्यावरुद्ध्यै

1.1.7.s: gharmaḥ śirastadayamagniḥ | saṃpriyaḥ paśubhirbhuvat | chardistokāya tanayāya yaccha | vātaḥ prāṇastadayamagniḥ | saṃpriyaḥ paśubhirbhuvat | svaditaṃ tokāya tanayāya pituṃ paca | prācīmanu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān | agneragne puro agnirbhaveha | viśvā āśā dīdyāno vibhāhi | ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade
1.1.7.d: घर्मः शिरस्तदयमग्निः । संप्रियः पशुभिर्भुवत् । छर्दिस्तोकाय तनयाय यच्छ । वातः प्राणस्तदयमग्निः । संप्रियः पशुभिर्भुवत् । स्वदितं तोकाय तनयाय पितुं पच । प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वान् । अग्नेरग्ने पुरो अग्निर्भवेह । विश्वा आशा दीद्यानो विभाहि । ऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पदे

1.1.7.s: arkaścakṣustadasau sūryastadayamagniḥ | saṃpriyaḥ paśubhirbhuvat | yatte śukra śukraṃ varcaḥ śukrā tanūḥ | śukraṃ jyotirajasram | tena me dīdihi tena tvā''dadhe | agninā'gne brahmaṇā | ānaśe vyānaśe sarvamāyurvyānaśe | ye te agne śive tanuvau | virāṭca svarāṭca | te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām
1.1.7.d: अर्कश्चक्षुस्तदसौ सूर्यस्तदयमग्निः । संप्रियः पशुभिर्भुवत् । यत्ते शुक्र शुक्रं वर्चः शुक्रा तनूः । शुक्रं ज्योतिरजस्रम् । तेन मे दीदिहि तेन त्वा'ऽदधे । अग्निनाऽग्ने ब्रह्मणा । आनशे व्यानशे सर्वमायुर्व्यानशे । ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ । विराट्च स्वराट्च । ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम्
1.1.7.m:
'The sun is the eye: so yonder sun, so this Agni;
may he become well-beloved by the domestic animals.
What bright luster is yours, O bright one, what bright body,
what bright, unceasing light,
with that shine upon me; with that I establish you.
Fire through fire, through the brahman,
I have reached, I have pervaded, I have pervaded the full lifespan.
Those two kindly bodies of yours, O Agni,
Virāj and Svarāj,
may they enter me, may they invigorate me.'

'Those two kindly bodies of yours, O Agni,
Samrāj and Abhibhū,
may they enter me, may they invigorate me.
Those two kindly bodies of yours, O Agni,
Vibhū and Paribhū,
may they enter me, may they invigorate me.
Those two kindly bodies of yours, O Agni,
Prabhvī and Prabhūti,
may they enter me, may they invigorate me.
Those which are your kindly bodies, O Agni,
with them I establish you.
Those which are your dread bodies, O Agni,
with them go to that one.'

1.1.7.s: ye te agne śive tanuvau | samrāṭcābhibhūśca | te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām | ye te agne śive tanuvau | vibhūśca paribhūśca | te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām | ye te agne śive tanuvau | prabhvī ca prabhūtiśca | te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām | yāste agne śivāstanuvaḥ | tābhistvā''dadhe | yāste agne ghorāstanuvaḥ | tābhiramuṃ gaccha
1.1.7.d: ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ । सम्राट्चाभिभूश्च । ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् । ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ । विभूश्च परिभूश्च । ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् । ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ । प्रभ्वी च प्रभूतिश्च । ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् । यास्ते अग्ने शिवास्तनुवः । ताभिस्त्वा'ऽदधे । यास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवः । ताभिरमुं गच्छ

1.1.8.s: ime vā ete lokā agnayaḥ | te yadavyāvṛttā ādhīyerann | śocayeyuryajamānam | gharmaḥ śira iti gārhapatyamādadhāti | vātaḥ prāṇa ityanvāhāryapacanam | arkaścakṣurityāhavanīyam | tenaivainānvyāvartayati | tathā na śocayanti yajamānam | rathantaramabhigāyate gārhapatya ādhīyamāne | rāthantaro vā ayaṃ lokaḥ
1.1.8.d: इमे वा एते लोका अग्नयः । ते यदव्यावृत्ता आधीयेरन्न् । शोचयेयुर्यजमानम् । घर्मः शिर इति गार्हपत्यमादधाति । वातः प्राण इत्यन्वाहार्यपचनम् । अर्कश्चक्षुरित्याहवनीयम् । तेनैवैनान्व्यावर्तयति । तथा न शोचयन्ति यजमानम् । रथन्तरमभिगायते गार्हपत्य आधीयमाने । राथन्तरो वा अयं लोकः

1.1.8.s: asminnevainaṃ loke pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | vāmadevyamabhigāyata uddhriyamāṇe | antarikṣaṃ vai vāmadevyam | antarikṣa evainaṃ pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | atho śāntirvai vāmadevyam | śāntamevainaṃ paśavyamuddharate | bṛhadabhigāyata āhavanīya ādhīyamāne | bārhato vā asau lokaḥ | amuṣminnevainaṃ loke pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | prajāpatiragnimasṛjata
1.1.8.d: अस्मिन्नेवैनं लोके प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । वामदेव्यमभिगायत उद्ध्रियमाणे । अन्तरिक्षं वै वामदेव्यम् । अन्तरिक्ष एवैनं प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । अथो शान्तिर्वै वामदेव्यम् । शान्तमेवैनं पशव्यमुद्धरते । बृहदभिगायत आहवनीय आधीयमाने । बार्हतो वा असौ लोकः । अमुष्मिन्नेवैनं लोके प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । प्रजापतिरग्निमसृजत

1.1.8.s: so'śvo vāro bhūtvā parāṅait | taṃ vāravantīyenāvārayata | tadvāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam | śyaitena śyetī akuruta | tacchyaitasya śyaitatvam | yadvāravantīyamabhigāyate | vārayitvaivainaṃ pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | śyaitena śyetī kurute | gharmaḥ śira iti gārhapatyamādadhāti | saśīrṣāṇamevainamādhatte
1.1.8.d: सोऽश्वो वारो भूत्वा पराङैत् । तं वारवन्तीयेनावारयत । तद्वारवन्तीयस्य वारवन्तीयत्वम् । श्यैतेन श्येती अकुरुत । तच्छ्यैतस्य श्यैतत्वम् । यद्वारवन्तीयमभिगायते । वारयित्वैवैनं प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । श्यैतेन श्येती कुरुते । घर्मः शिर इति गार्हपत्यमादधाति । सशीर्षाणमेवैनमाधत्ते
1.1.8.m: He, becoming a horse, turned away and departed. / He checked him with the Vāravantīya [sāman]; / that is why the Vāravantīya is called Vāravantīya. / By means of the Śyaita, he made [the horses] white; / that is why the Śyaita is called Śyaita. / In that he sings the Vāravantīya, / having checked him, he establishes him as firm. / By means of the Śyaita, he makes [them] white. / With 'The cauldron is the head,' he establishes the Gārhapatya [fire]; / he establishes it possessing a head.

1.1.8.s: upainamuttaro yajño namati | rudro vā eṣaḥ | yadagniḥ | sa ādhīyamāna īśvaro yajamānasya paśūn hiṃsitoḥ | saṃpriyaḥ paśubhirbhuvadityāha | paśubhirevainaṃ saṃpriyaṃ karoti | paśūnāmahiṃsāyai | chardistokāya tanayāya yacchetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | vātaḥ prāṇa ityanvāhāryapacanam
1.1.8.d: उपैनमुत्तरो यज्ञो नमति । रुद्रो वा एषः । यदग्निः । स आधीयमान ईश्वरो यजमानस्य पशून् हिंसितोः । संप्रियः पशुभिर्भुवदित्याह । पशुभिरेवैनं संप्रियं करोति । पशूनामहिंसायै । छर्दिस्तोकाय तनयाय यच्छेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । वातः प्राण इत्यन्वाहार्यपचनम्
1.1.8.m: The higher sacrifice inclines towards him. / This is Rudra, / namely Agni. / When established, he is capable of harming the sacrificer's domestic animals. / He says, 'May he become dear to domestic animals'; / he makes him dear to domestic animals, / for the non-injury of domestic animals. / He says, 'Grant shelter to offspring and descendants'; / it is this blessing that he invokes. / With 'The wind is exhalation,' [he establishes] the Anvāhāryapacana [fire].

1.1.8.s: saprāṇamevainamādhatte | svaditaṃ tokāya tanayāya pituṃ pacetyāha | annamevāsmai svadayati | prācīmanu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvānityāha | vibhaktirevainayoḥ sā | atho nānāvīryāvevainau kurute | ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpada ityāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | arkaścakṣurityāhavanīyam | arko vai devānāmannam
1.1.8.d: सप्राणमेवैनमाधत्ते । स्वदितं तोकाय तनयाय पितुं पचेत्याह । अन्नमेवास्मै स्वदयति । प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वानित्याह । विभक्तिरेवैनयोः सा । अथो नानावीर्यावेवैनौ कुरुते । ऊर्जं नो धेहि द्विपदे चतुष्पद इत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । अर्कश्चक्षुरित्याहवनीयम् । अर्को वै देवानामन्नम्
1.1.8.m: He establishes it possessing exhalation. / He says, 'Cook relishable food for offspring and descendants'; / he makes the food relishable for him. / He says, 'Go forth knowingly along the eastern direction'; / that is their differentiation. / Moreover, he makes them of different heroic powers. / He says, 'Bestow vigor on us, for biped and quadruped'; / it is this blessing that he invokes. / With 'The sun is the eye,' [he establishes] the Āhavanīya [fire]. / The sun is indeed the food of the gods.

1.1.8.s: annamevāvarundhe | tena me dīdihītyāha | samindha evainam | ānaśe vyānaśa iti trirudiṅgayati | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣvevainaṃ lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | tattathā na kāryam | vīṃgitamapratiṣṭhitamādadhīta | uddhṛtyaivādhāyābhimantriyaḥ | avīṅgitamevainaṃ pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | virāṭca svarāṭca yāste agne śivāstanuvastābhistvā''dadha ityāha | etā vā agneḥ śivāstanuvaḥ | tābhirevainaṃ samardhayati | yāste agne ghorāstanuvastābhiramuṃ gaccheti brūyādyaṃ dviṣyāt | tābhirevainaṃ parābhāvayati
1.1.8.d: अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । तेन मे दीदिहीत्याह । समिन्ध एवैनम् । आनशे व्यानश इति त्रिरुदिङ्गयति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एष्वेवैनं लोकेषु प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । तत्तथा न कार्यम् । वींगितमप्रतिष्ठितमादधीत । उद्धृत्यैवाधायाभिमन्त्रियः । अवीङ्गितमेवैनं प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । विराट्च स्वराट्च यास्ते अग्ने शिवास्तनुवस्ताभिस्त्वा'ऽदध इत्याह । एता वा अग्नेः शिवास्तनुवः । ताभिरेवैनं समर्धयति । यास्ते अग्ने घोरास्तनुवस्ताभिरमुं गच्छेति ब्रूयाद्यं द्विष्यात् । ताभिरेवैनं पराभावयति
1.1.8.m: He secures food itself. / He says, 'Shine upon me with that'; / he kindles it. / With 'He reached, he pervaded,' he shakes it three times upwards. / Three are these worlds; / he establishes him firmly in these worlds. / That must not be done so. / He would establish it shaken, unfirm. / Having brought it forth and established it, it should be addressed with mantras. / He establishes him unshaken, firm. / He says, 'O Agni, with those bodies of yours that are sovereign and self-ruling, that are auspicious, with those I establish you.' / These are indeed Agni's auspicious bodies; / he enriches him with them. / 'With those bodies of yours, O Agni, that are dreadful, go to so-and-so,' he should say regarding him whom he hates; / with those he causes him to perish.

1.1.9.s: śamīgarbhādagniṃ manthati | eṣā vā agneryajñiyā tanūḥ | tāmevāsmai janayati | aditiḥ putrakāmā | sādhyebhyo devebhyo brahmaudanamapacat | tasyā uccheṣaṇamadaduḥ | tatprāśñāt | sā reto'dhatta | tasyai dhātā cāryamā cājāyetām | sā dvitīyamapacat
1.1.9.d: शमीगर्भादग्निं मन्थति । एषा वा अग्नेर्यज्ञिया तनूः । तामेवास्मै जनयति । अदितिः पुत्रकामा । साध्येभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मौदनमपचत् । तस्या उच्छेषणमददुः । तत्प्राश्ञात् । सा रेतोऽधत्त । तस्यै धाता चार्यमा चाजायेताम् । सा द्वितीयमपचत्
1.1.9.m:
He churns out Agni from a piece of śamī wood containing an aśvattha. / This is indeed Agni's sacrificial body; / he generates that for him. / Aditi was desirous of sons; / she cooked a brahmaudana for the Sādhya gods. / They gave her the remnant. / She ate that. / She conceived semen. / To her, Dhātṛ and Aryaman were born. / She cooked a second [mess].

They gave her the remnant. / She ate that. / She conceived semen; to her, Mitra and Varuṇa were born. / She cooked a third [mess]. / They gave her the remnant. / She ate that. / She conceived semen; / to her, Aṃśa and Bhaga were born. / She cooked a fourth [mess].

1.1.9.s: tasyā uccheṣaṇamadaduḥ | tatprāśñāt | sā reto'dhatta | tasyai mitraśca varuṇaścājāyetām | sā tṛtīyamapacat | tasyā uccheṣaṇamadaduḥ | tatprāśñāt | sā reto'dhatta | tasyā aṃśaśca bhagaścājāyetām | sā caturthamapacat
1.1.9.d: तस्या उच्छेषणमददुः । तत्प्राश्ञात् । सा रेतोऽधत्त । तस्यै मित्रश्च वरुणश्चाजायेताम् । सा तृतीयमपचत् । तस्या उच्छेषणमददुः । तत्प्राश्ञात् । सा रेतोऽधत्त । तस्या अंशश्च भगश्चाजायेताम् । सा चतुर्थमपचत्
1.1.9.m: They gave her the remnant. / She ate that. / She conceived semen; / to her, Indra and Vivasvat were born. / He cooks a brahmaudana; / he thereby places semen. / The Brahmins eat the boiled rice mess. / What clarified butter remains, / anointing the kindling-sticks with that, he places them on [the fire]. / From the remnant, indeed, Aditi conceived semen.

1.1.9.s: tasyā uccheṣaṇamadaduḥ | tatprāśñāt | sā reto'dhatta | tasyā indraśca vivasvāṃścājāyetām | brahmaudanaṃ pacati | reta eva taddadhāti | prāśñanti brāhmaṇā odanam | yadājyamucchiṣyate | tena samidho'bhyajyādadhāti | uccheṣaṇādvā aditī reto'dhatta
1.1.9.d: तस्या उच्छेषणमददुः । तत्प्राश्ञात् । सा रेतोऽधत्त । तस्या इन्द्रश्च विवस्वांश्चाजायेताम् । ब्रह्मौदनं पचति । रेत एव तद्दधाति । प्राश्ञन्ति ब्राह्मणा ओदनम् । यदाज्यमुच्छिष्यते । तेन समिधोऽभ्यज्यादधाति । उच्छेषणाद्वा अदिती रेतोऽधत्त

1.1.9.s: uccheṣaṇādeva tadreto dhatte | asthi vā etat | yathsamidhaḥ | etadretaḥ | yadājyam | yadājyena samidho'bhyajyādadhāti | asthyeva tadretasi dadhāti | tisra ādadhāti mithunatvāya | iyatīrbhavanti | prajāpatinā yajñamukhena saṃmitāḥ
1.1.9.d: उच्छेषणादेव तद्रेतो धत्ते । अस्थि वा एतत् । यथ्समिधः । एतद्रेतः । यदाज्यम् । यदाज्येन समिधोऽभ्यज्यादधाति । अस्थ्येव तद्रेतसि दधाति । तिस्र आदधाति मिथुनत्वाय । इयतीर्भवन्ति । प्रजापतिना यज्ञमुखेन संमिताः
1.1.9.m: From the remnant itself he thereby places semen. / This is bone, / namely the kindling-sticks; / this is semen, / namely clarified butter. / When he places kindling-sticks on [the fire] after anointing them with clarified butter, / he thereby places bone in the semen. / He places three for pairing. / They are of this size, / commensurate with Prajāpati, the head of the sacrifice.

1.1.9.s: iyatīrbhavanti | yajñaparuṣā saṃmitāḥ | iyatīrbhavanti | etāvadvai puruṣe vīryam | vīryasaṃmitāḥ | ārdrā bhavanti | ārdramiva hi retaḥ sicyate | citriyasyāśvatthasyādadhāti | citrameva bhavati | ghṛtavatībhirādadhāti
1.1.9.d: इयतीर्भवन्ति । यज्ञपरुषा संमिताः । इयतीर्भवन्ति । एतावद्वै पुरुषे वीर्यम् । वीर्यसंमिताः । आर्द्रा भवन्ति । आर्द्रमिव हि रेतः सिच्यते । चित्रियस्याश्वत्थस्यादधाति । चित्रमेव भवति । घृतवतीभिरादधाति
1.1.9.m: They are of this size, / commensurate with the joints of the sacrifice. / They are of this size, / for such is the heroic power in man; / they are commensurate with heroic power. / They are moist, / for semen is emitted as if moist. / He puts on [sticks] of an aśvattha tree that has grown out of a śamī; / it becomes distinguished. / He puts them on with verses containing [the word] 'clarified butter.'

1.1.9.s: etadvā agneḥ priyaṃ dhāma | yadghṛtam | priyeṇaivainaṃ dhāmnā samardhayati | atho tejasā | gāyatrībhirbrāhmaṇasyādadhyāt | gāyatrachandā vai brāhmaṇaḥ | svasya chandasaḥ pratyayanastvāya | triṣṭugbhī rājanyasya | triṣṭupchandā vai rājanyaḥ | svasya chandasaḥ pratyayanastvāya
1.1.9.d: एतद्वा अग्नेः प्रियं धाम । यद्घृतम् । प्रियेणैवैनं धाम्ना समर्धयति । अथो तेजसा । गायत्रीभिर्ब्राह्मणस्यादध्यात् । गायत्रछन्दा वै ब्राह्मणः । स्वस्य छन्दसः प्रत्ययनस्त्वाय । त्रिष्टुग्भी राजन्यस्य । त्रिष्टुप्छन्दा वै राजन्यः । स्वस्य छन्दसः प्रत्ययनस्त्वाय
1.1.9.m: This is Agni's favorite abode, / namely clarified butter; / he enriches him with his favorite abode, / and also with fiery energy. / For a Brahmin, he should put [them] on with Gāyatrī verses; / the Brahmin has the Gāyatrī meter, / for having resort to his own meter. / For a Rājanya, with Triṣṭubh verses; / the Rājanya has the Triṣṭubh meter, / for having resort to his own meter.

1.1.9.s: jagatībhirvaiśyasya | jagatīchandā vai vaiśyaḥ | svasya chandasaḥ pratyayanastvāya | taṃ saṃvathsaraṃ gopāyet | saṃvathsaraṃ hi reto hitaṃ vardhate | yadyenaṃ saṃvathsare nopanamet | samidhaḥ punarādadhyāt | reta eva taddhitaṃ vardhamānameti | na māṃsamaśnīyāt | na striyamupeyāt
1.1.9.d: जगतीभिर्वैश्यस्य । जगतीछन्दा वै वैश्यः । स्वस्य छन्दसः प्रत्ययनस्त्वाय । तं संवथ्सरं गोपायेत् । संवथ्सरं हि रेतो हितं वर्धते । यद्येनं संवथ्सरे नोपनमेत् । समिधः पुनरादध्यात् । रेत एव तद्धितं वर्धमानमेति । न मांसमश्नीयात् । न स्त्रियमुपेयात्
1.1.9.m: For a Vaiśya, with Jagatī verses; / the Vaiśya has the Jagatī meter, / for having resort to his own meter. / He should guard it for a year; / for semen, once placed, grows for a year. / If it should not turn toward him in a year, / he should put kindling-sticks on again; / then the semen, placed, continues to grow. / He should not eat meat; / he should not approach a woman.

1.1.9.s: yanmāṃsamaśnīyāt | yathstriyamupeyāt | nirvīryaḥ syāt | nainamagnirupanamet | śva ādhāsyamāno brahmaudanaṃ pacati | ādityā vā ita uttamāḥ suvargaṃ lokamāyann | te vā ito yantaṃ pratinudante | ete khalu vāvādityāḥ | yadbrāhmaṇāḥ | taireva santvaṃ gacchati
1.1.9.d: यन्मांसमश्नीयात् । यथ्स्त्रियमुपेयात् । निर्वीर्यः स्यात् । नैनमग्निरुपनमेत् । श्व आधास्यमानो ब्रह्मौदनं पचति । आदित्या वा इत उत्तमाः सुवर्गं लोकमायन्न् । ते वा इतो यन्तं प्रतिनुदन्ते । एते खलु वावादित्याः । यद्ब्राह्मणाः । तैरेव सन्त्वं गच्छति
1.1.9.m: If he were to eat meat, / if he were to approach a woman, / he would be deprived of heroic power; / Agni would not turn toward him. / Intending to establish [the fires] tomorrow, he cooks a brahmaudana. / The Ādityas, going from here as the highest, went to the heavenly realm; / they thrust back him who goes from here. / These are indeed the Ādityas, / namely the Brahmins; / with them he comes to agreement.

1.1.9.s: nainaṃ pratinudante | brahmavādino vadanti | kvā saḥ | agniḥ kāryaḥ | yo'smai prajāṃ paśūnprajanayatīti | śalkaistāṃ rātrimagnimindhīta | tasminnupavyuṣamaraṇī niṣṭapet | yatharṣabhāya vāśitā nyāvicchāyati | tādṛgeva tat | apodūhya bhasmāgniṃ manthati
1.1.9.d: नैनं प्रतिनुदन्ते । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । क्वा सः । अग्निः कार्यः । योऽस्मै प्रजां पशून्प्रजनयतीति । शल्कैस्तां रात्रिमग्निमिन्धीत । तस्मिन्नुपव्युषमरणी निष्टपेत् । यथर्षभाय वाशिता न्याविच्छायति । तादृगेव तत् । अपोदूह्य भस्माग्निं मन्थति
1.1.9.m: They do not thrust him back. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / 'Where is that / Agni to be made, / who generates offspring and domestic animals for him?' / He should kindle the fire with splinters that night. / At dawn, he should heat the two churning sticks over it. / Just as a lowing cow is brought near to a bull, / just so is that. / Having swept away the ashes, he churns out the fire.

1.1.9.s: saiva sā'gneḥ santatiḥ | taṃ mathitvā prāñcamuddharati | saṃvathsarameva tadreto hitaṃ prajanayati | anāhitastasyāgnirityāhuḥ | yaḥ samidho'nādhāyāgnimādhatta iti | tāḥ saṃvathsare purastādādadhyāt | saṃvathsarādevainamavarudhyādhatte | yadi saṃvathsare nādadhyāt | dvādaśyāṃ purastādādadhyāt | saṃvathsarapratimā vai dvādaśa rātrayaḥ | saṃvathsaramevāsyāhitā bhavanti | yadi dvādaśyāṃ nādadhyāt | tryahe purastādādadhyāt | āhitā evāsya bhavanti
1.1.9.d: सैव साऽग्नेः सन्ततिः । तं मथित्वा प्राञ्चमुद्धरति । संवथ्सरमेव तद्रेतो हितं प्रजनयति । अनाहितस्तस्याग्निरित्याहुः । यः समिधोऽनाधायाग्निमाधत्त इति । ताः संवथ्सरे पुरस्तादादध्यात् । संवथ्सरादेवैनमवरुध्याधत्ते । यदि संवथ्सरे नादध्यात् । द्वादश्यां पुरस्तादादध्यात् । संवथ्सरप्रतिमा वै द्वादश रात्रयः । संवथ्सरमेवास्याहिता भवन्ति । यदि द्वादश्यां नादध्यात् । त्र्यहे पुरस्तादादध्यात् । आहिता एवास्य भवन्ति
1.1.9.m: That is the continuity of Agni. / Having churned it out, he brings it forth to the east. / Semen, placed for a year, he thereby brings to birth. / 'Unestablished is his fire,' they say / of him who establishes the fire without putting on the kindling-sticks. / He should put them on a year beforehand; / having secured him from a year, he establishes [him]. / If he should not put them on a year [beforehand], / he should put them on twelve days beforehand; the twelve nights are an image of the year; / for a year they are established for him. / If he should not put them on twelve days [beforehand], / he should put them on three days beforehand; / they are established for him.

1.1.10.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | sa riricāno'manyata | sa tapo'tapyata | sa ātmanvīryamapaśyat | tadavardhata | tadasmāthsahasordhvamasṛjyata | sā virāḍabhavat | tāṃ devāsurā vyagṛhṇata | so'bravītprajāpatiḥ | mama vā eṣā
1.1.10.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । स रिरिचानोऽमन्यत । स तपोऽतप्यत । स आत्मन्वीर्यमपश्यत् । तदवर्धत । तदस्माथ्सहसोर्ध्वमसृज्यत । सा विराडभवत् । तां देवासुरा व्यगृह्णत । सोऽब्रवीत्प्रजापतिः । मम वा एषा
1.1.10.m:
Prajāpati created offspring.
He thought himself emptied.
He performed ascetic heat.
He saw heroic power in himself.
It grew.
It was emitted upward from him with force.
It became Virāj.
The gods and the asuras contested for it.
Prajāpati said:
"She is indeed mine;

1.1.10.s: dohā eva yuṣmākamiti | sā tataḥ prācyudakrāmat | tatprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | atharva pituṃ me gopāyeti | sā dvitīyamudakrāmat | tatprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | narya prajāṃ me gopāyeti | sā tṛtīyamudakrāmat | tatprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | śaṃsya paśūnme gopāyeti
1.1.10.d: दोहा एव युष्माकमिति । सा ततः प्राच्युदक्रामत् । तत्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । अथर्व पितुं मे गोपायेति । सा द्वितीयमुदक्रामत् । तत्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । नर्य प्रजां मे गोपायेति । सा तृतीयमुदक्रामत् । तत्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । शंस्य पशून्मे गोपायेति
1.1.10.m:
yours are only the milkings."
From there she stepped forth eastward.
Prajāpati seized her completely, [saying]:
"O Atharvan, protect my food!"
She stepped forth a second time.
Prajāpati seized her completely, [saying]:
"O Narya, protect my offspring!"
She stepped forth a third time.
Prajāpati seized her completely, [saying]:
"O Śaṃsya, protect my domestic animals!"

1.1.10.s: sā caturthamudakrāmat | tatprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāyeti | sā pañcamamudakrāmat | tatprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāyeti | agnīn vāva sā tānvyakramata | tānprajāpatiḥ paryagṛhṇāt | atho paṅktimeva | paṅktirvā eṣā brāhmaṇe praviṣṭā
1.1.10.d: सा चतुर्थमुदक्रामत् । तत्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । सप्रथ सभां मे गोपायेति । सा पञ्चममुदक्रामत् । तत्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपायेति । अग्नीन् वाव सा तान्व्यक्रमत । तान्प्रजापतिः पर्यगृह्णात् । अथो पङ्क्तिमेव । पङ्क्तिर्वा एषा ब्राह्मणे प्रविष्टा
1.1.10.m:
She stepped forth a fourth time.
Prajāpati seized her completely, [saying]:
"O Saprathas, protect my council!"
She stepped forth a fifth time.
Prajāpati seized her completely, [saying]:
"O Ahi Budhnya, protect my mantra!"
Truly, she stepped across those fires.
Prajāpati seized them completely;
and also the fivefold series itself.
Truly, this fivefold series has entered into the Brahmin.

1.1.10.s: tāmātmano'dhi nirmimīte | yadagnirādhīyate | tasmādetāvanto'gnaya ādhīyante | pāṅktaṃ vā idaṃ sarvam | pāṅktenaiva pāṅktaṃ spṛṇoti | atharva pituṃ me gopāyetyāha | annamevaitena spṛṇoti | narya prajāṃ me gopāyetyāha | prajāmevaitena spṛṇoti | śaṃsya paśūnme gopāyetyāha
1.1.10.d: तामात्मनोऽधि निर्मिमीते । यदग्निराधीयते । तस्मादेतावन्तोऽग्नय आधीयन्ते । पाङ्क्तं वा इदं सर्वम् । पाङ्क्तेनैव पाङ्क्तं स्पृणोति । अथर्व पितुं मे गोपायेत्याह । अन्नमेवैतेन स्पृणोति । नर्य प्रजां मे गोपायेत्याह । प्रजामेवैतेन स्पृणोति । शंस्य पशून्मे गोपायेत्याह
1.1.10.m:
He produces it out of himself
when the fire is established.
Therefore, so many fires are established.
Indeed, this whole world is fivefold.
By means of the fivefold he secures the fivefold.
He says: "O Atharvan, protect my food!"
Thereby he secures food itself.
He says: "O Narya, protect my offspring!"
Thereby he secures offspring itself.
He says: "O Śaṃsya, protect my domestic animals!"

1.1.10.s: paśūnevaitena spṛṇoti | sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāyetyāha | sabhāmevaitenendriyaṃ spṛṇoti | ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāyetyāha | mantramevaitena śriyaṃ spṛṇoti | yadanvāhāryapacane'nvāhāryaṃ pacanti | tena so'syābhīṣṭaḥ prītaḥ | yadgārhapatya ājyamadhiśrayanti saṃpatnīryājayanti | tena so'syābhīṣṭaḥ prītaḥ | yadāhavanīye juhvati
1.1.10.d: पशूनेवैतेन स्पृणोति । सप्रथ सभां मे गोपायेत्याह । सभामेवैतेनेन्द्रियं स्पृणोति । अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपायेत्याह । मन्त्रमेवैतेन श्रियं स्पृणोति । यदन्वाहार्यपचनेऽन्वाहार्यं पचन्ति । तेन सोऽस्याभीष्टः प्रीतः । यद्गार्हपत्य आज्यमधिश्रयन्ति संपत्नीर्याजयन्ति । तेन सोऽस्याभीष्टः प्रीतः । यदाहवनीये जुह्वति
1.1.10.m:
Thereby he secures domestic animals themselves.
He says: "O Saprathas, protect my council!"
Thereby he secures the council, vital power itself.
He says: "O Ahi Budhnya, protect my mantra!"
Thereby he secures the mantra, fortune itself.
Because they cook the anvāhārya cooked mess in the anvāhāryapacana fire,
thereby it is desired and pleased for him.
Because they set the ghee on the gārhapatya fire and cause the wives to sacrifice,
thereby it is desired and pleased for him.
Because they make offerings in the āhavanīya fire,

1.1.10.s: tena so'syābhīṣṭaḥ prītaḥ | yathsabhāyāṃ vijayante | tena so'syābhīṣṭaḥ prītaḥ | yadāvasathe'nnaṃ haranti | tena so'syābhīṣṭaḥ prītaḥ | tathā'sya sarve prītā abhīṣṭā ādhīyante | pravasathameṣyannevamupatiṣṭhetaikamekam | yathā brāhmaṇāya gṛhevāsine paridāya gṛhāneti | tādṛgeva tat | punarāgatyopatiṣṭhate | sā'bhāgeyamevaiṣāṃ tat | sā tata ūrdhvārohat | sā rohiṇyabhavat | tadrohiṇyai rohiṇitvam | rohiṇyāmagnimādadhīta | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhitamādhatte | ṛdhnotyenena
1.1.10.d: तेन सोऽस्याभीष्टः प्रीतः । यथ्सभायां विजयन्ते । तेन सोऽस्याभीष्टः प्रीतः । यदावसथेऽन्नं हरन्ति । तेन सोऽस्याभीष्टः प्रीतः । तथाऽस्य सर्वे प्रीता अभीष्टा आधीयन्ते । प्रवसथमेष्यन्नेवमुपतिष्ठेतैकमेकम् । यथा ब्राह्मणाय गृहेवासिने परिदाय गृहानेति । तादृगेव तत् । पुनरागत्योपतिष्ठते । साऽभागेयमेवैषां तत् । सा तत ऊर्ध्वारोहत् । सा रोहिण्यभवत् । तद्रोहिण्यै रोहिणित्वम् । रोहिण्यामग्निमादधीत । स्व एवैनं योनौ प्रतिष्ठितमाधत्ते । ऋध्नोत्येनेन
1.1.10.m:
thereby it is desired and pleased for him.
Because they win in the council fire,
thereby it is desired and pleased for him.
Because they bring food to the āvasatha fire,
thereby it is desired and pleased for him.
Thus all [fires] are established for him, pleased and desired.
When about to set out on a journey, he should attend upon each one in this way.
Just as one goes away from his house after entrusting [it] to a Brahmin residing in the house,
such indeed is that.
Having returned, he attends upon [them].
That is their shareholding.
From there she mounted upward.
She became Rohiṇī.
That is the Rohiṇī-nature of Rohiṇī.
One should establish the fire under Rohiṇī.
He establishes it firmly established in its own womb.
He prospers through it.

1.2.1.s: uddhanyamānamasyā amedhyam | apa pāpmānaṃ yajamānasya hantu | śivā naḥ santu pradiśaścatasraḥ | śaṃ no mātā pṛthivī tokasātā | śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaye | āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ | vaiśvānarasya rūpam | pṛthivyāṃ parisrasā | syonamāviśantu naḥ
1.2.1.d: उद्धन्यमानमस्या अमेध्यम् । अप पाप्मानं यजमानस्य हन्तु । शिवा नः सन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः । शं नो माता पृथिवी तोकसाता । शं नो देवीरभिष्टये । आपो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः । वैश्वानरस्य रूपम् । पृथिव्यां परिस्रसा । स्योनमाविशन्तु नः
1.2.1.m:
Let what is impure being dug up from her
strike away the evil of the sacrificer.
May the four directions be auspicious for us;
may mother earth be peaceful to us in the winning of children.
May the divine waters be for our welfare
[and] for drinking;
may they flow over us for blessing and happiness.
May the forms of Vaiśvānara,
flowing all around the earth,
enter us gently.

1.2.1.s: yadidaṃ divo yadadaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | saṃjajñāne rodasī saṃbabhūvatuḥ | ūṣānkṛṣṇamavatu kṛṣṇamūṣāḥ | ihobhayoryajñiyamāgamiṣṭhāḥ | ūtīḥ kurvāṇo yatpṛthivīmacaraḥ | guhākāramākhurūpaṃ pratītya | tatte nyaktamiha saṃbharantaḥ | śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ savīrāḥ | ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā rasamābharantaḥ | śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ purūcīḥ
1.2.1.d: यदिदं दिवो यददः पृथिव्याः । संजज्ञाने रोदसी संबभूवतुः । ऊषान्कृष्णमवतु कृष्णमूषाः । इहोभयोर्यज्ञियमागमिष्ठाः । ऊतीः कुर्वाणो यत्पृथिवीमचरः । गुहाकारमाखुरूपं प्रतीत्य । तत्ते न्यक्तमिह संभरन्तः । शतं जीवेम शरदः सवीराः । ऊर्जं पृथिव्या रसमाभरन्तः । शतं जीवेम शरदः पुरूचीः
1.2.1.m:
Whatever of this is of heaven, whatever of that is of earth,
the two worlds, having come to agreement, came into being together.
May the saline earth protect the black, may the black protect the saline earth;
may you two come here most worthy of sacrifice for both.
When wandering over the earth performing protective acts,
assuming the form of a mouse, making a burrow,
collecting that embedded form of yours here,
may we live a hundred autumns with heroes.
Bringing the vigor and the sap of the earth,
may we live a hundred full autumns.

1.2.1.s: vamrībhiranuvittaṃ guhāsu | śrotraṃ ta urvyabadhirā bhavāmaḥ | prajāpatisṛṣṭānāṃ prajānām | kṣudhopahatyai suvitaṃ no astu | upaprabhinnamiṣamūrjaṃ prajābhyaḥ | sūdaṃ gṛhebhyo rasamābharāmi | yasya rūpaṃ bibhradimāmavindat | guhā praviṣṭāṃ sarirasya madhye | tasyedaṃ vihatamābharantaḥ | achambaṭkāramasyāṃ vidhema
1.2.1.d: वम्रीभिरनुवित्तं गुहासु । श्रोत्रं त उर्व्यबधिरा भवामः । प्रजापतिसृष्टानां प्रजानाम् । क्षुधोपहत्यै सुवितं नो अस्तु । उपप्रभिन्नमिषमूर्जं प्रजाभ्यः । सूदं गृहेभ्यो रसमाभरामि । यस्य रूपं बिभ्रदिमामविन्दत् । गुहा प्रविष्टां सरिरस्य मध्ये । तस्येदं विहतमाभरन्तः । अछम्बट्कारमस्यां विधेम
1.2.1.m:
Found by ants in secret places,
hearing your broad [call], may we not be deaf.
For the offspring created by Prajāpati,
may there be safe passage for the destruction of hunger.
Bringing here refreshment and vigor to the pierced offspring,
I bring a well of sap to the households.
Taking whose form he found her
who had entered the secret place in the midst of the watery deep,
bringing his dug-up [earth],
may we worship on her without interruption.

1.2.1.s: yatparyapaśyathsarirasya madhye | urvīmapaśyajjagataḥ pratiṣṭhām | tatpuṣkarasyāyatanāddhi jātam | parṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prathanaṃ harāmi | yābhiradṛṃhajjagataḥ pratiṣṭhām | urvīmimāṃ viśvajanasya bhartrīm | tā naḥ śivāḥ śarkarāḥ santu sarvāḥ | agne retaścandraṃ hiraṇyam | adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtamamṛtaṃ prajāsu | tathsaṃbharannuttarato nidhāya
1.2.1.d: यत्पर्यपश्यथ्सरिरस्य मध्ये । उर्वीमपश्यज्जगतः प्रतिष्ठाम् । तत्पुष्करस्यायतनाद्धि जातम् । पर्णं पृथिव्याः प्रथनं हरामि । याभिरदृंहज्जगतः प्रतिष्ठाम् । उर्वीमिमां विश्वजनस्य भर्त्रीम् । ता नः शिवाः शर्कराः सन्तु सर्वाः । अग्ने रेतश्चन्द्रं हिरण्यम् । अद्भ्यः संभूतममृतं प्रजासु । तथ्संभरन्नुत्तरतो निधाय
1.2.1.m:
What he saw in the midst of the watery deep,
he saw the broad [earth], the foundation of the world.
Therefore born from the abode of the lotus,
I bring the leaf, the expanse of the earth.
With which he made firm the foundation of the world,
this broad earth, the bearer of all people,
may all those gravels be auspicious to us.
The semen of Agni, the shining gold,
born from the waters, immortal among offspring—
bringing it and placing it to the north,

1.2.1.s: ati prayacchaṃ duritiṃ tareyam | aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā yadaśvatthe'tiṣṭhaḥ | saṃvathsaraṃ devebhyo nilāya | tatte nyaktamiha saṃbharantaḥ | śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ savīrāḥ | ūrjaḥ pṛthivyā adhyutthito'si | vanaspate śatavalśo viroha | tvayā vayamiṣamūrjaṃ madantaḥ | rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madema | gāyatriyā hriyamāṇasya yatte
1.2.1.d: अति प्रयच्छं दुरितिं तरेयम् । अश्वो रूपं कृत्वा यदश्वत्थेऽतिष्ठः । संवथ्सरं देवेभ्यो निलाय । तत्ते न्यक्तमिह संभरन्तः । शतं जीवेम शरदः सवीराः । ऊर्जः पृथिव्या अध्युत्थितोऽसि । वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह । त्वया वयमिषमूर्जं मदन्तः । रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदेम । गायत्रिया ह्रियमाणस्य यत्ते
1.2.1.m:
bestowing across, may I cross over misfortune.
When, having assumed the form of a horse, you stood in the aśvattha tree,
hiding from the gods for a year,
bringing that embedded form of yours here,
may we live a hundred autumns with heroes.
You have risen up from the vigor of the earth;
O lord of the forest, sprout forth with a hundred branches!
Delighting in refreshment and vigor through you,
may we delight in refreshment with increase of wealth.
When your [leaf] was being carried away by the Gāyatrī,

1.2.1.s: parṇamapatattṛtīyasyai divo'dhi | so'yaṃ parṇaḥ somaparṇāddhi jātaḥ | tato harāmi somapīthasyāvaruddhyai | devānāṃ brahmavādaṃ vadatāṃ yat | upāśṛṇoḥ suśravā vai śruto'si | tato māmāviśatu brahmavarcasam | tathsaṃbharaṃstadavarundhīya sākṣāt | yayā te sṛṣṭasyāgneḥ | hetimaśamayatprajāpatiḥ | tāmimāmapradāhāya
