1.3.6.d: प्र वा एतेऽस्माल्लोकाच्च्यवन्ते । य आजिं धावन्ति । उदञ्च आवर्तन्ते । अस्मादेव तेन लोकान्नयन्ति । रथविमोचनीयं जुहोति प्रतिष्ठित्यै । आमा वाजस्य प्रसवो जगम्यादित्याह । अन्नं वै वाजः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । यथालोकं वा एत उज्जयन्ति । य आजिं धावन्ति
1.3.6.m: They depart from this world, / who run the race. / They turn back toward the north; / from this world they thereby do not lead [them] away. / He offers the chariot-unloosing oblation for firm standing. / 'May the surge of refreshment come to me,' he says; / food indeed is the prize; / he thereby secures food. / According to their proper sphere do they conquer, / who run the race.

1.3.6.s: kṛṣṇalaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ vājasṛdbhyaḥ prayacchati | yameva te vājaṃ lokamujjayanti | taṃ parikrīyāvarundhe | ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati | ekadhaiva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | devā vā oṣadhīṣvājimayuḥ | tā bṛhaspatirudajayat | sa nīvārānniravṛṇīta | tannīvārāṇāṃ nīvāratvam | naivāraścarurbhavati
1.3.6.d: कृष्णलं कृष्णलं वाजसृद्भ्यः प्रयच्छति । यमेव ते वाजं लोकमुज्जयन्ति । तं परिक्रीयावरुन्धे । एकधा ब्रह्मण उपहरति । एकधैव यजमाने वीर्यं दधाति । देवा वा ओषधीष्वाजिमयुः । ता बृहस्पतिरुदजयत् । स नीवारान्निरवृणीत । तन्नीवाराणां नीवारत्वम् । नैवारश्चरुर्भवति
1.3.6.m: He gives a kṛṣṇala to each of those running for the prize; / whichever prize, whichever realm they win, / purchasing that, he secures it. / In one lot he offers [them] to the Brahman; / in one lot indeed he places heroic power in the sacrificer. / The gods ran a race for the plants; / Bṛhaspati won them. / He chose the wild rice (nīvāra); / that is the nature of wild rice (nīvāratva). / There is a boiled mess of wild rice.

1.3.6.s: etadvai devānāṃ paramamannam | yannīvārāḥ | parameṇaivāsmā annādyenāvaramannādyamavarundhe | saptadaśaśarāvo bhavati | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | kṣīre bhavati | rucamevāsmindadhāti | sarpiṣvānbhavati medhyatvāya | bārhaspatyo vā eṣa devatayā
1.3.6.d: एतद्वै देवानां परममन्नम् । यन्नीवाराः । परमेणैवास्मा अन्नाद्येनावरमन्नाद्यमवरुन्धे । सप्तदशशरावो भवति । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । क्षीरे भवति । रुचमेवास्मिन्दधाति । सर्पिष्वान्भवति मेध्यत्वाय । बार्हस्पत्यो वा एष देवतया
1.3.6.m: This is indeed the supreme food of the gods, / that is, the wild rice; / by the supreme edible food indeed he secures for him the lower edible food. / It consists of seventeen platters; / seventeen-fold is Prajāpati; / [this is] for obtaining Prajāpati. / It is cooked in milk; / brightness indeed he places in him. / It is full of ghee for sacrificial fitness; / belonging to Bṛhaspati by deity is this one.

1.3.6.s: yo vājapeyena yajate | bārhaspatya eṣa caruḥ | aśvānthsariṣyataḥ sasruṣaścāva ghrāpayati | yameva te vājaṃ lokamujjayanti | tamevāvarundhe | ajījipata vanaspataya indraṃ vājaṃ vimucyadhvamiti dundubhīn vimuñcati | yameva te vājaṃ lokamindriyaṃ dundubhaya ujjayanti | tamevāvarundhe
1.3.6.d: यो वाजपेयेन यजते । बार्हस्पत्य एष चरुः । अश्वान्थ्सरिष्यतः सस्रुषश्चाव घ्रापयति । यमेव ते वाजं लोकमुज्जयन्ति । तमेवावरुन्धे । अजीजिपत वनस्पतय इन्द्रं वाजं विमुच्यध्वमिति दुन्दुभीन् विमुञ्चति । यमेव ते वाजं लोकमिन्द्रियं दुन्दुभय उज्जयन्ति । तमेवावरुन्धे
1.3.6.m: He who sacrifices with the Vājapeya; / belonging to Bṛhaspati is this caru. / He makes the horses, both about to run and having run, smell it; / whichever prize, whichever realm they win, / that he secures. / 'You have caused Indra to win the prize, O trees, be unyoked,' saying thus he unyokes the war-drums; / whichever prize, whichever realm, whichever sensory power the war-drums win, / that he secures.

1.3.7.s: tārpyaṃ yajamānaṃ paridhāpayati | yajño vai tārpyam | yajñenaivainaṃ samardhayati | darbhamayaṃ paridhāpayati | pavitraṃ vai darbhāḥ | punātyevainam | vājaṃ vā eṣo'varuruthsate | yo vājapeyena yajate | oṣadhayaḥ khalu vai vājaḥ | yaddarbhamayaṃ paridhāpayati
1.3.7.d: तार्प्यं यजमानं परिधापयति । यज्ञो वै तार्प्यम् । यज्ञेनैवैनं समर्धयति । दर्भमयं परिधापयति । पवित्रं वै दर्भाः । पुनात्येवैनम् । वाजं वा एषोऽवरुरुथ्सते । यो वाजपेयेन यजते । ओषधयः खलु वै वाजः । यद्दर्भमयं परिधापयति
1.3.7.m: He makes the sacrificer put on a tārpya garment; / the sacrifice indeed is the tārpya; / with the sacrifice he thus makes him prosper. / He makes [him] put on an apron made of darbha grass; / a means of purification is darbha grass; / he purifies him indeed. / He desires to secure the prize, / he who sacrifices with the Vājapeya. / The plants indeed are the prize; / in that he makes him put on that made of darbha grass,

1.3.7.s: vājasyāvaruddhyai | jāya ehi suvo rohāvetyāha | patniyā evaiṣa yajñasyānvārambho'navacchityai | saptadaśāratniryūpo bhavati | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | tūparaścaturaśrirbhavati | gaudhūmaṃ caṣālam | na vā ete vrīhayo na yavāḥ | yadgodhūmāḥ
1.3.7.d: वाजस्यावरुद्ध्यै । जाय एहि सुवो रोहावेत्याह । पत्निया एवैष यज्ञस्यान्वारम्भोऽनवच्छित्यै । सप्तदशारत्निर्यूपो भवति । सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । तूपरश्चतुरश्रिर्भवति । गौधूमं चषालम् । न वा एते व्रीहयो न यवाः । यद्गोधूमाः
1.3.7.m: [it is] for the securing of the prize. / 'Wife, come, let us two ascend to the sun,' he says; / this is the holding on to the sacrifice by the wife, for uninterruptedness. / The sacrificial post is seventeen cubits long; / seventeen-fold is Prajāpati; / [this is] for obtaining Prajāpati. / It is hornless (unpointed), four-cornered; / the top-ring (caṣāla) is made of wheat; / neither rice nor barley are they, / that is, wheat.

1.3.7.s: evamiva hi prajāpatiḥ samṛddhyai | atho amumevāsmai lokamannavantaṃ karoti | vāsobhirveṣṭayati | eṣa vai yajamānaḥ | yadyūpaḥ | sarvadevatyaṃ vāsaḥ | sarvābhirevainaṃ devatābhiḥ samardhayati | atho ākramaṇameva tathsetuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | dvādaśa vājaprasavīyāni juhoti
1.3.7.d: एवमिव हि प्रजापतिः समृद्ध्यै । अथो अमुमेवास्मै लोकमन्नवन्तं करोति । वासोभिर्वेष्टयति । एष वै यजमानः । यद्यूपः । सर्वदेवत्यं वासः । सर्वाभिरेवैनं देवताभिः समर्धयति । अथो आक्रमणमेव तथ्सेतुं यजमानः कुरुते । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । द्वादश वाजप्रसवीयानि जुहोति
1.3.7.m: So indeed is Prajāpati, for success. / And also he makes that world full of food for him. / He wraps it with garments; / this sacrificer indeed / is the sacrificial post; / a garment belongs to all the deities; / with all deities he causes him to prosper. / And also, the sacrificer makes that a ramp, a bridge, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / He offers twelve oblations of the surge of refreshment (vājaprasavīya).

1.3.7.s: dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvathsaraḥ | saṃvathsarameva prīṇāti | atho saṃvathsaramevāsmā upadadhāti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | daśabhiḥ kalpai rohati | nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ | nābhirdaśamī | prāṇāneva yathāsthānaṃ kalpayitvā | suvargaṃ lokameti | etāvadvai puruṣasya svam
1.3.7.d: द्वादश मासाः संवथ्सरः । संवथ्सरमेव प्रीणाति । अथो संवथ्सरमेवास्मा उपदधाति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । दशभिः कल्पै रोहति । नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः । नाभिर्दशमी । प्राणानेव यथास्थानं कल्पयित्वा । सुवर्गं लोकमेति । एतावद्वै पुरुषस्य स्वम्
1.3.7.m: Twelve months are the year; / he pleases the year indeed; / and also he places the year near for him, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm. / He mounts with ten formulas; / nine indeed are the vital breaths in man, / the navel is the tenth; / having arranged the vital breaths in their proper place, / he goes to the heavenly realm. / So much indeed is a man's own.

1.3.7.s: yāvatprāṇāḥ | yāvadevāsyāsti | tena saha suvargaṃ lokameti | suvardevāṃ aganmetyāha | suvargameva lokameti | amṛtā abhūmetyāha | amṛtamiva hi suvargo lokaḥ | prajāpateḥ prajā abhūmetyāha | prājāpatyo vā ayaṃ lokaḥ | asmādeva tena lokānnaiti
1.3.7.d: यावत्प्राणाः । यावदेवास्यास्ति । तेन सह सुवर्गं लोकमेति । सुवर्देवां अगन्मेत्याह । सुवर्गमेव लोकमेति । अमृता अभूमेत्याह । अमृतमिव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । प्रजापतेः प्रजा अभूमेत्याह । प्राजापत्यो वा अयं लोकः । अस्मादेव तेन लोकान्नैति
1.3.7.m:
as many as his exhalations.
Whatever he has,
with that he goes to the heavenly realm.
"We have gone to the light, to the gods," he says;
he goes indeed to the heavenly realm.
"We have become immortal," he says,
for the heavenly realm is immortal, as it were.
"We have become Prajāpati's offspring," he says;
this realm belongs to Prajāpati,
and from this realm he does not depart thereby.

1.3.7.s: samahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | āsapuṭairghnanti | annaṃ vā iyam | annādyenaivainaṃ samardhayanti | ūṣairghnanti | ete hi sākṣādannam | yadūṣāḥ | sākṣādevainamannādyena samardhayanti | purastātpratyañcaṃ ghnanti
1.3.7.d: समहं प्रजया सं मया प्रजेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । आसपुटैर्घ्नन्ति । अन्नं वा इयम् । अन्नाद्येनैवैनं समर्धयन्ति । ऊषैर्घ्नन्ति । एते हि साक्षादन्नम् । यदूषाः । साक्षादेवैनमन्नाद्येन समर्धयन्ति । पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चं घ्नन्ति

1.3.7.s: purastāddhi pratīcīnamannamadyate | śīrṣato ghnanti | śīrṣato hyannamadyate | digbhyo ghnanti | digbhya evāsmā annādyamavarundhate | īśvaro vā eṣa parāṅpradaghaḥ | yo yūpaṃ rohati | hiraṇyamadhyavarohati | amṛtaṃ vai hiraṇyam | amṛtaṃ suvargo lokaḥ |
1.3.7.d: पुरस्ताद्धि प्रतीचीनमन्नमद्यते । शीर्षतो घ्नन्ति । शीर्षतो ह्यन्नमद्यते । दिग्भ्यो घ्नन्ति । दिग्भ्य एवास्मा अन्नाद्यमवरुन्धते । ईश्वरो वा एष पराङ्प्रदघः । यो यूपं रोहति । हिरण्यमध्यवरोहति । अमृतं वै हिरण्यम् । अमृतं सुवर्गो लोकः ।

1.3.7.s: amṛta eva suvarge loke pratitiṣṭhati | śatamānaṃ bhavati | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣyevendriye pratitiṣṭhati | puṣṭyai vā etadrūpam | yadajā | triḥ saṃvathsarasyānyānpaśūnpari prajāyate | bastājinamadhyava rohati | puṣṭyāmeva prajanane pratitiṣṭhati
1.3.7.d: अमृत एव सुवर्गे लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । शतमानं भवति । शतायुः पुरुषः शतेन्द्रियः । आयुष्येवेन्द्रिये प्रतितिष्ठति । पुष्ट्यै वा एतद्रूपम् । यदजा । त्रिः संवथ्सरस्यान्यान्पशून्परि प्रजायते । बस्ताजिनमध्यव रोहति । पुष्ट्यामेव प्रजनने प्रतितिष्ठति

1.3.8.s: saptānnahomāñjuhoti | sapta vā annāni | yāvantyevānnāni | tānyevāvarundhe | sapta grāmyā oṣadhayaḥ | saptāraṇyāḥ | ubhayīṣāmavaruddhyai | annasyānnasya juhoti | annasyānnasyāvaruddhyai | yadvājapeyayājyanava ruddhasyāśnīyāt
1.3.8.d: सप्तान्नहोमाञ्जुहोति । सप्त वा अन्नानि । यावन्त्येवान्नानि । तान्येवावरुन्धे । सप्त ग्राम्या ओषधयः । सप्तारण्याः । उभयीषामवरुद्ध्यै । अन्नस्यान्नस्य जुहोति । अन्नस्यान्नस्यावरुद्ध्यै । यद्वाजपेययाज्यनव रुद्धस्याश्नीयात्

1.3.8.s: avaruddhena vyṛddhyeta | sarvasya samavadāya juhoti | anavaruddhasyāvaruddhyai | audumbareṇa sruveṇa juhoti | ūrgvā annamudumbaraḥ | ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha | savitṛ prasūta evainaṃ brahmaṇā devatābhirabhiṣiñcati | annasyānnasyābhiṣiñcati | annasyānnasyāvaruddhyai
1.3.8.d: अवरुद्धेन व्यृद्ध्येत । सर्वस्य समवदाय जुहोति । अनवरुद्धस्यावरुद्ध्यै । औदुम्बरेण स्रुवेण जुहोति । ऊर्ग्वा अन्नमुदुम्बरः । ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह । सवितृ प्रसूत एवैनं ब्रह्मणा देवताभिरभिषिञ्चति । अन्नस्यान्नस्याभिषिञ्चति । अन्नस्यान्नस्यावरुद्ध्यै

1.3.8.s: purastāt pratyañcamabhiṣiñcati | purastāddhi pratīcīnamannamadyate | śīrṣato'bhiṣiñcati | śīrṣato hyannamadyate | ā mukhādanvava srāvayati | mukhata evāsmā annādyaṃ dadhāti | agnestvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmītyāha | eṣa vā agneḥ savaḥ | tenaivainamabhiṣiñcati | indrasya tvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmītyāha
1.3.8.d: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चमभिषिञ्चति । पुरस्ताद्धि प्रतीचीनमन्नमद्यते । शीर्षतोऽभिषिञ्चति । शीर्षतो ह्यन्नमद्यते । आ मुखादन्वव स्रावयति । मुखत एवास्मा अन्नाद्यं दधाति । अग्नेस्त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीत्याह । एष वा अग्नेः सवः । तेनैवैनमभिषिञ्चति । इन्द्रस्य त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीत्याह

1.3.8.s: indriyamevāsminnetena dadhāti | bṛhaspatestvā sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmītyāha | brahma vai devānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | brahmaṇaivainamabhiṣiñcati | somagrahāṃścāvadānīyāni cartvigbhya upa haranti | amumeva tairlokamannavantaṃ karoti | surāgrahāṃścānavadānīyāni ca vājasṛdbhyaḥ | imameva tairlokamannavantaṃ karoti | atho ubhayīṣvevābhiṣicyate | vimāthaṃ kurvate vājasṛtaḥ
1.3.8.d: इन्द्रियमेवास्मिन्नेतेन दधाति । बृहस्पतेस्त्वा साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीत्याह । ब्रह्म वै देवानां बृहस्पतिः । ब्रह्मणैवैनमभिषिञ्चति । सोमग्रहांश्चावदानीयानि चर्त्विग्भ्य उप हरन्ति । अमुमेव तैर्लोकमन्नवन्तं करोति । सुराग्रहांश्चानवदानीयानि च वाजसृद्भ्यः । इममेव तैर्लोकमन्नवन्तं करोति । अथो उभयीष्वेवाभिषिच्यते । विमाथं कुर्वते वाजसृतः

1.3.8.s: indriyasyāvaruddhyai | aniruktābhiḥ prātaḥsavane stuvate | aniruktaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | vājavatībhirmādhyandine | annaṃ vai vājaḥ | annamevāvarundhe | śipiviṣṭavatībhistṛtīyasavane | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | paśavaḥ śipiḥ | yajña eva paśuṣu pratitiṣṭhati | bṛhadantyaṃ bhavati | antamevainaṃ śriyai gamayati
1.3.8.d: इन्द्रियस्यावरुद्ध्यै । अनिरुक्ताभिः प्रातःसवने स्तुवते । अनिरुक्तः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । वाजवतीभिर्माध्यन्दिने । अन्नं वै वाजः । अन्नमेवावरुन्धे । शिपिविष्टवतीभिस्तृतीयसवने । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । पशवः शिपिः । यज्ञ एव पशुषु प्रतितिष्ठति । बृहदन्त्यं भवति । अन्तमेवैनं श्रियै गमयति

1.3.9.s: nṛṣadaṃ tvetyāha | prajā vai nṝn | prajānāmevaitena sūyate | druṣadamityāha | vanaspatayo vai dru | vanaspatīnāmevaitena sūyate | bhuvanasadamityāha | yadā vai vasīyānbhavati | bhuvanamaganniti vai tamāhuḥ | bhuvanamevaitena gacchati
1.3.9.d: नृषदं त्वेत्याह । प्रजा वै नॄन् । प्रजानामेवैतेन सूयते । द्रुषदमित्याह । वनस्पतयो वै द्रु । वनस्पतीनामेवैतेन सूयते । भुवनसदमित्याह । यदा वै वसीयान्भवति । भुवनमगन्निति वै तमाहुः । भुवनमेवैतेन गच्छति

1.3.9.s: apsuṣadaṃ tvā ghṛtasadamityāha | apāmevaitena ghṛtasya sūyate | vyomasadamityāha | yadā vai vasīyānbhavati | vyomāganniti vai tamāhuḥ | vyomaivaitena gacchati | pṛthiviṣadaṃ tvā'ntarikṣasadamityāha | eṣāmevaitena lokānāṃ sūyate | tasmādvājapeyayājī na kaṃ cana pratyavarohati | apīva hi devatānāṃ sūyate
1.3.9.d: अप्सुषदं त्वा घृतसदमित्याह । अपामेवैतेन घृतस्य सूयते । व्योमसदमित्याह । यदा वै वसीयान्भवति । व्योमागन्निति वै तमाहुः । व्योमैवैतेन गच्छति । पृथिविषदं त्वाऽन्तरिक्षसदमित्याह । एषामेवैतेन लोकानां सूयते । तस्माद्वाजपेययाजी न कं चन प्रत्यवरोहति । अपीव हि देवतानां सूयते

1.3.9.s: nākasadamityāha | yadā vai vasīyānbhavati | nākamaganniti vai tamāhuḥ | nākamevaitena gacchati | ye grahāḥ pañcajanīnā ityāha | pañcajanānāmevaitena sūyate | apāṃ rasamudvayasamityāha | apāmevaitena rasasya sūyate | sūryaraśmiṃ samābhṛtamityāha saśukratvāya
1.3.9.d: नाकसदमित्याह । यदा वै वसीयान्भवति । नाकमगन्निति वै तमाहुः । नाकमेवैतेन गच्छति । ये ग्रहाः पञ्चजनीना इत्याह । पञ्चजनानामेवैतेन सूयते । अपां रसमुद्वयसमित्याह । अपामेवैतेन रसस्य सूयते । सूर्यरश्मिं समाभृतमित्याह सशुक्रत्वाय

1.3.10.s: indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | asurānparābhāvya | so'māvāsyāṃ pratyāgacchat | te pitaraḥ pūrvedyurāgacchan | pitṝn yajño'gacchat | taṃ devāḥ punarayācanta | tamebhyo na punaradaduḥ | te'bruvanvaraṃ vṛṇāmahai | atha vaḥ punardāsyāmaḥ | asmabhyameva pūrvedyuḥ kriyātā iti
1.3.10.d: इन्द्रो वृत्रं हत्वा । असुरान्पराभाव्य । सोऽमावास्यां प्रत्यागच्छत् । ते पितरः पूर्वेद्युरागच्छन् । पितॄन् यज्ञोऽगच्छत् । तं देवाः पुनरयाचन्त । तमेभ्यो न पुनरददुः । तेऽब्रुवन्वरं वृणामहै । अथ वः पुनर्दास्यामः । अस्मभ्यमेव पूर्वेद्युः क्रियाता इति

1.3.10.s: tamebhyaḥ punaradaduḥ | tasmātpitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ kriyate | yatpitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ karoti | pitṛbhya eva tadyajñaṃ niṣkrīya yajamānaḥ pratanute | somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā nama ityāha | piturevādhi somapīthamavarundhe | na hi pitā pramīyamāṇa āhaiṣa somapītha iti | indriyaṃ vai somapīthaḥ | indriyameva somapīthamavarundhe | tenendriyeṇa dvitīyāṃ jāyāmabhyaśnute
1.3.10.d: तमेभ्यः पुनरददुः । तस्मात्पितृभ्यः पूर्वेद्युः क्रियते । यत्पितृभ्यः पूर्वेद्युः करोति । पितृभ्य एव तद्यज्ञं निष्क्रीय यजमानः प्रतनुते । सोमाय पितृपीताय स्वधा नम इत्याह । पितुरेवाधि सोमपीथमवरुन्धे । न हि पिता प्रमीयमाण आहैष सोमपीथ इति । इन्द्रियं वै सोमपीथः । इन्द्रियमेव सोमपीथमवरुन्धे । तेनेन्द्रियेण द्वितीयां जायामभ्यश्नुते

1.3.10.s: etadvai brāhmaṇaṃ purā vājaśravasā vidāmakrann | tasmātte dvedve jāye abhyākṣata | ya evaṃ veda | abhi dvitīyāṃ jāyāmaśnute | agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama ityāha | ya eva pitṛṇāmagniḥ | taṃ prīṇāti | tisra āhutīrjuhoti | trirnidadhāti | ṣaṭth saṃpadyante
1.3.10.d: एतद्वै ब्राह्मणं पुरा वाजश्रवसा विदामक्रन्न् । तस्मात्ते द्वेद्वे जाये अभ्याक्षत । य एवं वेद । अभि द्वितीयां जायामश्नुते । अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा नम इत्याह । य एव पितृणामग्निः । तं प्रीणाति । तिस्र आहुतीर्जुहोति । त्रिर्निदधाति । षट्थ् संपद्यन्ते
1.3.10.m: This Brāhmaṇa, indeed, the descendants of Vājaśravas knew formerly. / Therefore they obtained two wives each. / He who knows thus / obtains a second wife. / He says, "To Agni Kavyavāhana, svadhā, homage!" / Which Agni is of the fathers, / him he pleases. / He offers three oblations. / Three times he deposits [the balls of rice]. / They amount to six.

1.3.10.s: ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūneva prīṇāti | tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇamādadhāti | asti vā hi ṣaṣṭha ṛturna vā | devān vai pitṝnprītān | manuṣyāḥ pitaro'nu prapipate | tisra āhutīrjuhoti | trirnidadhāti | ṣaṭth saṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ
1.3.10.d: षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतूनेव प्रीणाति । तूष्णीं मेक्षणमादधाति । अस्ति वा हि षष्ठ ऋतुर्न वा । देवान् वै पितॄन्प्रीतान् । मनुष्याः पितरोऽनु प्रपिपते । तिस्र आहुतीर्जुहोति । त्रिर्निदधाति । षट्थ् संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः

1.3.10.s: ṛtavaḥ khalu vai devāḥ pitaraḥ | ṛtūneva devānpitṝnprīṇāti | tānprītān | manuṣyāḥ pitaro'nu prapipate | sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhirbhavati | sakṛdiva hi pitaraḥ | trirnidadhāti | tṛtīye vā ito loke pitaraḥ | tāneva prīṇāti | parāṅāvartate
1.3.10.d: ऋतवः खलु वै देवाः पितरः । ऋतूनेव देवान्पितॄन्प्रीणाति । तान्प्रीतान् । मनुष्याः पितरोऽनु प्रपिपते । सकृदाच्छिन्नं बर्हिर्भवति । सकृदिव हि पितरः । त्रिर्निदधाति । तृतीये वा इतो लोके पितरः । तानेव प्रीणाति । पराङावर्तते

1.3.10.s: hlīkā hi pitaraḥ | oṣmaṇo vyāvṛta upāste | ūṣmabhāgā hi pitaraḥ | brahmavādino vadanti | prāśyāṃna prāśyāmiti | yatprāśnīyāt | janyamannamadyāt | pramāyukaḥ syāt | yanna prāśnīyāt | ahaviḥ syāt
1.3.10.d: ह्लीका हि पितरः । ओष्मणो व्यावृत उपास्ते । ऊष्मभागा हि पितरः । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । प्राश्यांन प्राश्यामिति । यत्प्राश्नीयात् । जन्यमन्नमद्यात् । प्रमायुकः स्यात् । यन्न प्राश्नीयात् । अहविः स्यात्
1.3.10.m: For bashful are the fathers. / He sits until the cessation of the vapor; / for the fathers have the vapor as their share. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / "Is it to be eaten, or is it not to be eaten?" / If he were to eat, / he would eat strange food, / he would be prone to die. / If he were not to eat, / it would not be a sacrificial oblation.

1.3.10.s: pitṛbhya āvṛścyeta | avaghreyameva | tanneva prāśitaṃ nevāprāśitam | vīraṃ vā vai pitaraḥ prayanto haranti | vīraṃ vā dadati | daśāṃ chinatti | haraṇabhāgā hi pitaraḥ | pitṝneva niravadayate | uttara āyuṣi loma chindīta | pitṛṇāg hyetarhi nedīyaḥ
1.3.10.d: पितृभ्य आवृश्च्येत । अवघ्रेयमेव । तन्नेव प्राशितं नेवाप्राशितम् । वीरं वा वै पितरः प्रयन्तो हरन्ति । वीरं वा ददति । दशां छिनत्ति । हरणभागा हि पितरः । पितॄनेव निरवदयते । उत्तर आयुषि लोम छिन्दीत । पितृणाग् ह्येतर्हि नेदीयः

1.3.10.s: namaskaroti | namaskāro hi pitṛṇām | namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śuṣmāya | namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai | namo vaḥ pitaro manyave | namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya | pitaro namo vaḥ | ya etasmiṃ lloke stha
1.3.10.d: नमस्करोति । नमस्कारो हि पितृणाम् । नमो वः पितरो रसाय । नमो वः पितरः शुष्माय । नमो वः पितरो जीवाय । नमो वः पितरः स्वधायै । नमो वः पितरो मन्यवे । नमो वः पितरो घोराय । पितरो नमो वः । य एतस्मिं ल्लोके स्थ
1.3.10.m: He pays homage; / for homage belongs to the fathers: / "Homage to you, O fathers, for sap! / Homage to you, O fathers, for fierce energy! / Homage to you, O fathers, for life! / Homage to you, O fathers, for svadhā! / Homage to you, O fathers, for wrath! / Homage to you, O fathers, for terror! / O fathers, homage to you! / You who are in that world,"

1.3.10.s: yuṣmāg ste'nu | ye'smiṃ lloke | māṃ te'nu | ya etasmiṃ lloke stha | yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsta | ye'smiṃ lloke | ahaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭho bhūyāsamityāha | vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ vidvānpitṛbhyaḥ karoti | eṣa vai manuṣyāṇāṃ yajñaḥ
1.3.10.d: युष्माग् स्तेऽनु । येऽस्मिं ल्लोके । मां तेऽनु । य एतस्मिं ल्लोके स्थ । यूयं तेषां वसिष्ठा भूयास्त । येऽस्मिं ल्लोके । अहं तेषां वसिष्ठो भूयासमित्याह । वसिष्ठः समानानां भवति । य एवं विद्वान्पितृभ्यः करोति । एष वै मनुष्याणां यज्ञः
1.3.10.m: "may they follow you; / those who are in this world, / may they follow me. / You who are in that world, / may you be the best of them; / those who are in this world, / may I be the best of them," he says. / He becomes the best among his equals / who, knowing thus, performs [this rite] for the fathers. / This, indeed, is the sacrifice of men.

1.3.10.s: devānāṃ vā itare yajñāḥ | tena vā etatpitṛloke carati | yatpitṛbhyaḥ karoti | sa īśvaraḥ prametoḥ | prājāpatyayarcā punaraiti | yajño vai prajāpatiḥ | yajñenaiva saha punaraiti | na pramāyuko bhavati | pitṛloke vā etadyajamānaścarati | yatpitṛbhyaḥ karoti | sa īśvara ārtimārtoḥ | prajāpatistvāvainaṃ tata unnetumarhatītyāhuḥ | yatprājāpatyayarcā punaraiti | prajāpatirevainaṃ tata unnayati | nārtimārchati yajamānaḥ
1.3.10.d: देवानां वा इतरे यज्ञाः । तेन वा एतत्पितृलोके चरति । यत्पितृभ्यः करोति । स ईश्वरः प्रमेतोः । प्राजापत्ययर्चा पुनरैति । यज्ञो वै प्रजापतिः । यज्ञेनैव सह पुनरैति । न प्रमायुको भवति । पितृलोके वा एतद्यजमानश्चरति । यत्पितृभ्यः करोति । स ईश्वर आर्तिमार्तोः । प्रजापतिस्त्वावैनं तत उन्नेतुमर्हतीत्याहुः । यत्प्राजापत्ययर्चा पुनरैति । प्रजापतिरेवैनं तत उन्नयति । नार्तिमार्छति यजमानः
1.3.10.m: The other sacrifices belong to the gods. / Thereby he moves in the world of the fathers / who performs [this rite] for the fathers. / He is liable to perish. / He returns with a verse addressed to Prajāpati. / Sacrifice, indeed, is Prajāpati. / Along with sacrifice itself he returns; / he does not become prone to die. / The sacrificer moves in the world of the fathers / when he performs [the rite] for the fathers. / He is liable to suffer ruin. / They say: "Prajāpati, however, is able to lead him up from there." / Since he returns with a verse addressed to Prajāpati, / Prajāpati himself leads him up from there; / the sacrificer does not suffer ruin.

1.4.1.s: ubhaye vā ete prajāpateradhyasṛjyanta | devāścāsurāśca | tānna vyajānāt | ime'nya ime'nya iti | sa devānaṃ śūnakarot | tānabhyaṣuṇot | tānpavitreṇāpunāt | tānparastātpavitrasya vyagṛhṇāt | te grahā abhavan | tadgrahāṇāṃ grahatvam
1.4.1.d: उभये वा एते प्रजापतेरध्यसृज्यन्त । देवाश्चासुराश्च । तान्न व्यजानात् । इमेऽन्य इमेऽन्य इति । स देवानं शूनकरोत् । तानभ्यषुणोत् । तान्पवित्रेणापुनात् । तान्परस्तात्पवित्रस्य व्यगृह्णात् । ते ग्रहा अभवन् । तद्ग्रहाणां ग्रहत्वम्
1.4.1.m: Both these were created from Prajāpati: / the gods and the asuras. / He did not distinguish them, / saying, "These are one, these are the other." / He made the gods pure. / He pressed them out. / He purified them with a strainer. / Beyond the strainer he drew them off. / They became the soma draughts. / That is the draughtness of the soma draughts.

1.4.1.s: devatā vā etā yajamānasya gṛhe gṛhyante | yadgrahāḥ | vidurenaṃ devāḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣa ete grahā gṛhyante | eṣā vai somasyāhutiḥ | yadupāṃśuḥ | somena devāṃstarpayāṇīti khalu vai somena yajate | yadupāṃśuṃ juhoti | somenaiva taddevāṃstarpayati | yadgrahāñjuhoti
1.4.1.d: देवता वा एता यजमानस्य गृहे गृह्यन्ते । यद्ग्रहाः । विदुरेनं देवाः । यस्यैवं विदुष एते ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते । एषा वै सोमस्याहुतिः । यदुपांशुः । सोमेन देवांस्तर्पयाणीति खलु वै सोमेन यजते । यदुपांशुं जुहोति । सोमेनैव तद्देवांस्तर्पयति । यद्ग्रहाञ्जुहोति
1.4.1.m: These deities, indeed, are drawn in the house of the sacrificer, / namely the soma draughts. / The gods recognize him / for whom, knowing thus, these soma draughts are drawn. / This, indeed, is the oblation of Soma: / the Upāṃśu draught. / "Let me gratify the gods with soma"—thinking thus, indeed, one sacrifices with soma. / When he offers the Upāṃśu draught, / with soma itself he then gratifies the gods. / When he offers the soma draughts,

1.4.1.s: devā eva taddevāngacchanti | yaccamasāñjuhoti | tenaivānurūpeṇa yajamānaḥ suvargaṃ lokameti | kiṃ nvetadagra āsīdityāhuḥ | yatpātrāṇīti | iyaṃ vā etadagra āsīt | mṛnmayāni vā etānyāsan | tairdevā na vyāvṛtamagacchan | ta etāni dārumayāṇi pātrāṇyapaśyan | tānyakurvata
1.4.1.d: देवा एव तद्देवान्गच्छन्ति । यच्चमसाञ्जुहोति । तेनैवानुरूपेण यजमानः सुवर्गं लोकमेति । किं न्वेतदग्र आसीदित्याहुः । यत्पात्राणीति । इयं वा एतदग्र आसीत् । मृन्मयानि वा एतान्यासन् । तैर्देवा न व्यावृतमगच्छन् । त एतानि दारुमयाणि पात्राण्यपश्यन् । तान्यकुर्वत
1.4.1.m: the gods then go to the gods. / When he offers the cups, / by that corresponding form the sacrificer goes to the heavenly realm. / They say, "What, indeed, was this in the beginning?" / with regard to the vessels. / This [earth], indeed, was this in the beginning. / They were of clay. / With them the gods did not attain distinction. / They saw these wooden vessels; / they made them.

1.4.1.s: tairvai te vyāvṛtamagacchan | yaddārumayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti | vyāvṛtameva tairyajamāno gacchati | yāni dārumayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti | amumeva tairlokamabhijayati | yāni mṛnmayāni | imameva tairlokamabhijayati | brahmavādino vadanti | kāścatasraḥ sthālīrvāyavyāḥ somagrahaṇīriti | devā vai pṛśnimaduhran
1.4.1.d: तैर्वै ते व्यावृतमगच्छन् । यद्दारुमयाणि पात्राणि भवन्ति । व्यावृतमेव तैर्यजमानो गच्छति । यानि दारुमयाणि पात्राणि भवन्ति । अमुमेव तैर्लोकमभिजयति । यानि मृन्मयानि । इममेव तैर्लोकमभिजयति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । काश्चतस्रः स्थालीर्वायव्याः सोमग्रहणीरिति । देवा वै पृश्निमदुह्रन्
1.4.1.m: With them, indeed, they attained distinction. / Since the vessels are wooden, / by them the sacrificer attains distinction. / Those vessels that are wooden— / with them he wins that world. / Those that are of clay— / with them he wins this world. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / "Which are the four pots, the soma-holding vessels of Vāyu?" / The gods milked Pṛśni.

1.4.1.s: tasyā ete stanā āsan | iyaṃ vai pṛśniḥ | tāmādityā ādityasthālyā catuṣpadaḥ paśūnaduhran | yadādityasthālī bhavati | catuṣpada eva tayā paśūn yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tāmindra ukthyasthālyendriyamaduhat | yadukthyasthālī bhavati | indriyameva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tāṃ viśve devā āgrayaṇasthālyorjamaduhran | yadāgrayaṇasthālī bhavati
1.4.1.d: तस्या एते स्तना आसन् । इयं वै पृश्निः । तामादित्या आदित्यस्थाल्या चतुष्पदः पशूनदुह्रन् । यदादित्यस्थाली भवति । चतुष्पद एव तया पशून् यजमान इमां दुहे । तामिन्द्र उक्थ्यस्थाल्येन्द्रियमदुहत् । यदुक्थ्यस्थाली भवति । इन्द्रियमेव तया यजमान इमां दुहे । तां विश्वे देवा आग्रयणस्थाल्योर्जमदुह्रन् । यदाग्रयणस्थाली भवति
1.4.1.m: These were her udders. / This [earth], indeed, is Pṛśni. / The Ādityas milked four-footed domestic animals from her by means of the ādityasthālī pot. / Since there is an ādityasthālī pot, / with it the sacrificer milks four-footed domestic animals from this [earth]. / Indra milked Indra's power from her by means of the ukthyasthālī pot. / Since there is an ukthyasthālī pot, / with it the sacrificer milks Indra's power from this [earth]. / The Viśve Devas milked vigor from her by means of the āgrayaṇasthālī pot. / Since there is an āgrayaṇasthālī pot,

1.4.1.s: ūrjameva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tāṃ manuṣyā dhruvasthālyā''yuraduhran | yaddhruvasthālī bhavati | āyureva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | sthālyā gṛhṇāti | vāyavyena juhoti | tasmādanyena pātreṇa paśūnduhanti | anyena pratigṛhṇanti | atho vyāvṛtameva tadyajamāno gacchati
1.4.1.d: ऊर्जमेव तया यजमान इमां दुहे । तां मनुष्या ध्रुवस्थाल्या'ऽयुरदुह्रन् । यद्ध्रुवस्थाली भवति । आयुरेव तया यजमान इमां दुहे । स्थाल्या गृह्णाति । वायव्येन जुहोति । तस्मादन्येन पात्रेण पशून्दुहन्ति । अन्येन प्रतिगृह्णन्ति । अथो व्यावृतमेव तद्यजमानो गच्छति
1.4.1.m: with it the sacrificer milks vigor from this [earth]. / Men milked lifespan from her by means of the dhruvasthālī pot. / Since there is a dhruvasthālī pot, / with it the sacrificer milks lifespan from this [earth]. / He draws with the pot; / he offers with the vāyavya cup. / Therefore they milk domestic animals with one vessel / and receive [the milk] with another. / Moreover, the sacrificer thereby attains distinction.

1.4.2.s: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā | namucāvā'sure sacā | vipipānā śubhaspatī | indraṃ karmasvāvatam | putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhā | indrāvataṃ karmaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ | yathsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ | sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhīṣṇāt | ahāvyagne havirāsye te | srucīva ghṛtaṃ camū iva somaḥ
1.4.2.d: युवं सुराममश्विना । नमुचावाऽसुरे सचा । विपिपाना शुभस्पती । इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम् । पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभा । इन्द्रावतं कर्मणा दंसनाभिः । यथ्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः । सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभीष्णात् । अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते । स्रुचीव घृतं चमू इव सोमः
1.4.2.m:
You two, O Aśvins, lordly drinking
with Namuci, the asura,
O lords of beauty,
aided Indra in his deeds.
Like parents their son, O both Aśvins,
aid Indra with deeds, with wondrous arts,
when thou didst drink off the surā with powers,
[and] Sarasvatī cleansed thee, O Maghavan.
Offered, O Agni, is the oblation into thy mouth,
as ghee in a ladle, as soma in cups.

1.4.2.s: vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīram | praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam | yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇaḥ | vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ | kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase | hṛdā matiṃ janaya cārumagnaye | nānā hi vāṃ devahitaṃ sado mitam | mā saṃsṛkṣāthāṃ parame vyoman | surā tvamasi śuṣmiṇī soma eṣaḥ | mā mā hiṃsīḥ svāṃ yonimāviśan
1.4.2.d: वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् । प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम् । यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणः । वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः । कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे । हृदा मतिं जनय चारुमग्नये । नाना हि वां देवहितं सदो मितम् । मा संसृक्षाथां परमे व्योमन् । सुरा त्वमसि शुष्मिणी सोम एषः । मा मा हिंसीः स्वां योनिमाविशन्

1.4.2.s: yadatra śiṣṭaṃ rasinaḥ sutasya | yadindro apibacchacībhiḥ | ahaṃ tadasya manasā śivena | somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi | dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṛṇām | ahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām | tābhyāmidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti | antarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum | yaste deva varuṇa gāyatrachandāḥ pāśaḥ | taṃ ta etenāvayaje
1.4.2.d: यदत्र शिष्टं रसिनः सुतस्य । यदिन्द्रो अपिबच्छचीभिः । अहं तदस्य मनसा शिवेन । सोमं राजानमिह भक्षयामि । द्वे स्रुती अशृणवं पितृणाम् । अहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् । ताभ्यामिदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति । अन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम् । यस्ते देव वरुण गायत्रछन्दाः पाशः । तं त एतेनावयजे
1.4.2.m:
What is left here of the juicy pressed [soma]
which Indra drank by his powers,
that I partake of here with kindly mind,
king Soma.
Two pathways have I heard of for the fathers,
[and] I [heard of two] for gods and mortals;
by these two this whole world unites,
between the eastern and the western banner.
What noose is thine, O god Varuṇa, of gāyatrī-metre,
that I remove from thee by this.

1.4.2.s: yaste deva varuṇa triṣṭupchandāḥ pāśaḥ | taṃ ta etenāvayaje | yaste deva varuṇa jagatīchandāḥ pāśaḥ | taṃ ta etenāvayaje | somo vā etasya rājyamādatte | yo rājā sanrājyo vā somena yajate | devasuvāmetāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | etāvanto vai devānāṃ savāḥ | ta evāsmai savānprayacchanti | ta enaṃ punaḥ suvante rājyāya | devasū rājā bhavati
1.4.2.d: यस्ते देव वरुण त्रिष्टुप्छन्दाः पाशः । तं त एतेनावयजे । यस्ते देव वरुण जगतीछन्दाः पाशः । तं त एतेनावयजे । सोमो वा एतस्य राज्यमादत्ते । यो राजा सन्राज्यो वा सोमेन यजते । देवसुवामेतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । एतावन्तो वै देवानां सवाः । त एवास्मै सवान्प्रयच्छन्ति । त एनं पुनः सुवन्ते राज्याय । देवसू राजा भवति
1.4.2.m:
What noose is thine, O god Varuṇa, of triṣṭubh-metre,
that I remove from thee by this.
What noose is thine, O god Varuṇa, of jagatī-metre,
that I remove from thee by this.
Soma takes away his kingship
who, being a king or eligible to be king, sacrifices with soma.
These are the oblations of the divine instigators;
so many are the instigations of the gods.
They give him the instigations;
they instigate him again for kingship;
he becomes an instigated king.

1.4.3.s: udasthāddevyaditirviśvarūpī | āyuryajñapatāvadhāt | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgam | mitrāya varuṇāya ca | iyaṃ vā agnihotrī | iyaṃ vā etasya niṣīdati | yasyāgnihotrī niṣīdati | tāmutthāpayet | udasthāddevyaditiriti | iyaṃ vai devyaditiḥ
1.4.3.d: उदस्थाद्देव्यदितिर्विश्वरूपी । आयुर्यज्ञपतावधात् । इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागम् । मित्राय वरुणाय च । इयं वा अग्निहोत्री । इयं वा एतस्य निषीदति । यस्याग्निहोत्री निषीदति । तामुत्थापयेत् । उदस्थाद्देव्यदितिरिति । इयं वै देव्यदितिः
1.4.3.m:
The divine Aditi of all forms has stood up;
she has placed lifespan in the lord of the sacrifice,
making a portion for Indra,
and for Mitra and Varuṇa.
This indeed is the Agnihotra cow;
this indeed sinks down for him
whose Agnihotra cow sinks down.
He should make her rise,
saying: 'The divine Aditi has stood up.'
This indeed is the divine Aditi.

1.4.3.s: imāmevāsmā utthāpayati | āyuryajñapatāvadhādityāha | āyurevāsmindadhāti | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya cetyāha | yathā yajurevaitat | avartiṃ vā eṣaitasya pāpmānaṃ pratikhyāya niṣīdati | yasyāgnihotryupasṛṣṭā niṣīdati | tāṃ dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | yasyānnaṃ nādyāt | avartimevāsminpāpmānaṃ pratimuñcati
1.4.3.d: इमामेवास्मा उत्थापयति । आयुर्यज्ञपतावधादित्याह । आयुरेवास्मिन्दधाति । इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागं मित्राय वरुणाय चेत्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत् । अवर्तिं वा एषैतस्य पाप्मानं प्रतिख्याय निषीदति । यस्याग्निहोत्र्युपसृष्टा निषीदति । तां दुग्ध्वा ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् । यस्यान्नं नाद्यात् । अवर्तिमेवास्मिन्पाप्मानं प्रतिमुञ्चति
1.4.3.m:
He raises this [earth] up for him.
'She has placed lifespan in the lord of the sacrifice,' he says;
he places lifespan in him.
'Making a portion for Indra, and for Mitra and Varuṇa,' he says;
this is according to the sacrificial formula.
Having perceived his distress, his evil, she sits down,
whose Agnihotra cow, having been let loose [to the calf], sits down.
Having milked her, he should give her to a Brahmin
whose food he would not eat.
He fastens distress, evil, onto him.

1.4.3.s: dugdhvā dadāti | na hyadṛṣṭā dakṣiṇā dīyate | pṛthivīṃ vā etasya payaḥ praviśati | yasyāgnihotraṃ duhyamānaṃ skandati | yadadya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīmasakta | yadoṣadhīrapyasaradyadāpaḥ | payo gṛheṣu payo aghniyāsu | payo vathseṣu payo astu tanmayītyāha | paya evātmangṛheṣu paśuṣu dhatte | apa upasṛjati
1.4.3.d: दुग्ध्वा ददाति । न ह्यदृष्टा दक्षिणा दीयते । पृथिवीं वा एतस्य पयः प्रविशति । यस्याग्निहोत्रं दुह्यमानं स्कन्दति । यदद्य दुग्धं पृथिवीमसक्त । यदोषधीरप्यसरद्यदापः । पयो गृहेषु पयो अघ्नियासु । पयो वथ्सेषु पयो अस्तु तन्मयीत्याह । पय एवात्मन्गृहेषु पशुषु धत्ते । अप उपसृजति
1.4.3.m:
He gives [her] after milking;
for an unseen sacrificial fee is not given.
The milk of him enters the earth
whose Agnihotra, while being milked, spills.
'What milked today has clung to the earth,
what has flowed to the plants, what to the waters,
milk in the houses, milk in the cows,
milk in the calves, may that milk be in me,' he says.
He places milk in himself, in his houses, in his cattle.
He pours water on it.

1.4.3.s: adbhirevainadāpnoti | yo vai yajñasyārtenānārtaṃ saṃsṛjati | ubhe vai te tarhyārchataḥ | ārchati khalu vā etadagnihotram | yadduhyamānagg skandati | yadabhiduhyāt | ārtenānārtaṃ yajñasya saṃsṛjet | tadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyam | athānyāṃ dugdhvā punar hotavyam | anārtenaivārtaṃ yajñasya niṣkaroti
1.4.3.d: अद्भिरेवैनदाप्नोति । यो वै यज्ञस्यार्तेनानार्तं संसृजति । उभे वै ते तर्ह्यार्छतः । आर्छति खलु वा एतदग्निहोत्रम् । यद्दुह्यमानग्ग् स्कन्दति । यदभिदुह्यात् । आर्तेनानार्तं यज्ञस्य संसृजेत् । तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यम् । अथान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् होतव्यम् । अनार्तेनैवार्तं यज्ञस्य निष्करोति
1.4.3.m:
With water he overtakes it.
He who mingles the afflicted with the unafflicted of the sacrifice,
both of them then suffer affliction.
Indeed, this Agnihotra suffers affliction,
which spills while being milked.
If he should milk more onto it,
he would mingle the afflicted with the unafflicted of the sacrifice.
Whatever it is like, it should just be offered;
then, having milked another [cow], one should offer again.
By means of the unafflicted he restores the afflicted of the sacrifice.

1.4.3.s: yadyuddrutasya skandet | yattato'hutvā punareyāt | yajñaṃ vicchindyāt | yatra skandet | tanniṣadya punargṛhṇīyāt | yatraiva skandati | tata evainatpunargṛhṇāti | tadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hotavyam | athānyāṃ dugdhvā punar hotavyam | anārtenaivārtaṃ yajñasya niṣkaroti
1.4.3.d: यद्युद्द्रुतस्य स्कन्देत् । यत्ततोऽहुत्वा पुनरेयात् । यज्ञं विच्छिन्द्यात् । यत्र स्कन्देत् । तन्निषद्य पुनर्गृह्णीयात् । यत्रैव स्कन्दति । तत एवैनत्पुनर्गृह्णाति । तदेव यादृक्कीदृक्च होतव्यम् । अथान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् होतव्यम् । अनार्तेनैवार्तं यज्ञस्य निष्करोति
1.4.3.m:
If it should spill of one who has run up,
if, not having offered from that, he should go back,
he would cut off the sacrifice.
Where it spills,
sitting down there, he should take [milk] again.
Just where it spills,
from there he takes it again.
Whatever it is like, it should just be offered;
then, having milked another [cow], one should offer again.
By means of the unafflicted he restores the afflicted of the sacrifice.

1.4.3.s: vi vā etasya yajñaśchidyate | yasyāgnihotre'dhiśrite śvā'ntarā dhāvati | rudraḥ khalu vā eṣaḥ | yadagniḥ | yadgāmanvatyāvartayet | rudrāya paśūnapidadhyāt | apaśuryajamānaḥ syāt | yadapo'nvatiṣiñcet | anādyamagnerāpaḥ | anādyamābhyāmapi dadhyāt | gārhapatyādbhasmādāya | idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vaiṣṇavyarcā'havanīyāddhvaṃsayannuddravet | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñenaiva yajñaṃ saṃtanoti | bhasmanā padamapi vapati śāntyai
1.4.3.d: वि वा एतस्य यज्ञश्छिद्यते । यस्याग्निहोत्रेऽधिश्रिते श्वाऽन्तरा धावति । रुद्रः खलु वा एषः । यदग्निः । यद्गामन्वत्यावर्तयेत् । रुद्राय पशूनपिदध्यात् । अपशुर्यजमानः स्यात् । यदपोऽन्वतिषिञ्चेत् । अनाद्यमग्नेरापः । अनाद्यमाभ्यामपि दध्यात् । गार्हपत्याद्भस्मादाय । इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रम इति वैष्णव्यर्चाऽहवनीयाद्ध्वंसयन्नुद्द्रवेत् । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । यज्ञेनैव यज्ञं संतनोति । भस्मना पदमपि वपति शान्त्यै
1.4.3.m:
The sacrifice of him is severed
across whose Agnihotra, when set on the fire, a dog runs.
This indeed is Rudra,
namely, Agni.
If he were to lead a cow across after it,
he would deliver the cattle to Rudra;
the sacrificer would be without cattle.
If he were to sprinkle water after it,
waters are non-food for Agni;
he would deliver non-food to both of them.
Having taken ashes from the Gārhapatya,
he should run up scattering them from the Āhavanīya with the verse to Viṣṇu: 'This Viṣṇu...';
Viṣṇu indeed is the sacrifice;
by means of the sacrifice he stretches out the sacrifice.
He covers the footprint with ashes for appeasement.

1.4.4.s: ni vā etasyāhavanīyo gārhapatyaṃ kāmayate | ni gārhapatya āhavanīyam | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhinimrocati | darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ prabadhya purastāddharet | athāgnim | athāgnihotram | yaddhiraṇyaṃ purastāddharati | jyotirvai hiraṇyam | jyotirevainaṃ paśyannuddharati | yadagniṃ pūrvaṃ haratyathāgnihotram
1.4.4.d: नि वा एतस्याहवनीयो गार्हपत्यं कामयते । नि गार्हपत्य आहवनीयम् । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभिनिम्रोचति । दर्भेण हिरण्यं प्रबध्य पुरस्ताद्धरेत् । अथाग्निम् । अथाग्निहोत्रम् । यद्धिरण्यं पुरस्ताद्धरति । ज्योतिर्वै हिरण्यम् । ज्योतिरेवैनं पश्यन्नुद्धरति । यदग्निं पूर्वं हरत्यथाग्निहोत्रम्
1.4.4.m:
His Āhavanīya yearns for the Gārhapatya,
and the Gārhapatya for the Āhavanīya,
over whose un-taken-out fire the sun sets.
Having tied gold with darbha grass, he should carry it in front,
then the fire,
then the Agnihotra [milk].
In that he carries gold in front,
gold is light;
looking upon light he takes it out.
In that he carries the fire first, then the Agnihotra [milk],

1.4.4.s: bhāgadheyenaivainaṃ praṇayati | brāhmaṇa ārṣeya uddharet | brāhmaṇo vai sarvā devatāḥ | sarvābhirevainaṃ devatābhiruddharati | agnihotramupasādyātamitorāsīta | vratameva hatamanu mriyate | antaṃ vā eṣa ātmano gacchati | yastāmyati | antameṣa yajñasya gacchati | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhinimrocati
1.4.4.d: भागधेयेनैवैनं प्रणयति । ब्राह्मण आर्षेय उद्धरेत् । ब्राह्मणो वै सर्वा देवताः । सर्वाभिरेवैनं देवताभिरुद्धरति । अग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्यातमितोरासीत । व्रतमेव हतमनु म्रियते । अन्तं वा एष आत्मनो गच्छति । यस्ताम्यति । अन्तमेष यज्ञस्य गच्छति । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभिनिम्रोचति
1.4.4.m:
with its proper share he leads it forward.
A Brahmin of ṛṣi descent should take it out.
A Brahmin is all the deities;
with all the deities he takes it out.
Having set down the Agnihotra, he should sit until holding his breath.
He dies along with the broken vow.
He goes to the end of himself
who suffocates.
He goes to the end of the sacrifice
over whose un-taken-out fire the sun sets.

1.4.4.s: punaḥ samanya juhoti | antenaivāntaṃ yajñasya niṣkaroti | varuṇo vā etasya yajñaṃ gṛhṇāti | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhinimrocati | vāruṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet | tenaiva yajñaṃ niṣkrīṇīte | ni vā etasyāhavanīyo gārhapatyaṃ kāmayate | ni gārhapatya āhavanīyam | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhyudeti | caturgṛhītamājyaṃ purastāddharet
1.4.4.d: पुनः समन्य जुहोति । अन्तेनैवान्तं यज्ञस्य निष्करोति । वरुणो वा एतस्य यज्ञं गृह्णाति । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभिनिम्रोचति । वारुणं चरुं निर्वपेत् । तेनैव यज्ञं निष्क्रीणीते । नि वा एतस्याहवनीयो गार्हपत्यं कामयते । नि गार्हपत्य आहवनीयम् । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभ्युदेति । चतुर्गृहीतमाज्यं पुरस्ताद्धरेत्
1.4.4.m:
Breathing again, he offers.
By the end he restores the end of the sacrifice.
Varuṇa seizes the sacrifice of him
over whose un-taken-out fire the sun sets.
He should distribute a boiled offering to Varuṇa.
By that he redeems the sacrifice.
His Āhavanīya yearns for the Gārhapatya,
and the Gārhapatya for the Āhavanīya,
over whose un-taken-out fire the sun rises.
He should carry four-times-scooped ghee in front.

1.4.4.s: athāgnim | athāgnihotram | yadājyaṃ purastāddharati | etadvā agneḥ priyaṃ dhāma | yadājyam | priyeṇaivainaṃ dhāmnā samardhayati | yadagniṃ pūrvaṃ haratyathāgnihotram | bhāgadheyenaivainaṃ praṇayati | brāhmaṇa ārṣeya uddharet | brāhmaṇo vai sarvā devatāḥ
1.4.4.d: अथाग्निम् । अथाग्निहोत्रम् । यदाज्यं पुरस्ताद्धरति । एतद्वा अग्नेः प्रियं धाम । यदाज्यम् । प्रियेणैवैनं धाम्ना समर्धयति । यदग्निं पूर्वं हरत्यथाग्निहोत्रम् । भागधेयेनैवैनं प्रणयति । ब्राह्मण आर्षेय उद्धरेत् । ब्राह्मणो वै सर्वा देवताः
1.4.4.m: Then the fire; / then the agnihotra. / When he carries ghee in front, / this, indeed, is the dear abode of Agni, / namely ghee. / With his dear abode he provides him fully. / When he carries the fire first and then the agnihotra, / he brings him forth with his proper share. / A Brahmin of ṛṣi descent should take [it] out; / for the Brahmin is all deities.

1.4.4.s: sarvābhirevainaṃ devatābhiruddharati | parācī vā etasmai vyucchantī vyucchati | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhyudeti | uṣāḥ ketunā juṣatām | yajñaṃ devebhirinvitam | devebhyo madhumattamagg svāheti pratyaṅṅ niṣadyājyena juhuyāt | pratīcīmevāsmai vivāsayati | agnihotramupasādyātamitorāsīta | vratameva hatamanu mriyate | antaṃ vā eṣa ātmano gacchati
1.4.4.d: सर्वाभिरेवैनं देवताभिरुद्धरति । पराची वा एतस्मै व्युच्छन्ती व्युच्छति । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभ्युदेति । उषाः केतुना जुषताम् । यज्ञं देवेभिरिन्वितम् । देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमग्ग् स्वाहेति प्रत्यङ्ङ् निषद्याज्येन जुहुयात् । प्रतीचीमेवास्मै विवासयति । अग्निहोत्रमुपसाद्यातमितोरासीत । व्रतमेव हतमनु म्रियते । अन्तं वा एष आत्मनो गच्छति
1.4.4.m:
With all deities indeed he takes it up.
Facing away indeed the dawning [dawn] dawns for him
over whose un-taken-up fire the sun rises.
"Let the Dawn enjoy the sacrifice with its banner,
with the gods, / [a sacrifice] most honey-rich for the gods"—having sat down facing west, he should offer with clarified butter.
He makes her turn towards him.
Having deposited the agnihotra, he should sit until he faints.
He dies along with the broken vow;
he indeed goes to the end of himself.

1.4.4.s: yastāmyati | antameṣa yajñasya gacchati | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhyudeti | punaḥ samanya juhoti | antenaivāntaṃ yajñasya niṣkaroti | mitro vā etasya yajñaṃ gṛhṇāti | yasyāgnimanuddhṛtaṃ sūryo'bhyudeti | maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet | tenaiva yajñaṃ niṣkrīṇīte | yasyāhavanīye'nudvāte gārhapatya udvāyet
1.4.4.d: यस्ताम्यति । अन्तमेष यज्ञस्य गच्छति । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभ्युदेति । पुनः समन्य जुहोति । अन्तेनैवान्तं यज्ञस्य निष्करोति । मित्रो वा एतस्य यज्ञं गृह्णाति । यस्याग्निमनुद्धृतं सूर्योऽभ्युदेति । मैत्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् । तेनैव यज्ञं निष्क्रीणीते । यस्याहवनीयेऽनुद्वाते गार्हपत्य उद्वायेत्
1.4.4.m:
He who faints,
he goes to the end of the sacrifice.
For him over whose un-taken-up fire the sun rises,
he offers having gathered it again.
By the end indeed he repairs the end of the sacrifice.
Mitra indeed seizes the sacrifice of him
over whose un-taken-up fire the sun rises.
He should offer a mess of boiled rice to Mitra.
By that indeed he redeems the sacrifice.
If, while the āhavanīya fire has not gone out, the gārhapatya fire should go out:

1.4.4.s: yadāhavanīyamanudvāpya gārhapatyaṃ manthet | vicchindyāt | bhrātṛvyamasmai janayet | yadvai yajñasya vāstavyaṃ kriyate | tadanu rudro'vacarati | yatpūrvamanvavasyet | vāstavyamagnimupāsīta | rudro'sya paśūnghātukaḥ syāt | āhavanīyamudvāpya | gārhapatyaṃ manthet
1.4.4.d: यदाहवनीयमनुद्वाप्य गार्हपत्यं मन्थेत् । विच्छिन्द्यात् । भ्रातृव्यमस्मै जनयेत् । यद्वै यज्ञस्य वास्तव्यं क्रियते । तदनु रुद्रोऽवचरति । यत्पूर्वमन्ववस्येत् । वास्तव्यमग्निमुपासीत । रुद्रोऽस्य पशून्घातुकः स्यात् । आहवनीयमुद्वाप्य । गार्हपत्यं मन्थेत्
1.4.4.m:
If, without letting the āhavanīya go out, he should churn the gārhapatya,
he would cause a disruption;
he would generate a rival for him.
Whatever part of the sacrifice is left at the homestead,
along that Rudra prowls.
If he were to settle along the first [fire],
he would serve a homestead-dwelling fire;
Rudra would be likely to slay his domestic animals.
Having extinguished the āhavanīya,
he should churn the gārhapatya.

1.4.4.s: itaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agniḥ | svādyoneradhi jātavedāḥ | sa gāyatriyā triṣṭubhā jagatyā | devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānanniti | chandobhirevainaṃ svādyoneḥ prajanayati | gārhapatyaṃ manthati | gārhapatyaṃ vā anvāhitāgneḥ paśava upatiṣṭhante | sa yadudvāyati | tadanu paśavo'pa krāmanti | iṣe rayyai ramasva
1.4.4.d: इतः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निः । स्वाद्योनेरधि जातवेदाः । स गायत्रिया त्रिष्टुभा जगत्या । देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्निति । छन्दोभिरेवैनं स्वाद्योनेः प्रजनयति । गार्हपत्यं मन्थति । गार्हपत्यं वा अन्वाहिताग्नेः पशव उपतिष्ठन्ते । स यदुद्वायति । तदनु पशवोऽप क्रामन्ति । इषे रय्यै रमस्व
1.4.4.m:
"From here Agni was born first,
Jātavedas from his own womb;
may he, knowing, carry the offering to the gods
with the gāyatrī, the triṣṭubh, the jagatī"—[reciting] this,
by the metres indeed he generates him from his own womb.
He churns the gārhapatya.
Upon the gārhapatya indeed the domestic animals of the one who has established the fires wait.
When it goes out,
then along with it the domestic animals wander away.
"Rest for refreshment, for wealth,

1.4.4.s: sahase dyumnāya | ūrje patyāyetyāha | paśavo vai rayiḥ | paśūnevāsmai ramayati | sārasvatau tvothsau samindhātāmityāha | ṛkhsāme vai sārasvatāvuthsau | ṛkhsāmābhyāmevainaṃ samindhe | samrāḍasi virāḍasītyāha | rathantaraṃ vai samrāṭ | bṛhadvirāṭ
1.4.4.d: सहसे द्युम्नाय । ऊर्जे पत्यायेत्याह । पशवो वै रयिः । पशूनेवास्मै रमयति । सारस्वतौ त्वोथ्सौ समिन्धातामित्याह । ऋख्सामे वै सारस्वतावुथ्सौ । ऋख्सामाभ्यामेवैनं समिन्धे । सम्राडसि विराडसीत्याह । रथन्तरं वै सम्राट् । बृहद्विराट्

1.4.4.s: tābhyāmevainaṃ samindhe | vajro vai cakram | vajro vā etasya yajñaṃ vicchinatti | yasyāno vā ratho vā'ntarā'gnī yāti | āhavanīyamudvāpya | gārhapatyāduddharet | yadagne pūrvaṃ prabhṛtaṃ padaṃ hi te | sūryasya raśmīnanvātatāna | tatra rayiṣṭhāmanu saṃbharaitam | saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyeti
1.4.4.d: ताभ्यामेवैनं समिन्धे । वज्रो वै चक्रम् । वज्रो वा एतस्य यज्ञं विच्छिनत्ति । यस्यानो वा रथो वाऽन्तराऽग्नी याति । आहवनीयमुद्वाप्य । गार्हपत्यादुद्धरेत् । यदग्ने पूर्वं प्रभृतं पदं हि ते । सूर्यस्य रश्मीनन्वाततान । तत्र रयिष्ठामनु संभरैतम् । सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्येति
1.4.4.m:
With the two indeed he kindles him.
A thunderbolt indeed is a wheel;
a thunderbolt indeed cuts off the sacrifice of him
between whose fires a cart or a chariot travels.
Having extinguished the āhavanīya fire,
he should take it up from the gārhapatya fire.
"Agni, what former step of yours was set forward,
and extended along the rays of the sun,
there bring this [wealth] together with that which rests in wealth;
unite us with [your] benevolence rich in vigor"—
with the former sacrifice indeed he extends his sacrifice continuously.
"You, Agni, are far-spreading," he says.
Agni is all the deities;
with the deities indeed he extends the sacrifice continuously.
He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Pathikṛt.
He runs toward Agni Pathikṛt with his own share;
he indeed leads him back onto the path of sacrifice.
A draft ox is the sacrificial gift;
for he is a bearer, for success.

1.4.4.s: pūrveṇaivāsya yajñena yajñamanu saṃ tanoti | tvamagne saprathā asītyāha | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhireva yajñaṃ saṃ tanoti | agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | agnimeva pathikṛtaṃ svena bhāgadheyenopa dhāvati | sa evainaṃ yajñiyaṃ panthāmapi nayati | anaḍvāndakṣiṇā | vahī hyeṣa samṛddhyai
1.4.4.d: पूर्वेणैवास्य यज्ञेन यज्ञमनु सं तनोति । त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असीत्याह । अग्निः सर्वा देवताः । देवताभिरेव यज्ञं सं तनोति । अग्नये पथिकृते पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् । अग्निमेव पथिकृतं स्वेन भागधेयेनोप धावति । स एवैनं यज्ञियं पन्थामपि नयति । अनड्वान्दक्षिणा । वही ह्येष समृद्ध्यै

1.4.5.s: yasya prātaḥsavane somo'tiricyate | mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ kāmayamāno'bhyatiricyate | gaurdhayati marutāmiti dhayadvatīṣu kurvanti | hinasti vai sandhyadhītam | sandhīva khalu vā etat | yathsavanasyātiricyate | yaddhayadvatīṣu kurvanti | sandheḥ śāntyai | gāyatraṃ sāma bhavati pañcadaśaḥ stomaḥ | tenaiva prātaḥsavanānna yanti
1.4.5.d: यस्य प्रातःसवने सोमोऽतिरिच्यते । माध्यन्दिनं सवनं कामयमानोऽभ्यतिरिच्यते । गौर्धयति मरुतामिति धयद्वतीषु कुर्वन्ति । हिनस्ति वै सन्ध्यधीतम् । सन्धीव खलु वा एतत् । यथ्सवनस्यातिरिच्यते । यद्धयद्वतीषु कुर्वन्ति । सन्धेः शान्त्यै । गायत्रं साम भवति पञ्चदशः स्तोमः । तेनैव प्रातःसवनान्न यन्ति
1.4.5.m:
For whom soma remains over at the morning pressing,
it remains over as desiring the midday pressing.
"The cow of the Maruts suckles"—they perform [it] on verses containing "suckles".
What is recited at a juncture indeed injures;
this indeed is like a juncture,
which remains over from a pressing.
In that they perform on verses containing "suckles",
[it is] for the appeasement of the juncture.
The sāman is the Gāyatra, the stoma is the fifteenfold [stoma];
by that indeed they do not depart from the morning pressing.

1.4.5.s: marutvatīṣu kurvanti | tenaiva mādhyandināthsavanānna yanti | hotuścamasamanūnnayante | hotā'nuśaṃsati | madhyata eva yajñaṃ samādadhāti | yasya mādhyandine savane somo'tiricyate | ādityaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ kāmayamāno'bhyatiricyate | gaurivītaṃ sāma bhavati | atiriktaṃ vai gaurivītam | atiriktaṃ yathsavanasyātiricyate
1.4.5.d: मरुत्वतीषु कुर्वन्ति । तेनैव माध्यन्दिनाथ्सवनान्न यन्ति । होतुश्चमसमनून्नयन्ते । होताऽनुशंसति । मध्यत एव यज्ञं समादधाति । यस्य माध्यन्दिने सवने सोमोऽतिरिच्यते । आदित्यं तृतीयसवनं कामयमानोऽभ्यतिरिच्यते । गौरिवीतं साम भवति । अतिरिक्तं वै गौरिवीतम् । अतिरिक्तं यथ्सवनस्यातिरिच्यते

1.4.5.s: atiriktasya śāntyai | baṇmahāṃ asi sūryeti kurvanti | yasyaivādityasya savanasya kāmenātiricyate | tenaivainaṃ kāmena samardhayanti | gaurivītaṃ sāma bhavati | tenaiva mādhyandināthsavanānna yanti | saptadaśaḥ stomaḥ | tenaiva tṛtīyasavanānna yanti | hotuścamasamanūnnayante | hotā'nuśaṃsati
1.4.5.d: अतिरिक्तस्य शान्त्यै । बण्महां असि सूर्येति कुर्वन्ति । यस्यैवादित्यस्य सवनस्य कामेनातिरिच्यते । तेनैवैनं कामेन समर्धयन्ति । गौरिवीतं साम भवति । तेनैव माध्यन्दिनाथ्सवनान्न यन्ति । सप्तदशः स्तोमः । तेनैव तृतीयसवनान्न यन्ति । होतुश्चमसमनून्नयन्ते । होताऽनुशंसति

1.4.5.s: madhyata eva yajñaṃ samādadhāti | yasya tṛtīyasavane somo'tiricyeta | ukthyaṃ kurvīta | yasyokthye'tiricyeta | atirātraṃ kurvīta | yasyātirātre'tiricyate | tattvai duṣprajñānam | yajamānaṃ vā etatpaśava āsāhya yanti | bṛhathsāma bhavati | bṛhadvā imān lokāndādhāra | bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | bṛhataivāsmai paśūndādhāra | śipiviṣṭavatīṣu kurvanti | śipiviṣṭo vai devānāṃ puṣṭam | puṣṭyaivainaṃ samardhayanti | hotuścamasamanūnnayante | hotā'nuśaṃsati | madhyata eva yajñaṃ samādadhāti
1.4.5.d: मध्यत एव यज्ञं समादधाति । यस्य तृतीयसवने सोमोऽतिरिच्येत । उक्थ्यं कुर्वीत । यस्योक्थ्येऽतिरिच्येत । अतिरात्रं कुर्वीत । यस्यातिरात्रेऽतिरिच्यते । तत्त्वै दुष्प्रज्ञानम् । यजमानं वा एतत्पशव आसाह्य यन्ति । बृहथ्साम भवति । बृहद्वा इमान् लोकान्दाधार । बार्हताः पशवः । बृहतैवास्मै पशून्दाधार । शिपिविष्टवतीषु कुर्वन्ति । शिपिविष्टो वै देवानां पुष्टम् । पुष्ट्यैवैनं समर्धयन्ति । होतुश्चमसमनून्नयन्ते । होताऽनुशंसति । मध्यत एव यज्ञं समादधाति
1.4.5.m:
In the middle indeed he connects the sacrifice.
For whom soma should remain over at the third pressing,
he should perform an Ukthya.
For whom it should remain over at an Ukthya,
he should perform an Atirātra.
For whom it should remain over at an Atirātra—
that indeed is difficult to discern.
The domestic animals indeed go overpowering the sacrificer at this.
The sāman is the Bṛhat;
the Bṛhat indeed upheld these worlds;
domestic animals belong to the Bṛhat;
by the Bṛhat indeed he upholds the domestic animals for him.
They perform on verses containing "śipiviṣṭa"; Śipiviṣṭa indeed is the fatness of the gods;
with nourishment indeed they cause him to prosper.
They draw [soma] into the Hotṛ's cup;
the Hotṛ recites along.
In the middle indeed he connects the sacrifice.

1.4.6.s: ekaiko vai janatāyāmindraḥ | ekaṃ vā etāvindramabhi saṃsunutaḥ | yau dvau saṃsunutaḥ | prajāpatirvā eṣa vitāyate | yadyajñaḥ | tasya grāvāṇo dantāḥ | anyataraṃ vā ete saṃsunvatornirbapsati | pūrveṇopasṛtyā devatā ityāhuḥ | pūrvopasṛtasya vai śreyānbhavati | etivantyājyāni bhavantyabhijityai
1.4.6.d: एकैको वै जनतायामिन्द्रः । एकं वा एताविन्द्रमभि संसुनुतः । यौ द्वौ संसुनुतः । प्रजापतिर्वा एष वितायते । यद्यज्ञः । तस्य ग्रावाणो दन्ताः । अन्यतरं वा एते संसुन्वतोर्निर्बप्सति । पूर्वेणोपसृत्या देवता इत्याहुः । पूर्वोपसृतस्य वै श्रेयान्भवति । एतिवन्त्याज्यानि भवन्त्यभिजित्यै
1.4.6.m:
One by one indeed is Indra in the people.
Upon one Indra indeed these two press together,
whoever two press together.
Prajāpati indeed expands here,
namely the sacrifice.
Its teeth are the pressing-stones.
These [teeth] chew up one or the other of the two who press together.
"Deities are to be approached with precedence," they say.
He who approaches first becomes the superior.
The butter portions have "eti" [going forward] for conquest.

1.4.6.s: marutvatīḥ pratipadaḥ | maruto vai devānāmaparājitamāyatanam | devānāmevāparājita āyatane yatate | ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavataḥ | iyaṃ vāva rathantaram | asau bṛhat | ābhyāmevainamantareti | vācaśca manasaśca | prāṇāccāpānācca | divaśca pṛthivyāśca
1.4.6.d: मरुत्वतीः प्रतिपदः । मरुतो वै देवानामपराजितमायतनम् । देवानामेवापराजित आयतने यतते । उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतः । इयं वाव रथन्तरम् । असौ बृहत् । आभ्यामेवैनमन्तरेति । वाचश्च मनसश्च । प्राणाच्चापानाच्च । दिवश्च पृथिव्याश्च

1.4.6.s: sarvasmādvittādvedyāt | abhivarto brahmasāmaṃ bhavati | suvargasya lokasyābhivṛttyai | abhijidbhavati | suvargasya lokasyābhijityai | viśvajidbhavati | viśvasya jityai | yasya bhūyāṃso yajñakratava ityāhuḥ | sa devatā vṛṅkta iti | yadyagniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ parastāthsyāt
1.4.6.d: सर्वस्माद्वित्ताद्वेद्यात् । अभिवर्तो ब्रह्मसामं भवति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिवृत्त्यै । अभिजिद्भवति । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्याभिजित्यै । विश्वजिद्भवति । विश्वस्य जित्यै । यस्य भूयांसो यज्ञक्रतव इत्याहुः । स देवता वृङ्क्त इति । यद्यग्निष्टोमः सोमः परस्ताथ्स्यात्
1.4.6.m: From all acquired property that is to be acquired, / the Abhivarta becomes the Brahmasāman / for the encompassment of the heavenly realm. / The Abhijit takes place / for the conquest of the heavenly realm. / The Viśvajit takes place / for the conquest of all. / "He whose sacrifice-rituals are more numerous," they say, / "he takes the deities for himself." / If the Soma [sacrifice] beyond were an Agniṣṭoma,

1.4.6.s: ukthyaṃ kurvīta | yadyukthyaḥ syāt | atirātraṃ kurvīta | yajñakratubhirevāsya devatā vṛṅkte | yo vai chandobhirabhibhavati | sa saṃsunvatorabhibhavati | saṃveśāya tvopaveśāya tvetyāha | chandāṃsi vai saṃveśa upaveśaḥ | chandobhirevāsya chandāṃsyabhibhavati | iṣṭargo vā ṛtvijāmadhvaryuḥ
1.4.6.d: उक्थ्यं कुर्वीत । यद्युक्थ्यः स्यात् । अतिरात्रं कुर्वीत । यज्ञक्रतुभिरेवास्य देवता वृङ्क्ते । यो वै छन्दोभिरभिभवति । स संसुन्वतोरभिभवति । संवेशाय त्वोपवेशाय त्वेत्याह । छन्दांसि वै संवेश उपवेशः । छन्दोभिरेवास्य छन्दांस्यभिभवति । इष्टर्गो वा ऋत्विजामध्वर्युः
1.4.6.m: he should perform an Ukthya. / If it were an Ukthya, / he should perform an Atirātra. / By means of the sacrifice-rituals he takes the deities for himself. / He who indeed overpowers through the meters, / he overpowers of the two who are pressing simultaneously. / "For lying down, thee; for sitting down, thee," he says. / The meters indeed are lying down and sitting down. / Through the meters he overpowers his meters. / The Adhvaryu is the cleanser of the priests.

1.4.6.s: iṣṭargaḥ khalu vai pūrvo'rṣṭuḥ kṣīyate | prāṇāpānau mṛtyormā pātamityāha | prāṇāpānayoreva śrayate | prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭamityāha | nainaṃ purā''yuṣaḥ prāṇāpānau jahitaḥ | ārtiṃ vā ete niyanti | yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate | taṃ yadavavarjeyuḥ | krūrakṛtāmivaiṣāṃ lokaḥ syāt | āhara daheti brūyāt
1.4.6.d: इष्टर्गः खलु वै पूर्वोऽर्ष्टुः क्षीयते । प्राणापानौ मृत्योर्मा पातमित्याह । प्राणापानयोरेव श्रयते । प्राणापानौ मा मा हासिष्टमित्याह । नैनं पुरा'ऽयुषः प्राणापानौ जहितः । आर्तिं वा एते नियन्ति । येषां दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते । तं यदववर्जेयुः । क्रूरकृतामिवैषां लोकः स्यात् । आहर दहेति ब्रूयात्
1.4.6.m: The cleanser indeed is consumed before the person being cleansed. / "May exhalation and inhalation protect me from death," he says. / In exhalation and inhalation he rests. / "May exhalation and inhalation not abandon me," he says. / Exhalation and inhalation do not abandon him before his lifespan. / They indeed incur misfortune / among whom an initiated person dies. / If they were to cast him away, / their realm would be as that of doers of cruelty. / "Bring [him], burn [him]!" he should say.

1.4.6.s: taṃ dakṣiṇato vedyai nidhāya | sarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuyuḥ | iyaṃ vai sarpato rājñī | asyā evainaṃ paridadati | vyṛddhaṃ tadityāhuḥ | yathstutamananuśastamiti | hotā prathamaḥ prācīnāvītī mārjālīyaṃ parīyāt | yāmīranubruvan | sarparājñīnāṃ kīrtayet | ubhayorevainaṃ lokayoḥ paridadati
1.4.6.d: तं दक्षिणतो वेद्यै निधाय । सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिः स्तुयुः । इयं वै सर्पतो राज्ञी । अस्या एवैनं परिददति । व्यृद्धं तदित्याहुः । यथ्स्तुतमननुशस्तमिति । होता प्रथमः प्राचीनावीती मार्जालीयं परीयात् । यामीरनुब्रुवन् । सर्पराज्ञीनां कीर्तयेत् । उभयोरेवैनं लोकयोः परिददति
1.4.6.m: Having placed him to the south of the altar, / they should praise with the verses of the Queen of Serpents. / This [earth] indeed is the Queen of the Serpents. / To her indeed they commit him. / "Deficient is that," they say, / "which is chanted [by the Sāman-singers] but not recited [by the Hotṛ]." / The Hotṛ first, with his sacred thread over the right shoulder, should walk around the Mārjālīya, / reciting verses addressed to Yama. / He should mention those of the Queen of Serpents. / To both worlds indeed they commit him.

1.4.6.s: atho dhuvantyevainam | atho nyevāsmai hnuvate | triḥ pariyanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyo dhuvate | triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | ṣaṭth saṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtubhirevainaṃ dhuvate | agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipadaṃ kurvīran | rathantarasāmaiṣāṃ somaḥ syāt | āyurevātmandadhate | atho pāpmānameva vijahato yanti
1.4.6.d: अथो धुवन्त्येवैनम् । अथो न्येवास्मै ह्नुवते । त्रिः परियन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभ्य एवैनं लोकेभ्यो धुवते । त्रिः पुनः परियन्ति । षट्थ् संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतुभिरेवैनं धुवते । अग्न आयूंषि पवस इति प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् । रथन्तरसामैषां सोमः स्यात् । आयुरेवात्मन्दधते । अथो पाप्मानमेव विजहतो यन्ति
1.4.6.m: Then they shake him, / and they make amends to him. / Three times they walk around. / Three are these worlds. / From these worlds they shake him. / Three times they walk around again. / They amount to six. / Six indeed are the seasons. / By the seasons they shake him. / "O Agni, thou purifiest the lifespans"—they should make this the opening verse. / The Rathantarasāman should be their Soma [rite]. / Lifespan indeed they place in themselves. / And they go on, casting away evil.

1.4.7.s: asuryaṃ vā etasmādvarṇaṃ kṛtvā | paśavo vīryamapakrāmanti | yasya yūpo virohati | tvāṣṭraṃ bahurūpamālabheta | tvaṣṭā vai rūpāṇāmīśe | ya eva rūpāṇāmīśe | so'sminpaśūn vīryaṃ yacchati | nāsmātpaśavo vīryamapa krāmanti | ārtiṃ vā ete niyanti | yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāmagnirudvāyati
1.4.7.d: असुर्यं वा एतस्माद्वर्णं कृत्वा । पशवो वीर्यमपक्रामन्ति । यस्य यूपो विरोहति । त्वाष्ट्रं बहुरूपमालभेत । त्वष्टा वै रूपाणामीशे । य एव रूपाणामीशे । सोऽस्मिन्पशून् वीर्यं यच्छति । नास्मात्पशवो वीर्यमप क्रामन्ति । आर्तिं वा एते नियन्ति । येषां दीक्षितानामग्निरुद्वायति
1.4.7.m: Having made an ungodly color away from him, / domestic animals and heroic power depart [from him] / whose sacrificial post sprouts. / He should seize [an animal] sacred to Tvaṣṭṛ of various forms. / Tvaṣṭṛ indeed rules over forms. / He who rules over forms, / he bestows domestic animals and heroic power upon him. / Domestic animals and heroic power do not depart from him. / They indeed incur misfortune / among whom, when initiated, the fire goes out.

1.4.7.s: yadāhavanīya udvāyet | yattaṃ manthet | vicchindyāt | bhrātṛvyamasmai janayet | yadāhavanīya udvāyet | āgnīddhrāduddharet | yadāgnīddhra udvāyet | gārhapatyāduddharet | yadgārhapatya udvāyet | ata eva punarmanthet
1.4.7.d: यदाहवनीय उद्वायेत् । यत्तं मन्थेत् । विच्छिन्द्यात् । भ्रातृव्यमस्मै जनयेत् । यदाहवनीय उद्वायेत् । आग्नीद्ध्रादुद्धरेत् । यदाग्नीद्ध्र उद्वायेत् । गार्हपत्यादुद्धरेत् । यद्गार्हपत्य उद्वायेत् । अत एव पुनर्मन्थेत्
1.4.7.m: If the Āhavanīya should go out, / if he were to churn that one, / he would tear apart [the sacrifice], / he would produce a rival for him. / If the Āhavanīya should go out, / he should bring it forth from the Āgnīdhra. / If the Āgnīdhra should go out, / he should bring it forth from the Gārhapatya. / If the Gārhapatya should go out, / from this very [place] he should churn it again.

1.4.7.s: atra vāva sa nilayate | yatra khalu vai nilīnamuttamaṃ paśyanti | tadenamicchanti | yasmāddārorudvāyet | tasyāraṇī kuryāt | krumukamapi kuryāt | eṣā vā agneḥ priyā tanūḥ | yatkrumukaḥ | priyayaivainaṃ tanuvā samardhayati | gārhapatyaṃ manthati
1.4.7.d: अत्र वाव स निलयते । यत्र खलु वै निलीनमुत्तमं पश्यन्ति । तदेनमिच्छन्ति । यस्माद्दारोरुद्वायेत् । तस्यारणी कुर्यात् । क्रुमुकमपि कुर्यात् । एषा वा अग्नेः प्रिया तनूः । यत्क्रुमुकः । प्रिययैवैनं तनुवा समर्धयति । गार्हपत्यं मन्थति
1.4.7.m: Here indeed he hides. / Where they see him hidden last of all, / there they seek him. / From whatever wood it should go out, / of that he should make the churning sticks. / He should also use *krumuka* wood. / This indeed is Agni's dear body, / namely, *krumuka*. / With his dear body he provides him. / He churns the Gārhapatya.

1.4.7.s: gārhapatyo vā agneryoniḥ | svādevainaṃ yonerjanayati | nāsmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | yasya soma upadasyet | suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dvedhā vicchidya | ṛjīṣe'nyadā dhūnuyāt | juhuyādanyat | somamevābhiṣuṇoti | somaṃ juhoti | somasya vā abhiṣūyamāṇasya priyā tanūrudakrāmat
1.4.7.d: गार्हपत्यो वा अग्नेर्योनिः । स्वादेवैनं योनेर्जनयति । नास्मै भ्रातृव्यं जनयति । यस्य सोम उपदस्येत् । सुवर्णं हिरण्यं द्वेधा विच्छिद्य । ऋजीषेऽन्यदा धूनुयात् । जुहुयादन्यत् । सोममेवाभिषुणोति । सोमं जुहोति । सोमस्य वा अभिषूयमाणस्य प्रिया तनूरुदक्रामत्
1.4.7.m: The Gārhapatya is the womb of Agni. / From his own womb he generates him. / He does not produce a rival for him. / He whose Soma should run out, / having cut gold into two pieces, / he should shake out one into the dregs, / he should offer the other. / He presses Soma itself; / he offers Soma. / The dear body of Soma, while being pressed, departed.

1.4.7.s: tathsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyamabhavat | yathsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ kurvanti | priyayaivainaṃ tanuvā samardhayanti | yasyākrītaṃ somamapahareyuḥ | krīṇīyādeva | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yasya krītamapahareyuḥ | ādārāṃśca phālgunāni cābhiṣuṇuyāt | gāyatrī yaṃ somamāharat | tasya yo'ṃśuḥ parā'patat
1.4.7.d: तथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यमभवत् । यथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यं कुर्वन्ति । प्रिययैवैनं तनुवा समर्धयन्ति । यस्याक्रीतं सोममपहरेयुः । क्रीणीयादेव । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यस्य क्रीतमपहरेयुः । आदारांश्च फाल्गुनानि चाभिषुणुयात् । गायत्री यं सोममाहरत् । तस्य योऽंशुः पराऽपतत्
1.4.7.m: It became gold. / In that they use gold, / they furnish him with his dear body. / He whose unbought Soma they should carry off, / he should just buy [another]. / That indeed is the expiation for it. / He whose bought [Soma] they should carry off, / he should press *ādāra* plants and *phālguna* plants. / Which shoot fell away / of the Soma that the Gāyatrī brought,

1.4.7.s: ta ādārā abhavan | indro vṛtramahan | tasya valkaḥ parā'patat | tāni phālgunānyabhavan | paśavo vai phālgunāni | paśavaḥ somo rājā | yadādārāṃśca phālgunāni cābhiṣuṇoti | somameva rājānamabhiṣuṇoti | śṛtena prātaḥsavane śrīṇīyāt | dadhnā madhyandine
1.4.7.d: त आदारा अभवन् । इन्द्रो वृत्रमहन् । तस्य वल्कः पराऽपतत् । तानि फाल्गुनान्यभवन् । पशवो वै फाल्गुनानि । पशवः सोमो राजा । यदादारांश्च फाल्गुनानि चाभिषुणोति । सोममेव राजानमभिषुणोति । शृतेन प्रातःसवने श्रीणीयात् । दध्ना मध्यन्दिने
1.4.7.m: those became the *ādāra* plants. / Indra slew Vṛtra; / his bark fell away: / that became the *phālguna* plants. / Domestic animals indeed are the *phālguna* plants; / domestic animals are king Soma. / When he presses *ādāra* plants and *phālguna* plants, / he presses king Soma itself. / With hot milk he should mix it at the morning pressing; / with curds at midday;

1.4.7.s: nītamiśreṇa tṛtīyasavane | agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ syādrathantarasāmā | ya evartvijo vṛtāḥ syuḥ | ta enaṃ yājayeyuḥ | ekāṃ gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttebhya eva | punaḥ somaṃ krīṇīyāt | yajñenaiva tadyajñamicchati | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānamāgurate | yaḥ sattrāyāgurate | etāvānkhalu vai puruṣaḥ | yāvadasya vittam | sarvavedasena yajeta | sarvapṛṣṭho'sya somaḥ syāt | sarvābhya eva devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānaṃ niṣkrīṇīte
1.4.7.d: नीतमिश्रेण तृतीयसवने । अग्निष्टोमः सोमः स्याद्रथन्तरसामा । य एवर्त्विजो वृताः स्युः । त एनं याजयेयुः । एकां गां दक्षिणां दद्यात्तेभ्य एव । पुनः सोमं क्रीणीयात् । यज्ञेनैव तद्यज्ञमिच्छति । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । सर्वाभ्यो वा एष देवताभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पृष्ठेभ्य आत्मानमागुरते । यः सत्त्रायागुरते । एतावान्खलु वै पुरुषः । यावदस्य वित्तम् । सर्ववेदसेन यजेत । सर्वपृष्ठोऽस्य सोमः स्यात् । सर्वाभ्य एव देवताभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पृष्ठेभ्य आत्मानं निष्क्रीणीते
1.4.7.m: with clarified butter mixed in at the third pressing. / The Soma [rite] should be an Agniṣṭoma having the Rathantarasāman. / Whichever priests were chosen, / they should perform the sacrifice for him. / A single cow he should give as a sacrificial fee to them alone. / Again he should buy Soma. / Through sacrifice he thus seeks the sacrifice. / That indeed is the expiation for it. / To all the deities, to all the Pṛṣṭha stotras he pledges himself, / who pledges himself to a sacrificial session. / So much indeed is a man / as his property is. / He should sacrifice with all his possessions. / His Soma [rite] should have all the Pṛṣṭha stotras. / From all deities, from all the Pṛṣṭha stotras he redeems himself.

1.4.8.s: pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ | pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu mā | punantu mā devajanāḥ | punantu manavo dhiyā | punantu viśva āyavaḥ | jātavedaḥ pavitravat | pavitreṇa punāhi mā | śukreṇa deva dīdyat | agne kratvā kratūṃranu
1.4.8.d: पवमानः सुवर्जनः । पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः । यः पोता स पुनातु मा । पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः । पुनन्तु मनवो धिया । पुनन्तु विश्व आयवः । जातवेदः पवित्रवत् । पवित्रेण पुनाहि मा । शुक्रेण देव दीद्यत् । अग्ने क्रत्वा क्रतूंरनु
1.4.8.m: Pavamāna, having the realm of light for folk, / active through the purifier: / may he who is the Potṛ purify me. / May the divine folk purify me; / may the Manus purify me with vision; / may all human beings purify me. / O Jātavedas, possessor of the purifier, / purify me with the purifier, / shining with bright light, O god, / O Agni, along with will according to wills.

1.4.8.s: yatte pavitramarciṣi | agne vitatamantarā | brahma tena punīmahe | ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ | pavitreṇa savena ca | idaṃ brahma punīmahe | vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgāt | yasyai bahvīstanuvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | tayā madantaḥ sadha mādyeṣu | vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
1.4.8.d: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिषि । अग्ने विततमन्तरा । ब्रह्म तेन पुनीमहे । उभाभ्यां देव सवितः । पवित्रेण सवेन च । इदं ब्रह्म पुनीमहे । वैश्वदेवी पुनती देव्यागात् । यस्यै बह्वीस्तनुवो वीतपृष्ठाः । तया मदन्तः सध माद्येषु । वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्
1.4.8.m: That purifier of thine which is in the flame, / stretched out within, O Agni, / with that brahman we purify ourselves. / By both, O divine Savitṛ, / by the purifier and by the impulse, / we purify this brahman. / The purifying goddess belonging to all gods has arrived, / who has many bodies with smoothed backs. / Exulting with her in feasts of intoxication, / may we be lords of riches.

1.4.8.s: vaiśvānaro raśmibhirmā punātu | vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro mayobhūḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhiḥ | ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām | bṛhadbhiḥ savitastṛbhiḥ | varṣiṣṭhairdeva manmabhiḥ | agne dakṣaiḥ punāhi mā | yena devā apunata | yenāpo divyaṃ kaśaḥ | tena divyena brahmaṇā
1.4.8.d: वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर्मा पुनातु । वातः प्राणेनेषिरो मयोभूः । द्यावापृथिवी पयसा पयोभिः । ऋतावरी यज्ञिये मा पुनीताम् । बृहद्भिः सवितस्तृभिः । वर्षिष्ठैर्देव मन्मभिः । अग्ने दक्षैः पुनाहि मा । येन देवा अपुनत । येनापो दिव्यं कशः । तेन दिव्येन ब्रह्मणा
1.4.8.m: May Vaiśvānara purify me with his rays; / may the Wind, swift and beneficent, [purify me] with his breath; / may heaven and earth, rich in order and worthy of sacrifice, / purify me with milk and waters. / With lofty [rays], O Savitṛ, / with the highest thoughts, O god, / with skills, O Agni, do you purify me! / By that with which the gods purified [themselves], / by which the waters [purified] the celestial whip, / by that celestial brahman,

1.4.8.s: idaṃ brahma punīmahe | yaḥ pāvamānīradhyeti | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam | sarvaṃ sa pūtamaśnāti | svaditaṃ mātariśvanā | pāvamānīryo adhyeti | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam | tasmai sarasvatī duhe | kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam | pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ
1.4.8.d: इदं ब्रह्म पुनीमहे । यः पावमानीरध्येति । ऋषिभिः संभृतं रसम् । सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति । स्वदितं मातरिश्वना । पावमानीर्यो अध्येति । ऋषिभिः संभृतं रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे । क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम् । पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः
1.4.8.m: we purify this brahman. / Whoever studies the purifying [hymns], / the sap gathered by the ṛṣis, / eats all that is purified, / sweetened by Mātariśvan. / Whoever studies the purifying [hymns], / the sap gathered by the ṛṣis, / for him Sarasvatī yields / milk, clarified butter, honey, and water. / The purifying [hymns] bringing well-being,

1.4.8.s: sudughā hi payasvatīḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛto rasaḥ | brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitam | pāvamānīrdiśantu naḥ | imaṃ lokamatho amum | kāmānthsamardhayantu naḥ | devīrdevaiḥ samābhṛtāḥ | pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ | sudughā hi ghṛtaścutaḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛto rasaḥ
1.4.8.d: सुदुघा हि पयस्वतीः । ऋषिभिः संभृतो रसः । ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतं हितम् । पावमानीर्दिशन्तु नः । इमं लोकमथो अमुम् । कामान्थ्समर्धयन्तु नः । देवीर्देवैः समाभृताः । पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः । सुदुघा हि घृतश्चुतः । ऋषिभिः संभृतो रसः
1.4.8.m: yielding good milk, rich in milk— / the sap gathered by the ṛṣis, / immortality placed within the Brahmins— / may the purifying [hymns] assign to us / this world and also that one; / may they fulfill our desires, / divine [powers] brought together by the gods! / The purifying [hymns] bringing well-being, / yielding good milk, dripping with clarified butter, / the sap gathered by the ṛṣis,

1.4.8.s: brāhmaṇeṣvamṛtaṃ hitam | yena devāḥ pavitreṇa | ātmānaṃ punate sadā | tena sahasradhāreṇa | pāvamānyaḥ punantu mā | prājāpatyaṃ pavitram | śatodyāmaṃ hiraṇmayam | tena brahmavido vayam | pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe | indraḥ sunītī saha mā punātu | somaḥ svastyā varuṇaḥ samīcyā | yamo rājā pramṛṇābhiḥ punātu mā | jātavedā morjayantyā punātu
1.4.8.d: ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतं हितम् । येन देवाः पवित्रेण । आत्मानं पुनते सदा । तेन सहस्रधारेण । पावमान्यः पुनन्तु मा । प्राजापत्यं पवित्रम् । शतोद्यामं हिरण्मयम् । तेन ब्रह्मविदो वयम् । पूतं ब्रह्म पुनीमहे । इन्द्रः सुनीती सह मा पुनातु । सोमः स्वस्त्या वरुणः समीच्या । यमो राजा प्रमृणाभिः पुनातु मा । जातवेदा मोर्जयन्त्या पुनातु
1.4.8.m: immortality placed within the Brahmins— / by that filter with which the gods / continually purify themselves, / with that thousand-streamed [filter] / may the purifying [hymns] purify [us]! / The filter belonging to Prajāpati, / stretching out a hundredfold, made of gold— / by that, we who know brahman / purify the purified brahman. / May Indra purify me with good guidance; / Soma with well-being; Varuṇa with concordance; / may King Yama purify me with crushing blows; / may Jātavedas purify me with invigorating [power]!

1.4.9.s: prajā vai satramāsata tapastapyamānā ajuhvatīḥ | devā apaśyañcamasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām | tamupodatiṣṭhantamajuhavuḥ | tenārdhamāsa ūrjamavārundhata | tasmādardhamāse devā ijyante | pitaro'paśyañcamasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām | tamupodatiṣṭhantamajuhavuḥ | tena māsyūrjamavārundhata | tasmānmāsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate | manuṣyā apaśyañcamasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām
1.4.9.d: प्रजा वै सत्रमासत तपस्तप्यमाना अजुह्वतीः । देवा अपश्यञ्चमसं घृतस्य पूर्णं स्वधाम् । तमुपोदतिष्ठन्तमजुहवुः । तेनार्धमास ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तस्मादर्धमासे देवा इज्यन्ते । पितरोऽपश्यञ्चमसं घृतस्य पूर्णं स्वधाम् । तमुपोदतिष्ठन्तमजुहवुः । तेन मास्यूर्जमवारुन्धत । तस्मान्मासि पितृभ्यः क्रियते । मनुष्या अपश्यञ्चमसं घृतस्य पूर्णं स्वधाम्
1.4.9.m:
The creatures sat in a sacrificial session, practicing austerity, not offering oblations. / The gods saw a bowl full of clarified butter, a svadhā-offering. / Standing up beside it, they made an offering of it. / Through it, they obtained vigor for a half-month. / Therefore, sacrifice is made to the gods at the half-month. / The fathers saw a bowl full of clarified butter, a svadhā-offering. / Standing up beside it, they made an offering of it. / Through it, they obtained vigor for a month. / Therefore, [the rite] is performed for the fathers at the month. / Human beings saw a bowl full of clarified butter, a svadhā-offering.

Standing up beside it, they made an offering of it. / Through it, they obtained two-fold vigor. / Therefore, twice a day [food] is served to human beings: / in the morning and in the evening. / Domestic animals saw a bowl full of clarified butter, a svadhā-offering. / Standing up beside it, they made an offering of it. / Through it, they obtained three-fold vigor. / Therefore, three times a day domestic animals are driven out: / in the morning, at mid-morning, and in the evening. / The asuras saw a bowl full of clarified butter, a svadhā-offering.

1.4.9.s: tamupodatiṣṭhantamajuhavuḥ | tena dvayīmūrjamavārundhata | tasmāddvirahno manuṣyebhya upa hriyate | prātaśca sāyaṃ ca | paśavo'paśyañcamasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām | tamupodatiṣṭhantamajuhavuḥ | tena trayīmūrjamavārundhata | tasmāttrirahnaḥ paśavaḥ prerate | prātaḥ saṅgave sāyam | asurā apaśyañcamasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām
1.4.9.d: तमुपोदतिष्ठन्तमजुहवुः । तेन द्वयीमूर्जमवारुन्धत । तस्माद्द्विरह्नो मनुष्येभ्य उप ह्रियते । प्रातश्च सायं च । पशवोऽपश्यञ्चमसं घृतस्य पूर्णं स्वधाम् । तमुपोदतिष्ठन्तमजुहवुः । तेन त्रयीमूर्जमवारुन्धत । तस्मात्त्रिरह्नः पशवः प्रेरते । प्रातः सङ्गवे सायम् । असुरा अपश्यञ्चमसं घृतस्य पूर्णं स्वधाम्
1.4.9.m: Standing up beside it, they made an offering of it. / Through it, they obtained vigor for a year. / The gods thought: / "These [asuras] have indeed become this / that we are!" / They saw these four-month sacrifices (Cāturmāsyas). / They performed them. / Through them they took away that vigor of theirs. / Then the gods flourished, / the asuras were defeated.

1.4.9.s: tamupodatiṣṭhantamajuhavuḥ | tena saṃvathsara ūrjamavārundhata | te devā amanyanta | amī vā idamabhūvan | yadvayaṃsma iti | ta etāni cāturmāsyānyapaśyan | tāni niravapan | tairevaiṣāṃ tāmūrjamavṛñjata | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ
1.4.9.d: तमुपोदतिष्ठन्तमजुहवुः । तेन संवथ्सर ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । ते देवा अमन्यन्त । अमी वा इदमभूवन् । यद्वयंस्म इति । त एतानि चातुर्मास्यान्यपश्यन् । तानि निरवपन् । तैरेवैषां तामूर्जमवृञ्जत । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः

1.4.9.s: yadyajate | yāmeva devā ūrjamavārundhata | tāṃ tenāvarundhe | yatpitṛbhyaḥ karoti | yāmeva pitara ūrjamavārundhata | tāṃ tenāvarundhe | yadāvasathe'nnaṃ haranti | yāmeva manuṣyā ūrjamavārundhata | tāṃ tenāvarundhe | yaddakṣiṇāṃ dadāti
1.4.9.d: यद्यजते । यामेव देवा ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तां तेनावरुन्धे । यत्पितृभ्यः करोति । यामेव पितर ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तां तेनावरुन्धे । यदावसथेऽन्नं हरन्ति । यामेव मनुष्या ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तां तेनावरुन्धे । यद्दक्षिणां ददाति
1.4.9.m: When he sacrifices, / that very vigor which the gods obtained, / he obtains by that. / When he performs [rites] for the fathers, / that very vigor which the fathers obtained, / he obtains by that. / When they take food to the lodge, / that very vigor which human beings obtained, / he obtains by that. / When he gives the sacrificial fee,

1.4.9.s: yāmeva paśava ūrjamavārundhata | tāṃ tenāvarundhe | yaccāturmāsyairyajate | yāmevāsurā ūrjamavārundhata | tāṃ tenāvarundhe | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | virājo vā eṣā vikrāntiḥ | yaccāturmāsyāni | vaiśvadevenāsmiṃ lloke pratyatiṣṭhat | varuṇapraghāsairantarikṣe | sākamedhairamuṣmiṃ lloke | eṣa hatvāvai tathsarvaṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ vidvāṃścāturmāsyairyajate
1.4.9.d: यामेव पशव ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तां तेनावरुन्धे । यच्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजते । यामेवासुरा ऊर्जमवारुन्धत । तां तेनावरुन्धे । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति । विराजो वा एषा विक्रान्तिः । यच्चातुर्मास्यानि । वैश्वदेवेनास्मिं ल्लोके प्रत्यतिष्ठत् । वरुणप्रघासैरन्तरिक्षे । साकमेधैरमुष्मिं ल्लोके । एष हत्वावै तथ्सर्वं भवति । य एवं विद्वांश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजते
1.4.9.m: that very vigor which the domestic animals obtained, / he obtains by that. / When he sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices, / that very vigor which the asuras obtained, / he obtains by that. / He prospers in his self; / his rival is defeated. / This indeed is the stride of the Virāj, / namely the four-month sacrifices. / Through the Vaiśvadeva, he firmly establishes himself in this world, / through the Varuṇapraghāsas in the intermediate space, / through the Sākamedhas in that world. / One who knows thus and sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices, / slaying [the rival], becomes all that.

1.4.10.s: agnirvāva saṃvathsaraḥ | ādityaḥ parivathsaraḥ | candramā idāvathsaraḥ | vāyuranuvathsaraḥ | yadvaiśvadevena yajate | agnimeva tathsaṃvathsaramāpnoti | tasmādvaiśvadevena yajamānaḥ | saṃvathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | yadvaruṇapraghāsairyajate | ādityameva tatparivathsaramāpnoti
1.4.10.d: अग्निर्वाव संवथ्सरः । आदित्यः परिवथ्सरः । चन्द्रमा इदावथ्सरः । वायुरनुवथ्सरः । यद्वैश्वदेवेन यजते । अग्निमेव तथ्संवथ्सरमाप्नोति । तस्माद्वैश्वदेवेन यजमानः । संवथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । यद्वरुणप्रघासैर्यजते । आदित्यमेव तत्परिवथ्सरमाप्नोति
1.4.10.m: Agni is indeed the year; / Āditya is the full year (parivatsara); / the Moon is the recurring year (idāvatsara); / Vāyu is the following year (anuvatsara). / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / he thereby attains Agni, the year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Vaiśvadeva, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the year." / When he sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / he thereby attains Āditya, the full year.

1.4.10.s: tasmādvaruṇapraghāsairyajamānaḥ | parivathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | yathsākamedhairyajate | candramasameva tadidāvathsaramāpnoti | tasmāthsākamedhairyajamānaḥ | idāvathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | yatpitṛyajñena yajate | devāneva tadanvavasyati | atha vā asya vāyuścānuvathsaraścāprītāvucchiṣyete | yacchunāsīrīyeṇa yajate
1.4.10.d: तस्माद्वरुणप्रघासैर्यजमानः । परिवथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । यथ्साकमेधैर्यजते । चन्द्रमसमेव तदिदावथ्सरमाप्नोति । तस्माथ्साकमेधैर्यजमानः । इदावथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । यत्पितृयज्ञेन यजते । देवानेव तदन्ववस्यति । अथ वा अस्य वायुश्चानुवथ्सरश्चाप्रीतावुच्छिष्येते । यच्छुनासीरीयेण यजते
