1.4.10.m: Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Varuṇapraghāsas, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the full year." / When he sacrifices with the Sākamedhas, / he thereby attains the Moon, the recurring year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Sākamedhas, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the recurring year." / When he sacrifices with the Pitṛyajña, / he thereby settles along with the gods. / But Vāyu and the following year would be left unpropitiated for him. / When he sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya,

1.4.10.s: vāyumeva tadanuvathsaramāpnoti | tasmācchunāsīrīyeṇa yajamānaḥ | anuvathsarīṇāg svastimāśāsta ityāśāsīta | saṃvathsaraṃ vā eṣa īpsatītyāhuḥ | yaścāturmāsyairyajata iti | eṣa ha tvai saṃvathsaramāpnoti | ya evaṃ vidvāṃścāturmāsyairyajate | viśve devāḥ samayajanta | te'gnimevāyajanta | ta etaṃ lokamajayan
1.4.10.d: वायुमेव तदनुवथ्सरमाप्नोति । तस्माच्छुनासीरीयेण यजमानः । अनुवथ्सरीणाग् स्वस्तिमाशास्त इत्याशासीत । संवथ्सरं वा एष ईप्सतीत्याहुः । यश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजत इति । एष ह त्वै संवथ्सरमाप्नोति । य एवं विद्वांश्चातुर्मास्यैर्यजते । विश्वे देवाः समयजन्त । तेऽग्निमेवायजन्त । त एतं लोकमजयन्
1.4.10.m: he thereby attains Vāyu, the following year. / Therefore, the sacrificer, when performing the Śunāsīrīya, / should pray, saying: "He prays for the well-being of the following year." / "He seeks to win the year," they say, / "who sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices." / He indeed attains the year / who knows thus and sacrifices with the four-month sacrifices. / All the gods sacrificed together; / they sacrificed to Agni alone. / They won this world

1.4.10.s: yasminnagniḥ | yadvaiśvadevena yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnagniḥ | agnereva sāyujyamupaiti | yadā vaiśvadevena yajate | atha saṃvathsarasya gṛhapatimāpnoti | yadā saṃvathsarasya gṛhapatimāpnoti | atha sahasrayājinamāpnoti | yadā sahasrayājinamāpnoti
1.4.10.d: यस्मिन्नग्निः । यद्वैश्वदेवेन यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नग्निः । अग्नेरेव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदा वैश्वदेवेन यजते । अथ संवथ्सरस्य गृहपतिमाप्नोति । यदा संवथ्सरस्य गृहपतिमाप्नोति । अथ सहस्रयाजिनमाप्नोति । यदा सहस्रयाजिनमाप्नोति
1.4.10.m: in which Agni is. / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / he wins this very world / in which Agni is. / He attains unison with Agni. / When he sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva, / then he attains the master of the house of the year; / when he attains the master of the house of the year, / then he attains the sacrificer of a thousand; / when he attains the sacrificer of a thousand,

1.4.10.s: atha gṛhamedhinamāpnoti | yadā gṛhamedhinamāpnoti | athāgnirbhavati | yadā'gnirbhavati | atha gaurbhavati | eṣā vai vaiśvadevasya mātrā | etadvā eteṣāmavamam | ato'to vā uttarāṇi śreyāṃsi bhavanti | yadviśve devāḥ samayajanta | tadvaiśvadevasya vaiśvadevatvam
1.4.10.d: अथ गृहमेधिनमाप्नोति । यदा गृहमेधिनमाप्नोति । अथाग्निर्भवति । यदाऽग्निर्भवति । अथ गौर्भवति । एषा वै वैश्वदेवस्य मात्रा । एतद्वा एतेषामवमम् । अतोऽतो वा उत्तराणि श्रेयांसि भवन्ति । यद्विश्वे देवाः समयजन्त । तद्वैश्वदेवस्य वैश्वदेवत्वम्
1.4.10.m: then he attains the sacrificer of domestic rites (gṛhamedhin); / when he attains the sacrificer of domestic rites, / then he becomes Agni; / when he becomes Agni, / then he becomes a cow. / This indeed is the measure of the Vaiśvadeva. / This is indeed the lowest of these; / higher and higher than this become the superior [states]. / Because all the gods (viśve devāḥ) sacrificed together, / that is the all-god-nature of the Vaiśvadeva.

1.4.10.s: athādityo varuṇaṃ rājānaṃ varuṇapraghāsairayajata | sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasminnādityaḥ | yadvaruṇapraghāsairyajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnādityaḥ | ādityasyaiva sāyujyamupaiti | yadādityo varuṇaṃ rājānaṃ varuṇapraghāsairayajata | tadvaruṇapraghāsānāṃ varuṇapraghāsatvam | atha somo rājā chandāṃsi sākamedhairayajata
1.4.10.d: अथादित्यो वरुणं राजानं वरुणप्रघासैरयजत । स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिन्नादित्यः । यद्वरुणप्रघासैर्यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नादित्यः । आदित्यस्यैव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदादित्यो वरुणं राजानं वरुणप्रघासैरयजत । तद्वरुणप्रघासानां वरुणप्रघासत्वम् । अथ सोमो राजा छन्दांसि साकमेधैरयजत
1.4.10.m: Then Āditya sacrificed to king Varuṇa with the Varuṇapraghāsas. / He conquered that world / where Āditya is. / When one sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / he conquers that very world / where Āditya is. / He attains unison with Āditya. / Because Āditya sacrificed to king Varuṇa with the Varuṇapraghāsas, / that is the essence of the Varuṇapraghāsas. / Then King Soma sacrificed to the metres with the Sākamedhas.

1.4.10.s: sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasmiṃścandramā vibhāti | yathsākamedhairyajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasmiṃścandramā vibhāti | candramasa eva sāyujyamupaiti | somo vai candramāḥ | eṣa ha tvai sākṣāthsomaṃ bhakṣayati | ya evaṃ vidvānthsākamedhairyajate | yathsomaśca rājā chandāṃsi ca samaidhanta
1.4.10.d: स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिंश्चन्द्रमा विभाति । यथ्साकमेधैर्यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिंश्चन्द्रमा विभाति । चन्द्रमस एव सायुज्यमुपैति । सोमो वै चन्द्रमाः । एष ह त्वै साक्षाथ्सोमं भक्षयति । य एवं विद्वान्थ्साकमेधैर्यजते । यथ्सोमश्च राजा छन्दांसि च समैधन्त
1.4.10.m: He conquered that world / where the moon shines forth. / When one sacrifices with the Sākamedhas, / he conquers that very world / where the moon shines forth. / He attains unison with the moon. / Soma indeed is the moon. / He directly partakes of Soma, / who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Sākamedhas. / Because King Soma and the metres prospered together (samaidhanta),

1.4.10.s: tathsākamedhānāṃ sākamedhatvam | athartavaḥ pitaraḥ prajāpatiṃ pitaraṃ pitṛyajñenāyajanta | ta etaṃ lokamajayan | yasminnṛtavaḥ | yatpitṛyajñena yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminnṛtavaḥ | ṛtūnāmeva sāyujyamupaiti | yadṛtavaḥ pitaraḥ prajāpatiṃ pitaraṃ pitṛyajñenāyajanta | tatpitṛyajñasya pitṛyajñatvam
1.4.10.d: तथ्साकमेधानां साकमेधत्वम् । अथर्तवः पितरः प्रजापतिं पितरं पितृयज्ञेनायजन्त । त एतं लोकमजयन् । यस्मिन्नृतवः । यत्पितृयज्ञेन यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्नृतवः । ऋतूनामेव सायुज्यमुपैति । यदृतवः पितरः प्रजापतिं पितरं पितृयज्ञेनायजन्त । तत्पितृयज्ञस्य पितृयज्ञत्वम्
1.4.10.m: that is the essence of the Sākamedhas. / Then the seasons, the ancestors, sacrificed to Prajāpati the father with the Pitṛyajña. / They conquered that world / where the seasons are. / When one sacrifices with the Pitṛyajña, / he conquers that very world / where the seasons are. / He attains unison with the seasons. / Because the seasons, the ancestors, sacrificed to Prajāpati the father with the Pitṛyajña, / that is the essence of the Pitṛyajña.

1.4.10.s: athauṣadhaya imaṃ devaṃ tryambakairayajanta prathemahīti | tato vai tā aprathanta | ya evaṃ vidvāṃstryambakairyajate | prathate prajayā paśubhiḥ | atha vāyuḥ parameṣṭhinaṃ śunāsīrīyeṇāyajata | sa etaṃ lokamajayat | yasminvāyuḥ | yacchunāsīrīyeṇa yajate | etameva lokaṃ jayati | yasminvāyuḥ
1.4.10.d: अथौषधय इमं देवं त्र्यम्बकैरयजन्त प्रथेमहीति । ततो वै ता अप्रथन्त । य एवं विद्वांस्त्र्यम्बकैर्यजते । प्रथते प्रजया पशुभिः । अथ वायुः परमेष्ठिनं शुनासीरीयेणायजत । स एतं लोकमजयत् । यस्मिन्वायुः । यच्छुनासीरीयेण यजते । एतमेव लोकं जयति । यस्मिन्वायुः
1.4.10.m: Then the plants sacrificed to this deity with the Tryambakas, [saying,] “May we spread forth!” / Then indeed they spread forth. / He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Tryambakas, / spreads forth with offspring and domestic animals. / Then Vāyu sacrificed to Parameṣṭhin with the Śunāsīrīya. / He conquered that world / where Vāyu is. / When one sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya, / he conquers that very world / where Vāyu is.

1.4.10.s: vāyoreva sāyujyamupaiti | brahmavādino vadanti | pra cāturmāsyayājī mīyatāna pramīyatāiti | jīvanvā eṣa ṛtūnapyeti | yadi vasantā pramīyate | vasanto bhavati | yadi grīṣme grīṣmaḥ | yadi varṣāsu varṣāḥ | yadi śaradi śarat | yadi heman hemantaḥ | ṛturbhūtvā saṃvathsaramapyeti | saṃvathsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatirvāvaiṣaḥ
1.4.10.d: वायोरेव सायुज्यमुपैति । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । प्र चातुर्मास्ययाजी मीयतान प्रमीयताइति । जीवन्वा एष ऋतूनप्येति । यदि वसन्ता प्रमीयते । वसन्तो भवति । यदि ग्रीष्मे ग्रीष्मः । यदि वर्षासु वर्षाः । यदि शरदि शरत् । यदि हेमन् हेमन्तः । ऋतुर्भूत्वा संवथ्सरमप्येति । संवथ्सरः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतिर्वावैषः
1.4.10.m: He attains unison with Vāyu. / The discussers of sacred lore say: / “Does the performer of the four-month sacrifices die or does he not die?” / Living indeed, he enters into the seasons. / If he dies in the spring, / he becomes the spring. / If in the summer, the summer. / If in the rains, the rains. / If in the autumn, the autumn. / If in the winter, the winter. / Having become a season, he enters into the year. / The year is Prajāpati. / He indeed is Prajāpati.
